intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: A warrior takes sword in hand, clasping a gem to his heart.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Engraving vanishing memories into the sword,
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: He places finely honed skills into the stone.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Spoken from the sword, handed down from the stone...
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Now the story can be told...
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Square presents
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The "The Zodiac Brave Story".
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: I am Alazlam, a scholar of ancient Ivalice history...
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Have you ever heard of the "Lion War"?
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: It divided Ivalice in two over who would be the successor to the throne.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: It ended with the appearance of a young hero named Delita.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Everybody living here knows this hero's tale...
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: But we also know that what we see with our eyes alone... isn't necessarily the truth.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Here's a young man.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: He is the youngest son of the noble Beoulve...pillars of knighthood.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: There's no record of his playing an active part in history but...
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: According to the "Durai Report" released last year (concealed for many years by church), this unknown man is the true hero...
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The church claims he was a blasphemer and anarchist-the root of all evil...
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: But is this the "truth"?
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Won't you join me on a journey for the "truth"?
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Before that, please tell me your 'name' and 'birthday'.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: A young knight with the crest of the black lion is seen on his chocobo. The knight carefully watches the area and signals. A four men riding chocobos comes out from behind the knight. The five travels through the forest and plains at great speed with their chocobos. After travelling for some time, the five men finally comes in front of what seems to be a church.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: God, please help us sinful children of Ivalice.
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Female Knight
intro.text: Princess Ovelia, let's go.
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Princess Ovelia
intro.text: Just a moment, Agrias...
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: The guards have already arrived.
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Priest
intro.text: Princess, don't give Agrias trouble. Please hurry...
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: A knight and two squires comes in from outside.
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Black Knight
intro.text: What's going on? It's been nearly an hour!
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: Don't be rude to the Princess, Gafgarion.
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The two squires behind the Black Knight kneels down while the Black Knight simply bows his head.
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: Is this going to be alright, Agrias? This is an urgent issue for us.
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: So there are rude knaves even among the Hokuten?
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: I'm being more than kind to the guard captains here. Besides, we're mercenaries hired by the Hokuten. I'm not obliged to show respect to you.
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: What? How dare you!
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The princess stands up.
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.text: Enough. Let's go.
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The two squires gets up on their feet. The princess walks over to the priest.
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Priest
intro.text: Go with God.
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.text: You too, Simon.
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: A female knight walks in with a nasty wound. The priest helps the knight.
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Female Knight
intro.text: Lady Agrias!... The enemy!
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Simon
intro.text: Prince Goltana's men!?
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Agrias quickly rushes out the monastery.
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: What one must do to make money. What, Ramza? You have a problem, too?
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: ...I'm no longer a Knight. Just a mercenary like you.
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: ...That's right. Well then. Let's go!
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The Knight and the two squires goes outside.
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.text: Oh God...
intro.title: Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: The crest of the Black Lion!? What's wrong with Prince Goltana!? He's such an idiot! Does he want to start a war!?
intro.title: Outside the monastery

intro.speaker: Goltana Knight
intro.text: Knave! There's no point in resisting! Just give us the Princess, or that beautiful face of yours will be scarred forever!
intro.title: Outside the monastery

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The black knight and the two squires comes out to help Agrias and the others.
intro.title: Outside the monastery

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: Fool! Only idiots attack head on!
intro.title: Outside the monastery

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Agrias steps forward.
intro.title: Outside the monastery

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: Leave this to us!
intro.title: Outside the monastery

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: We can't make money that way! Rad, Ramza! Follow me!! Kill them all! Don't leave any survivors!
intro.title: Outside the monastery

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: Nonsense! There's no need to kill them! That's just what Goltana wants us to do! Just let them go!
intro.title: Outside the monastery

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: That's impossible!
intro.title: Outside the monastery

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: Let go of me!
outro.title: Outside the monastery

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Agrias looks at the monastery.
outro.title: Outside the monastery

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: Damn!!
outro.title: Outside the monastery

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Agrias runs inside to save the princess. A knight takes the princess through the back door of the monastery.
outro.title: Outside the monastery

outro.speaker: Knight
outro.text: Come here! Be quiet!!
outro.title: Outside the monastery

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: Why should I listen to you!?
outro.title: Outside the monastery

outro.speaker: Knight
outro.text: What an annoying Princess.
outro.title: Outside the monastery

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The knight punches the princess on the stomach and puts her on his chocobo. Agrias comes out.
outro.title: Outside the monastery

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: Wait!!
outro.title: Outside the monastery

outro.speaker: Knight
outro.text: Tough...Don't blame us. Blame yourself or God.
outro.title: Outside the monastery

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The knight takes off with the princess. Agrias runs after the knight, realizing she cannot keep up, she falls down on her knees.
outro.title: Outside the monastery

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: Oh, God......
outro.title: Outside the monastery

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza sees the knight.
outro.title: Outside the monastery

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: ...Delita?? You're alive, Delita? But, why are you in Goltana's troops? Why...?
outro.title: Outside the monastery

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita's name appears for the first time a year before the Lion War broke out.
outro.title: Outside the monastery

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Many soldiers who returned from the war, had no jobs, little money, and even less loyalty to the crown.
outro.title: Outside the monastery

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Many became thieves and rebels plotting rebellion against the royal family.
outro.title: Outside the monastery

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: At that time robbery and murder were commonplace in Ivalice. Many heroes and wizards came out of there. And Gariland was no exception either.
outro.title: Outside the monastery

intro.speaker: Chapter 1
intro.text: THE MEAGER
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: ```text I------------------------------------------------------------I |-- =-=-= =-= =-=-= =-= =-=- NEWS -=-= =-= =-=-= =-= =-=-= --| | The Death Corps | | Robberies are on the rise in various areas and Gallione | | is no exception. Wagon hijackings and abductions are | | rampant. Now a group of former criminals and mercenaries, | | called the "Death Corps", have been making the most | | trouble for the Hokuten.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: | | The King Omdoria | | There is a great concern over King Omdolia, who collapsed | | at Prince Orinas birthday celebration. The Board of | | Chamberlains reported his fever has subsided, but he'll | | take 3 weeks to recover. It will be several months before | | he can make any public appearances. But since most public | | policy is made by Queen Ruvelia, no turmoil is expected.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: | | The Fifty Year War | | A war that caused terror for nearly 50 years between | | Ivalice and Ordalia, known as the "Fifty Year War". The | | War was ignited when King Diwanu died without naming a | | successor. The throne was succeeded by Diwanu's brother, | | Valowa, but Denamunda of Ivalice, declared war. This was | | only an excuse... the real reason was because of...
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: | | Zelamonia, a territory of Ivalice running along the | | Ordalian border. It was once independent, but was annexed | | over a century ago, after an invasion. Ivalice supported | | Ordalia, but the result was failure. Unrest among the | | Nobles and in the cities of Zelamonia, along with Ordalia's| | rule, led them to seek intervention from Ivalice.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: | | With victories in the early battles, Ivalice's Army | | marched on the capital of Bura. But King Denamunda fell | | ill and was never to return to his kingdom. The confusion | | gave the Ordalian Army an opportunity, as Valowa was | | successful in holding off Ivalice's Army. Approximately 2 | | year stalemate of was broken by the Romandan Army's | | invasion.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: | | Romanda is a military state separated from Ivalice by | | Larner Channel. Under King Valowa's orders, a blood | | relative, they marched on Ivalice. But, Denamunda who | | succeeded King Denamunda was a brave warrior against both | | the Romanda and Ordalian armies. An outbreak of Bubonic | | Plague in Romanda forced them to retreat in 2 years.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: | | The 2 squads most effective in the war were the Hokuten, | | led by Balbanes, and the Nanten, led by T.G. Cid. They | | scored many victories as they marched on Ordalia. But the | | long war was disasterous for both administrations. Farmers'| | revolts and riots broke out in many areas, as both | | kingdoms focused their war efforts within their borders.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: | | This made another stalemate broken only by the death of | | King Denamunda. (Widely believed to be assassinated) His | | successor, Omdolia was not fit to lead the kingdom, and | | left all matters of state to the elder statesmen and the | | Queen. Therefore, there was no power to drive the troops | | of Prince Lanard, Valowa's successor, out.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: After allowing | | the invasion of Zeltennia, battles that both the Hokuten | | and the Nanten fought in, Ivalice hoped for peace. | | Realizing the war was useless, both kingdoms agreed on | | peace, focusing their efforts within their respective | | borders. Although the agreement was bilateral, Ivalice | | surrendered. | | Soon after, Ivalice's economy was on the brink of | | bankruptcy because of severe war reparations.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Payments | | could not be made to returning soldiers, and large groups | | of Knights were discharged. As a result, high | | unemployment, uncertainty and distrust filled Ivalice. | I------------------------------------------------------------I ```
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Several students nearing graduation of the Gariland Academy were assembled. A plan was being formed, centered on the Hokuten, to extinguish the Death Corps who were terrorizing the Gallione region. The plan was to have the students handle all the future problems.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: Cadet
intro.text: I heard another wagon bound for Igros was attacked.
intro.title: Military Academy's Auditorium

intro.speaker: Cadet
intro.text: Must have been the Death Corps...
intro.title: Military Academy's Auditorium

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Something's starting... Know anything, Delita?
intro.title: Military Academy's Auditorium

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: No...but I can guess.
intro.title: Military Academy's Auditorium

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: What do you mean?
intro.title: Military Academy's Auditorium

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Prince Larg's coming to town.
intro.title: Military Academy's Auditorium

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Prince Larg? Why?
intro.title: Military Academy's Auditorium

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Not only Larg, but Marquis Elmdor of Limberry, too.
intro.title: Military Academy's Auditorium

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: That's news! It's not an official visit, is it?
intro.title: Military Academy's Auditorium

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: There are danger zones everywhere in Ivalice. The Hokuten Knights are in full operation, but suffering from a shortage of men.
intro.title: Military Academy's Auditorium

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: So, they need us cadets.
intro.title: Military Academy's Auditorium

intro.speaker: Voice
intro.text: Everyone, fall in!
intro.title: Military Academy's Auditorium

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: A Hokuten knight comes in.
intro.title: Military Academy's Auditorium

intro.speaker: Hokuten Knight
intro.text: You have a mission! As you know, barbarians are rapidly increasing here in Gallione. The traitorous Death Corps detest the royal family. We cannot overlook them. We will begin exterminating these traitors. By order of our Master. Larg's Knights stationed at Igros Castle and many other groups will participate. Your duty is to support the flank. Specifically, you'll go to Igros and help guard it.
intro.title: Military Academy's Auditorium

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: A female Hokuten knight comes in and whispers something to the knight. After that, the female knight leaves the room.
intro.title: Military Academy's Auditorium

intro.speaker: Hokuten Knight
intro.text: Cadets, ready your swords! A gang of tortured thieves is trying to sneak into this town. We'll begin preparations now to keep them out of town! Come with me! This is the frontline of operations! That's all! Prepare immediately!
intro.title: Military Academy's Auditorium

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The cadets goes out to confront the thieves at Magic City Gariland.
intro.title: Military Academy's Auditorium

intro.speaker: Thief
intro.text: What's this? Just a bunch of kids! What luck! OK, all we have to do is kill these kids! Then, we can escape! Don't you worry! We'll kill every one of you!
intro.title: Magic City Gariland

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Ramza, watch out! Don't rush them!
intro.title: Magic City Gariland

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Don't patronize me, Delita! I'm also a Beoulve!!
intro.title: Magic City Gariland

intro.speaker: Thief
intro.text: Beoulve!? THE Beoulve family!? So, you must be cadets from the military academy! Snot-nosed little nobles!!
intro.title: Magic City Gariland

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Silence! Surrender or die in obscurity!!
intro.title: Magic City Gariland

intro.speaker: Thief
intro.text: What can a bunch of kids like you do? Buncha spoiled punks like you'll never beat us!!
intro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Why do you continue committing acts like robbery? You wouldn't have died this way if you'd led an honest life.
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Victorious at Magic City, Ramza and the other cadets rests. Ramza remembers his father's death...
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: =-= Past =-=
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Having attained the highest rank of Heavenly Knight, brave Balbanes was facing his last days...
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The end of the 50 Year War The Beoulve Residence
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Balbanes Beoulve, renowned hero of the Fifty Year War, has been bedridden for 2 years due to illness. The sight of his father ill in bed was unbearable for his three children.
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: Balbanes
outro.text: How goes......the battle?
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Through swift action we were able to recover Limberry. It's only a matter of time before the Ordalia army leaves Zeltennia. Don't worry.
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: Lord Dycedarg
outro.text: The secret messenger sent to Count Lenario has returned. Count Lenario has agreed to your plan.
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: Balbanes
outro.text: Good...then, at last... this long war... will finally come to an end.
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: Father...
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Alma starts to cry.
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: Balbanes
outro.text: Don't cry...my daughter...
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Where is Ramza? Just when we need him most!
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: Balbanes
outro.text: Dycedarg, Zalbag... my beloved sons... Take care of Ramza. He may be your half brother, but he is my own flesh.
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza comes in running into the room.
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Father!!
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza comes near to his father's bed.
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Lower your voice.
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: Balbanes
outro.text: I'm glad you came... Let me...look at you...
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Father...
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: Balbanes
outro.text: It has been a long time... You've become a fine man... You start at the Academy...in spring, don't you?
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: Balbanes
outro.text: Listen, Ramza...... A Beoulve has served the royal family for generations. The warrior spirit is in us. Never shame your name... never tolerate in justice... Living true to your heart is the warrior's way......the Beoulve way.
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: I understand, father......
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: Balbanes
outro.text: Delita's a good boy. He should serve you well... I've asked the dean to accept him into the Academy. It shocked the dean a bit. He will serve you well... Treat him well...
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: Balbanes
outro.text: Take good care of Alma... Become a fine knight... Ramza.
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Balbanes dies.
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: After resting, Ramza and his party heads for Igros. On their way to Igros Castle the cadets comes across some thieves. A swordsman was attacked by the Death Corps on the Mandalia Plains. He was attacked while heading for Igros. The Marquis was abducted, that man was the only survivor.
outro.title: Magic City Gariland

missions.brief: Gariland · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: A life on the plains

intro.speaker: Thief (1)
intro.text: Still breathing. What'll we do?
intro.title: Mandalia Plains

intro.speaker: Thief (2)
intro.text: Don't be stupid. We just need to get the Marquis.
intro.title: Mandalia Plains

intro.speaker: Thief (1)
intro.text: Right. Hey, don't blame us. Blame fate.
intro.title: Mandalia Plains

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The party arrives at the scene.
intro.title: Mandalia Plains

intro.speaker: Thief (2)
intro.text: Wha? Damn! The Hokuten knights!
intro.title: Mandalia Plains

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Death corps? They attacking someone?
intro.title: Mandalia Plains

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Get them!
intro.title: Mandalia Plains

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Are you mad Ramza? Leaving him stranded!?
intro.title: Mandalia Plains

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Is this how you fight?
intro.title: Mandalia Plains

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: ...I'll save him.
intro.title: Mandalia Plains

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Don't disgrace the knights! Saving him comes first!
intro.title: Mandalia Plains

intro.speaker: Algus
intro.text: Reinforcements? Thank God!
intro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Are you OK?
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Barely... But the Marquis...
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Marquis? You mean Marquis Elmdor?
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Yeah. Who're you?
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: We're military cadets. I think we can help. Tell us more.
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Still breathing. Let's save him!
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: I'm Algus...of the Limberry Aegis Knights......
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: A knight...?
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: ...I mean, a cadet... like you all.
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: I'm Ramza Beoulve. This is Delita, a good friend.
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Algus looks at Ramza in disbelieve.
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Beoulve...? ...of the Hokuten? Excellent! How lucky I am!
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: I beg you, please help me save the Marquis!
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: What are you talking about?
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: The Marquis is still alive! They've kidnapped him! He will be killed, if we don't act fast! I don't know what I would do if...... So, please! Help me! Please!!
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Relax. We don't know for sure if he'll be killed. There must be some reason for Death Corps to take him. They might have made some demands.
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Besides, there is nothing we can do. The Marquis was kidnapped, and I'm sure by now everyone at Igros Castle is up in arms.
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: First, we should go to Igros and report.
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: All right. Let's do that.
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza, Delita, Algus and the others reaches Igros Castle. Ramza heads for the castle. Dycedarg meets with Ramza and his friends and decides to have dinner with them.
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: ...I hear you beat the first troops. I'm proud to be your brother. The senior statesmen spoke highly of you. You are truly descended from Beoulves.
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: ...Thank you.
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Aren't you happy?
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Oh, yes, I am. Thank you for the kind words....You might have heard about the enemy attacking Elmdor's carriage and kidnapping him. What would you have us do?
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: I've already had Zalbag send out a search party. They'll probably demand ransom... if he's still alive.
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Algus stands up from his chair and bows his head.
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Highness. Please let me have 100 soldiers!
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: I beg you. Let me avenge my comrades murder!
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: I said it's taken care of. Didn't you hear me? Gallione isn't any place for you. Let us handle it.
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: B..ut!
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Think of your rank, Algus! Have you forgotten you're just a soldier without rank of Knighthood?
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Urrrgh......
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Algus sits down.
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: I want you to guard Igros Castle. It shouldn't be so difficult. "Danger" probably won't get this far.
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: After having dinner Ramza, Delita and Algus goes outside the castle's courtyard.
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: ...My family was once respected like the Beoulves. My grandfather was captured during the Fifty Year War... He sold his friends out to the enemy to save himself. But, as he left the castle, he got stabbed in the back by a cadet just like myself. One of my grandfather's friends managed to escape and spread the story around. Of course my father didn't believe it, but everyone else did, they deserted him...
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Algus picks up a rock and throws it into the flowing river.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Rank...Dycedarg would never meet with someone like me...
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Voice of a young girl
outro.text: Delita!
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Teta!
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Alma, Zalbag!
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Alma, Teta and Zalbag runs down to meet Ramza and Delita.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: Brother Ramza. You came back.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Long time no see, brother.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: I heard how you beat the thieves in Gariland. That's worthy of a Beoulve. I'm sure father would've been pleased with you.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: ......Thank you.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Heh...haven't changed a bit. You don't like that much, eh? Delita, you look good. I heard about your role also. Just look how happy Teta is.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Teta
outro.text: Delita, I'm glad you're doing well.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: And you also. How is your schooling?
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Teta
outro.text: Fine. Everyone is so nice to me...
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: I'd like to talk more with you, but I must hunt down some thieves. Pardon me.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: I pray for your victory.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Zalbag turns around and waves his hand. He walks up and suddenly stops.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: ...The Death Corps have demanded a ransom.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: What!?
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: ...I can't understand it. The Death Corps claim to be anarchists, but they only rob and hurt the nobility. It's hard to believe they would kidnap the Marquis just for money.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Absurd! Why they're nothing more than knaves, I say!
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: The messenger we sent still hasn't returned. He's probably in trouble, but the nobles say there's no need to search for his whereabouts.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Where was he when you last heard from him?
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: A trade city called Dorter, east of Gallione......Guarding a castle is boring work. Don't you think?
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Zalbag leaves.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Teta, I'm sorry. We must go.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Teta
outro.text: Don't worry about me. Just take care of yourself.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita hugs Teta.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Don't worry. I'll come back safely...so be a good girl. Well then, let's go, Algus.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita, Teta and Algus leaves. Ramza tries to follow them but is interrupted by Alma.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: What Teta said is not true. Actually.........
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Something wrong with Teta?
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: She has been picked on at school because of her rank.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: Sorry...I shouldn't have worried you like that. Teta will be OK. I'll be there for her. Trust me.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: I'm not worried. But don't you overdo it.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: You're the one going too far to meet their expectations. Just be yourself and don't be restricted by your name.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: You sound like our mother. Ha, ha, ha, ha, ha.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza goes off to follow the others.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: Ramza......
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The party leaves Igros castle and heads for Dorter. The party encounters some monsters on their way.
outro.title: Igros Castle's Courtyard

missions.brief: Mandalia · Protect Algus.

missions.name: Tracks in the wood

intro.speaker: Algus
intro.text: What rotten luck. Meeting monsters in a place like this.
intro.title: Sweegy Woods

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Don't gripe, Algus. It's better than guarding a castle.
intro.title: Sweegy Woods

intro.speaker: Algus
intro.text: This is a matter of life and death. How can you say that?
intro.title: Sweegy Woods

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The monsters slowly approaches the party.
intro.title: Sweegy Woods

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Enough! Here they come!!
intro.title: Sweegy Woods

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Just through this forest, and we're almost to Dorter.
outro.title: Sweegy Woods

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The cadets comes to Dorter.
outro.title: Sweegy Woods

missions.brief: Sweegy · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Rain over Dorter

intro.speaker: Fencer
intro.text: ....I said I don't know!
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: Knight
intro.text: Don't lie to me! I know what you did! Where is Gustav? Where!?
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: Fencer
intro.text: I......don't know......
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: Knight
intro.text: Where is the Marquis? Where are you hiding him? Speak!!
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The knight pulls the man up by his throat and throws him in a nearby puddle. The knight draws out his sword and points the tip of his sword at the man.
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: Knight
intro.text: This is your last chance...... Where is he?
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: Fencer
intro.text: D....desert......
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: Knight
intro.text: I see...in "Rat Cellar"...
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza and the others comes to see what's happening.
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Wait!!
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The knight turns around and looks at the party.
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: Knight
intro.text: Damn, the Hokuten.
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The knight quickly disappears into the darkness.
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: Algus
intro.text: Looks like our trip here was well worth it.
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: I've seen him somewhere...
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Do you know him, Delita?
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: I saw him at the end of the Fifty Year War in Igros...
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Fencer's men shows up to assist the man.
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: I guess we must fight. Eaaagggghh!!
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Now I remember! His name is Wiegraf. Leader of a volunteer army, a corps of Death Knights.
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: Algus
intro.text: What? .... You mean he's the.....?
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Yes... The leader of the Death Corps.
intro.title: Slums in Dorter

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: You must be the Death Corps. Where is the Marquis? Where is he being held? Tell us!!
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The man is silent.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Your boss, Wiegraf was just here. Where did he go!?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The knight doesn't speak a word.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Y, you bastard! Say something!!
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Algus kicks him on the stomach, grabs his hair up and tries to hit him.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Stop! Algus!
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Damn.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Algus lets the man's hair go.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: ...Listen carefully. In a moment, the Hokuten will begin to slaughter you. That's right, each of you're going straight to hell. Being a thief sure pays, huh? But you're lucky. You tell us where Wiegraf is going, and I'll let you live, OK?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Fencer of Death Corps
outro.text: I don't know a damn thing.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Algus kicks him hard on the face.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Watch your language! Never talk to nobles like that!
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Fencer
outro.text: We're...not...thieves.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: What did you say!?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Fencer
outro.text: ...Nobles never change. You think we aren't human. We risk our lives in the War for this country...... But you dumped us afterward. How are we different? Birth? Status? What the hell's rank?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: You kidnap people for ransom! So don't act so great!!
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Fencer
outro.text: ...Kidnapping the Marquis was not Mr. Wiegraf's plan.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Fencer
outro.text: We'd never kidnap a VIP.... for money....
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Then, who? Who kidnapped Elmdor?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Talk! If it wasn't you, then who else would do it?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Fencer
outro.text: .....Gustav.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Gustav? Who the hell is he?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Gustav Margueriff... Captain of the "Death Corps".
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: So it WAS you all!
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Fencer
outro.text: No. We're fighting to beat you! We're proud that we fight for equality... We're different from Gustav!
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Algus kicks the man again on the face.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Proud? Bastards!!
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Enough, Algus!
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: So, where is this Gustav?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Fencer
outro.text: .... 'Sand Rat Cellar'.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Sand ra-a-a-ts?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Algus may not know what they are since he's not from here. 'Sand Rats' only inhabit the Zeklaus Desert north of Dorter.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Was there a village between Dorter and Zeklaus Desert?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Not anymore. But there is a place where desert people used to gather...
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: ......Gustav and the Marquis may be there.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Yes, probably.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: What's that mean??
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: 'Cellar' means a rat's nest.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The party heads for the Cellar.
outro.title: In a room

missions.brief: Dorter · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Sand Rat’s Sietch

intro.speaker: Death Corps Knight
intro.text: Hey, did you hear? The Hokuten are moving.
intro.title: Desert of the Sand Mouse

intro.speaker: Archer
intro.text: So I heard. What's going to happen to us?
intro.title: Desert of the Sand Mouse

intro.speaker: Knight
intro.text: Forget the Corps and run before we get killed.
intro.title: Desert of the Sand Mouse

intro.speaker: Soldier
intro.text: We'll die anyway even if we follow Wiegraf.
intro.title: Desert of the Sand Mouse

intro.speaker: Knight
intro.text: Exactly. If we get a ransom for the Marquis like Gustav planned, we can get outta this misery.
intro.title: Desert of the Sand Mouse

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The party arrives.
intro.title: Desert of the Sand Mouse

intro.speaker: Guard
intro.text: Oh, God!! The Hokuten!!
intro.title: Desert of the Sand Mouse

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Let's get the guard first, before the others find us!!
intro.title: Desert of the Sand Mouse

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: Gustav, why don't you give up?
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Gustav
outro.text: Your revolution can never succeed!! What we need is food and a place to sleep, not ideas! And we need it now!!
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: You only see the present. You have to fix the basics!
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Gustav
outro.text: And you think you'll do that? I don't think so, Wiegraf. Never!
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Wiegraf steps forward to make a strike.
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: Is that all you want to say? Gustav, good-bye.
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Gustav runs in full speed and tries to score a blow on Wiegraf first. Gustav attacks but Wiegraf counters the attack and sees the opening. In one motion he stabs his sword straight through Gustav's chest.
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Gustav
outro.text: Ugh...u...
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Gustav's sword falls down from his hand. Gustav looks down. Wiegraf pulls out his sword from Gustav's chest. Blood spills out and Gustav falls down on the ground, dead. Ramza, Delita and Algus comes inside the shack.
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Wiegraf!!
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Algus sees Marquis lying on the floor.
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Marquis!!
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Algus tries to free Marquis but is stopped by Wiegraf. Wiegraf points his sword at Marquis.
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: Freeze!
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: You bastard!!!
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Stop it, Algus.
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: The Marquis is all right. Take him back to Igros.
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: What?
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: Kidnapping wasn't our goal. We never stoop to such acts. You can have the Marquis, if you just let me go...well?
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Don't trifle with us! You can't beat us!
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita pulls back Algus.
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Stop it, Algus. He's serious!
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The three goes over to Elmdor while Wiegraf goes near to the door.
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Elmdor
outro.text: Ugnn..n....
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Wiegraf quickly leaves the room. Algus tries to chase Wiegraf but Delita blocks his way.
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Let him go, Algus!!
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Why do you stop me!
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: The Death Corps will destroy itself! Don't risk it!
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: ...Ughh!!
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza helps Marquis.
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: He's all right. Weakened, but no serious wounds.
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Let's go back to Igros...
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: After saving Marquis the party heads back to Igros.
outro.title: Shack

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: What happened? Why did you go to Zeklaus Desert?
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Explain to me......
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: I forced Ramza to go with me.
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Is that true, Ramza? Delita forced you to go?
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: .....No, it was my decision. Not Delita's.
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Ramza's lying. I was the one to......
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: No need to protect me. I decided to ignore an order!
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: If everyone acted lawlessly, how could "law" exist? We Beoulves must show the importance of observing the "law" as the Knights rule. Are you trying to ruin the Beoulve name?
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: ......I'm sorry, brother.
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: A man's voice
outro.text: That's enough, Dycedarg.
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: A wealthy man enters the room. Delita, Ramza and Algus falls down on their knees before the man.
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: A well dressed man
outro.text: He was a great help rescuing the Marquis. I know young soldiers are eager to succeed. So were we.
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Don't spoil him. There's a line between right and wrong.
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Larg
outro.text: So, you are Dycedarg's younger brother.....relax. You look exactly like the late General Balbanes... A fine-looking young man. I'm sure that youthful energy didn't come from just guarding the castle.....
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: The mission is nearly done. I'll allow you to join. We'll attack some of the thieves' hideouts at once. You choose one of them.
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: ... Yes.
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The three leaves the room in silence. Larg walks over to a nearby window.
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: I'm sorry.
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Larg
outro.text: Don't apologize, Dycedarg. After all, Gustav wasn't much of a soldier. The plan couldn't be changed after the Marquis was kidnapped in Gallione.... Besides, he did save the Marquis's life. They must accept our demands. Your brother's actions turned the tide for us...
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: The King doesn't have much time to live......... We must hurry......
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Larg
outro.text: Yes, I'm counting on you, my friend....
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The extermination of the Death Corps was near. The party heads to Thieves Fort.
outro.title: Inside Igros Castle

missions.brief: Zeklaus · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Miluda’s stand

intro.speaker: Miluda
intro.text: Communication with the main unit's been cut off. It's over.
intro.title: Thieves Fort

intro.speaker: Death Corps Priest
intro.text: No way! It's not over yet!
intro.title: Thieves Fort

intro.speaker: Priest
intro.text: I agree. It continues until the nobles apologize to us!
intro.title: Thieves Fort

intro.speaker: Miluda
intro.text: My brother.... His views are too optimistic.
intro.title: Thieves Fort

intro.speaker: Death Corps Guard
intro.text: Enemy attack!!
intro.title: Thieves Fort

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The cadets arrives at Thieves Fort to exterminate the remaining Death Corps.
intro.title: Thieves Fort

intro.speaker: Algus
intro.text: Ramza helped me save the Marquis. I'll stay on till the end!
intro.title: Thieves Fort

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Lay down your swords. Surrender and we'll spare you.
outro.title: Thieves Fort

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Realizing that she can't win, Miluda and her men gives up.
outro.title: Thieves Fort

outro.speaker: Miluda
outro.text: Go ahead, kill us then. We're just animals-Kill us!
outro.title: Thieves Fort

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: You hate us that much...?
outro.title: Thieves Fort

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Ramza Kill her, now! She's your enemy! An enemy of the Beoulves! Understand? Your enemy! She's a loser. Who's lost sight of life! Losers cannot remain alive! If we don't kill her, she'll kill us! We can't coexist! Kill her, Ramza! With your own hands!!
outro.title: Thieves Fort

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Ramza, I don't see why she's our enemy...
outro.title: Thieves Fort

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: What did you say? Are you mad, Delita?
outro.title: Thieves Fort

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: She's not an animal...... She's human just like us...
outro.title: Thieves Fort

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Are you betraying us!? You, too....!?
outro.title: Thieves Fort

outro.speaker: Miluda
outro.text: Oh, sympathy is it? Despicable creatures. You're my enemy as long as you belong to the Beoulves. Don't forget it......
outro.title: Thieves Fort

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Miluda disappears into the shadows, holding her wounds.
outro.title: Thieves Fort

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Delita...., we are ......?
outro.title: Thieves Fort

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Geez, what's wrong with you?
outro.title: Thieves Fort

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Meanwhile, at Igros, capital of Gallione, 'Beoulve castle'
outro.title: Thieves Fort

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The Pirates attacks the Beoulve mansion. Knowing the majority of the troops were out killing Death Corps. The Corps objective was to kill Dycedarg, a major influence on Larg. The attack was going smoothly when Zalbag arrives and spoils the plan.
outro.title: Thieves Fort

outro.speaker: Teta
outro.text: Let go! Stop it, let go of me!!
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: A thief riding a chocobo leaves off with Teta.
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Golagros
outro.text: Hurry up!
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Another thief comes out of the castle holding Alma's hand.
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: Ouch! Let go of my hand! Brother!!
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Zalbag comes in rushing from inside the castle and kills the thief with a single blow using his sword.
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Golagros
outro.text: Damn... That's it!!
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The knight flees away with his chocobo.
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Are you all right, Alma?
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: I'm OK, but Teta isn't.
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Yes, I know.
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Dycedarg comes out holding his wound. Alma helps the wounded Dycedarg.
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Brother!!
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: I, I'm all right...... What about ...Alma....?
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: Yes. I'm fine. What an awful wound....
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: I never thought they'd come here. They're after me.
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Five people were killed, and Teta was kidnapped.
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: After them....Leave no stone unturned until you find them.
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: Please don't talk anymore!
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Death Corps......bastard.
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Dycedarg faints.
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: Are you all right!?
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Hey! Anybody there!?
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The troop comes to Igros and finds out what has happened.
outro.title: Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Injured from the Death Corps attack, Dycedarg lay in his bed.
outro.title: Inside Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: I heard you destroyed the enemies' hideout...Good job. Leave the rest to Zalbag and relax for a while... No need to worry.... It's not that bad of a wound.
outro.title: Inside Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Teta.... What about Teta....?
outro.title: Inside Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: As soon as we find their base, Zalbag will attack in force.
outro.title: Inside Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: W, What...!?
outro.title: Inside Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Death Corps is falling apart. Deserters are down to a few. Wiegraf will be caught... It's just a matter of time.
outro.title: Inside Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Teta.... Are you deserting Teta?
outro.title: Inside Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Don't worry. Everything's all planned. We won't attack until Teta's returned. For certain. I'd never abandon Teta. She's like a sister to me.
outro.title: Inside Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: - Outside of Beoulve castle - [Delita goes outraged over his kidnapped sister. Ramza tries to stop Delita.
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Wait, Delita. Where are you going? Just calm down!
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Calm down? Are you kidding? I can't calm down!
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: You don't know where she is! Don't waste your time!
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita pulls up Ramza by his shirt.
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Waste my time!? She is my only sister!!
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Remember, Dycedarg said... He'd never abandon Teta... So....don't .... Ugh...I...can't breath.
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita puts Ramza down.
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: I'm sorry, Ramza. Are you all right....?
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Y... yeah.......cough...cough...
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Algus comes out from the castle.
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Never believe in "never".
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: You mean my brother's lying?
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: If I were him, I'd never save a common girl.
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: What did you say......?
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: I said I won't send troops to save you, commoners!!
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: How dare you!!
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita punches Algus on the face. Algus goes off flying. He holds his cheek after falling on the ground. Ramza holds Delita's arms.
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Stop it! Delita!
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Let go of me! Damn you! Let go!!
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Heh! Commoners are all alike. You'll never be nobles! Delita, You don't belong here! Understand, rascal!?
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Damn you!!
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Enough! Delita! And you, too, Algus!
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Algus stands up.
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Ramza, don't you see? He's not one of us. You see, Ramza, we nobles can't live with them.
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Lies! He's my good friend. We're like brothers!
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: That's exactly the point. Don't act like friends. You are the son of a distinguished family. You cannot be with him. I'm sure your brothers would agree with me!
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita pushes Ramza aside.
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Not all nobles are like you! I trust Ramza!
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita leaves.
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Get lost! I never want to see you again!!
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Don't say that. We're friends, aren't we?
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza being serious, steps forward.
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: I won't say it again! Get lost!!
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Algus walks off and stops.
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Their base is at Fort Zeakden. I heard it from your brother. There are several cordons, so you can't attack them from the front, of course. The only way is to attack from the rear. Well...do your best, you spoiled-rotten boy.
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Get out!!
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Algus leaves. The party heads for Fort Zeakden. While heading for Fort Zeakden, in a sunset field, Delita and Ramza stops.
outro.title: Outside of Beoulve castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Beautiful. Somewhere Teta's watching the same sunset.
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: ....Don't worry, Delita. I'm sure she is OK.
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: ....I've felt out of place for a long time.
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Are you thinking about what Algus said?
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: I guess there are things you can't change, no matter what.
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Don't say that. If you put effort into it...
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Could I be a general if I tried hard enough? I want to rescue Teta on my own, but I can't do a thing. I'm 'useless'....
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita picks up a reed.
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Remember how father taught us to play that reed flute?
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita begins to play the reed flute. Ramza picks up a reed. The two plays the reed flute, a skill they learned from Balbanes.
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers

Since his collapse | | during Orinas' birthday celebration, we've been told that | | he was on his way to recovery, but the discouraged faces | | of his close advisors tell otherwise.
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: With an official | | guardian for the Prince yet to be named, the Queen is | | certain to clash with the elder statesmen over his | | guardianship. | | Destruction of the Death Corps!? | | It was revealed that the main group in the Death Corps the | | Thieves, were close to annihilation due to the joint | | effort by the four groups of the Knights.
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: According to | | official reports, the total number of thieves apprehended | | by the plan added up to approximately 700, and the death | | toll was approximately 3000. Wiegraf, the leader of the | | Death Corps is yet to be apprehended, but the Hokuten | | stated that it was just a matter of time.
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: | | Attempt murder of Lord Dycedarg | | The Thieves, major players in the Death Corps, are close | | to annihilation, but the Knights haven't been able to | | capture their leader, Wiegraf, yet. Although the Hokuten | | are in pursuit of the remaining members. An assault on a | | high official occurred at the mansion of the well-known | | and respected Beoulve family. The target seems to have | | been Prince Larg's assistant, Dycedarg.
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Unfortunately, the | | assassination attempt was unsuccessful. | I------------------------------------------------------------I ```
outro.title: Mandalia Plains

banter.speaker: Miluda
banter.text: Who do you think you are!? We're not animals! We're human, just like you! There's no difference among us other than our families! You ever been hungry? With only soup to eat for months? Why do we have to suffer? Because you nobles deprive us our right to live!
banter.title: Thieves Fort

banter.speaker: Algus
banter.text: Human? Hmph, ridiculous! From the minute you were born you had to obey us! From the second you were born you were our animals!!
banter.title: Thieves Fort

banter.speaker: Miluda
banter.text: Says who!? That's nonsense! Who decided all this?!
banter.title: Thieves Fort

banter.speaker: Algus
banter.text: It's the Will of Heaven!
banter.title: Thieves Fort

banter.speaker: Miluda
banter.text: Heaven? God would never say such things! In his eyes, all are equal! He'd never let this happen! Never!
banter.title: Thieves Fort

banter.speaker: Algus
banter.text: Animals have no God!!
banter.title: Thieves Fort

banter.speaker: Delita
banter.text: Ramza, Is she really our enemy....?
banter.title: Thieves Fort

missions.brief: Thieves’ Fort · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: No road home

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The party arrives at Lenalia Plateau and meets with Miluda and her troops again.
intro.title: Lenalia Plateau

intro.speaker: Miluda
intro.text: It's blocked here, too... There is no way out.
intro.title: Lenalia Plateau

intro.speaker: Death Corps Soldier
intro.text: Forget it. We might as well surrender....
intro.title: Lenalia Plateau

intro.speaker: Miluda
intro.text: I'd rather die here than get taken prisoner!! Besides, if we get caught here, we'll be executed! Fighting is the only way out!
intro.title: Lenalia Plateau

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Where is Wiegraf?! Where did you hide Teta!?
intro.title: Lenalia Plateau

intro.speaker: Miluda
intro.text: Teta? You mean that Beoulve, Golagros took hostage?
intro.title: Lenalia Plateau

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Teta's my sister! She has nothing to do with them! It's pointless to hold her hostage! Please, return my sister!
intro.title: Lenalia Plateau

intro.speaker: Miluda
intro.text: And what about you? Will you Nobles give back all you took from us? We're only asking you to return what you took from us in the first place. But no-you just keep taking! Forcing us to retaliate! Just give up! There's no reason to return her!!
intro.title: Lenalia Plateau

outro.speaker: Miluda
outro.text: B...Brother... I'm sorry...
outro.title: Lenalia Plateau

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Miluda dies.
outro.title: Lenalia Plateau

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Why...? What went wrong?
outro.title: Lenalia Plateau

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Damn it, who the hell am I? Who...?
outro.title: Lenalia Plateau

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: In a small windmill at Fovoham, Golagros and Wiegraf, hid from the Hokuten.
outro.title: Lenalia Plateau

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: Why did you kidnap the girl?
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: Golagros
outro.text: I needed a hostage to escape.
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: If that was the case, you could've let her go later. What....now you, Golagros?
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: Golagros
outro.text: You putting me with Gustav? Think. The Death Corps lost most of their men and now are surrounded by the Hokuten. She was our only ace in the hole to get us out of this. Because she's a Beoulve.
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Wiegraf and Golagros looks at Teta.
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: What good is escaping? Or were you even thinking that? Even if we do escape, we'll get caught sooner or later and be in their power! We must make it so our children don't have to go through what we did. A small stone may only make a small ripple at first, but someday it will be a wave. Even if we have to rust away here!
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: Golagros
outro.text: So you would have us die?
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: Not in vain. Take as many Nobles with you as possible!
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: Golagros
outro.text: Ludicrous! We'll die like dogs!!
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: No, there may be still be survivors at Fort Zeakden. If you join them, you may get something!
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: Golagros
outro.text: They're probably dead already...
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: A soldier comes inside and informs Wiegraf about Miluda's death.
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: What!? Miluda killed?! Miluda....
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: Soldier
outro.text: It's a just a matter of time before the squad gets here. What should we do?
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: Alright. Retreat!! You heard, Golagros. Go to Fort Zeakden. Leave the girl here!
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: Voice of a guard
outro.text: They're here!! The Hokuten are here!
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The soldier rushes out.
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: Damn! Already? I'll stop them here! Golagros, you head for Fort Zeakden with others!
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Wiegraf walks out.
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: Golagros
outro.text: I'm not going... Now way I'm going to die!
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Golagros looks at Teta.
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

banter.speaker: Miluda
banter.text: I can't die now! Not during the revolution! I'm a Death Corps soldier!! I'll never run away!!
banter.title: Lenalia Plateau

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: Put the sword away, Miluda! No use fighting any longer! Let's put down our swords, stop fighting, and talk! There must be a solution to all this! Let's find it! I'll talk to my brother! No, I'll talk to Lord Larg! Trust me!!
banter.title: Lenalia Plateau

banter.speaker: Miluda
banter.text: No more tricky smooth talk! I'm sick of your lies!!
banter.title: Lenalia Plateau

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: I'm not lying!! You say revolution......... Is a revolution necessary? Is it our fault? Are we making you suffer? What's the problem?
banter.title: Lenalia Plateau

banter.speaker: Miluda
banter.text: Ignorance itself is a crime! What you think is right is only what you can see. But, that's not everything. It's not your fault. But I'll keep blaming you until there's a change! As long as you're a Beoulve, you're my enemy!
banter.title: Lenalia Plateau

missions.brief: Lenalia · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: The windmill at Fovoham

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The squad arrives. They find Wiegraf waiting for them.
intro.title: Windmill Shed

intro.speaker: Wiegraf
intro.text: You...it was you... Did you kill Miluda? It was you cadets who killed my sister!
intro.title: Windmill Shed

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: She was Wiegraf's sister?
intro.title: Windmill Shed

intro.speaker: Wiegraf
intro.text: Well then, I have no choice. I'll avenge my sister!!
intro.title: Windmill Shed

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Give Teta back!!
intro.title: Windmill Shed

intro.speaker: Wiegraf
intro.text: Teta? Oh, that girl? So you're a Beoulve?
intro.title: Windmill Shed

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: He's not a Beoulve! I am!
intro.title: Windmill Shed

intro.speaker: Wiegraf
intro.text: Then Golagros was wrong. But he is with you, correct?
intro.title: Windmill Shed

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: It doesn't matter who he is. You have his sister.
intro.title: Windmill Shed

intro.speaker: Wiegraf
intro.text: Correct me if I'm wrong... Either way, the girl was to be released anyway. We had no intention of keeping her. But first things first! If you want the girl back, you'll have to beat me!!
intro.title: Windmill Shed

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: Hmph-tough one, eh? Miluda, I'm sorry! But I can't die here!
outro.title: Windmill Shed

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Wait, Wiegraf! Running away?
outro.title: Windmill Shed

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: Who do you think had Gustav kidnap the Marquis? Your brother, Dycedarg! And I'm sure Zalbag knows, too!
outro.title: Windmill Shed

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Don't be ridiculous! Why would he do such a thing?
outro.title: Windmill Shed

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: Two lions are fighting for power after the king died! One is white lion, Larg. The other is black, Goltana. Both want to know who their allies are. But, it's hard to read strangers' minds. So, why not kill 'em all and bring in your own people? Gustav was deceived by Dycedarg's silk tongue and kidnapped the Marquis!
outro.title: Windmill Shed

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Lies!! A Beoulve would never do such a thing!
outro.title: Windmill Shed

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: You should see for yourself! Goodbye Beoulve!
outro.title: Windmill Shed

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Wiegraf vanishes.
outro.title: Windmill Shed

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Wait, Wiegraf!! Take that back!!
outro.title: Windmill Shed

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Teta! Where are you? Teta!
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita and Ramza comes in looking for Teta.
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: I can't find her anywhere! Teta! Where are you!?
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: No sign of Teta.
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Did Wiegraf lie to us!? Delita, let's go to Zeakden! Teta must be there.
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: What happened? What went wrong? Tell me, Ramza. Why did this have to happen to Teta?
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita falls down on his knee.
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Delita...
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The remaining Death Corps members retreated to a snowy Fort Zeakden, only to find themselves trapped by the Hokuten. Golagros holds Teta as a shield.
outro.title: In a Small Windmill

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: Put the sword down! No need to waste lives!
banter.title: Windmill Shed

banter.speaker: Wiegraf
banter.text: Then, why did you kill her? Why Miluda?
banter.title: Windmill Shed

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: I had no intention of killing her! There are other ways than fighting. Can we talk?
banter.title: Windmill Shed

banter.speaker: Wiegraf
banter.text: You still don't understand why we won't surrender! What good is talking anyway? Could you make something happen even if you wanted to? You couldn't, could you? And even if you did, your brothers wouldn't allow it!!
banter.title: Windmill Shed

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: My brothers don't want to fight!! Wiegraf, if you put the sword down, they'll listen!
banter.title: Windmill Shed

banter.speaker: Wiegraf
banter.text: HA! This's absurd! Your brothers don't want to fight? You're so deluded!
banter.title: Windmill Shed

missions.brief: Fovoham · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: The price of a name

intro.speaker: Golagros
intro.text: Get out of here now! What if something happens to her? And don't do anything funny! There's tons of powder inside the fort! More than enough to blow all of you to hell and back! Got it? Then, get out!
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: Zalbag
intro.text: The Hokuten will never be threatened by you!!
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza and Delita finally arrives at the scene.
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Brother! Algus!!
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Delita sees Teta.
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Teta!!
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: Teta
intro.text: Delita!!
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: Golagros
intro.text: Get out! Now!!
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: Zalbag
intro.text: Go on, do it!
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: Algus
intro.text: Yes, sir!
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Algus aims and shoots at Teta.
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: Golagros
intro.text: What's this?
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Algus shoots again. This time at Golagros, wounding him.
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Teta!!
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: A Hokuten knight appears from the shadow behind Zalbag.
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: Hokuten Knight
intro.text: General Zalbag, more enemies are on the mountain path! There are about 50 of them. I've been informed one of them resembles Wiegraf!
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: Zalbag
intro.text: Alright, I'll be right there. Take care of the rest, Algus.
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: Golagros
intro.text: D...damn it!
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Golagros locks himself inside the fort.
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Teta!
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: Algus
intro.text: Where are you going?
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Algus! You bastard!!
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: Algus
intro.text: You want to fight? Fine then, let's go!
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Brother...why...Teta...?
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

intro.speaker: Algus
intro.text: C'mon! Animals are animals! I'll prove it to you!!
intro.title: Fort Zeakden

outro.speaker: Algus
outro.text: Damn you...How could I be beaten by weaklings like you?
outro.title: Fort Zeakden

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita pushes his sword more deeper into Algus's body and then pulls out his sword. Algus dies miserably. His men realizing their leader is dead, vanishes. After the battle, Delita walks over to his sister, Teta, and holds her.
outro.title: Fort Zeakden

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: ..Delita.
outro.title: Fort Zeakden

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The dying Golagros ignites the fort's powder stores.
outro.title: Fort Zeakden

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: What was that!? An explosion?? Delita, it's dangerous! Come over here, quick!!
outro.title: Fort Zeakden

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita doesn't move an inch. The base blows knocking Ramza. Ramza stands up.
outro.title: Fort Zeakden

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Delita!!
outro.title: Fort Zeakden

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The base completely gets destroyed by the explosion.
outro.title: Fort Zeakden

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: I've taken my whole life for granted. When it came down to it I dropped it all and ran.
outro.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: Why, why are you doing this? Algus, why!?
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Algus
banter.text: It's your brother's orders. Please don't ask why. Besides, would you sacrifice the Hokuten pride, all for a common girl!?
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Ramza
