banter.text: Teta is Delita's sister!!
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Algus
banter.text: It's about time you learned about 'difference'! Different birth, totally different life! It's fate! Neither should've been here! Should've been flower sellers somewhere! And what about you, Ramza? Why are you arguing with me? You're a traitor to Hokuten!
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: B...but, but, this is inexcusable!
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Algus
banter.text: You're such a spoiled child! How could someone like you be a Beoulve?
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: I didn't have a choice!!
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Algus
banter.text: You're such a baby! Don't pamper yourself!! Beoulves are leaders of warriors. You have certain responsibilities as a leader! There are many things that only you can do! You must do them for those who can't!
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: I don't want to live life just being used by others!!
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Algus
banter.text: Just being used? Don't talk rubbish!! Beoulves are used because of who they are! We ourselves have survived under their wing, used their protection! That's right. It's a give and take relationship! That's how you survived! Just being used? You've been using your "best friend", Delita!
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: Me? Using Delita? Are you all right, Delita?
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Delita
banter.text: Leave me, Ramza! After Algus, you're next!
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: Delita...
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Algus
banter.text: As a Beoulve, surely you know our mission!? Your mission took precedence even when I was attacked on Mandalia Plains!!
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: Gmph!!
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Algus
banter.text: You saved me to use me.
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: Ridiculous! I couldn't just leave someone in trouble!
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Algus
banter.text: Well next time you'd better! You never know if they'll be friendly or not!
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Delita
banter.text: Algus! You murdered Teta! I'll kill you! I swear it!
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Algus
banter.text: Angry, Delita? Angry because you're so utterly helpless? Know your limits! Commoners don't have power to change things! That's right, get angry! It's all you can do! Ha, ha, you deserve it!!
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Delita
banter.text: Is that it? Is that all, Algus?!
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Algus
banter.text: Don't be mad, Delita. You'll join her soon!
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

banter.speaker: Delita
banter.text: You won't confuse me! Nobody uses me!!
banter.title: Fort Zeakden

missions.brief: Zeakden · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Return to the stone city

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: so, Ramza you know who kidnapped her?
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Agrias steps out of the monastery.
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: He's taking Princess Ovelia with him. Can't be that far.
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: Are you going after him?
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: Of course! I couldn't face the royal family unless I do!
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: We won't help you. It's not in the contract!
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: We don't need help from one who's not even a knight! A knight must fix his won mistakes. This is one of our responsibilities as guards! Lavian, Alice, let's go!
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Simon, the priest comes out.
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: Are you all right, Milord?
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Simon
intro.text: The Princess...how is she?
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Agrias shakes her head.
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: I'm very sorry. I swear I'll get her back!
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Simon
intro.text: ....No. You'd be in danger...
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: Don't worry. I swear on my knight's honor I'll save her!
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza steps forward.
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: I'll go, too! I won't be a burden!
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: Are you crazy?! This's none of your business!
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: I have to know! I must see it with my own eyes!
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: You mean, that boy you saw?
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza nods.
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: You're stubborn as a mule. Don't cry to me for help if something happens!
intro.title: Outside of Orbonne Monastery

intro.speaker: Chapter 2
intro.text: THE MANIPULATER AND THE SUBSERVIENT
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: ```text I------------------------------------------------------------I |-- =-=-= =-= =-=-= =-= =-=- NEWS -=-= =-= =-=-= =-= =-=-= --| | After the king's death | | After the death of King Omdolia, Queen Ruvelia held the | | reigns of the government. Any officials objecting her | | policies were ousted, even elder statesmen. The Empress | | openly criticized the Queen, and was banished to Bunahan, | | never to return.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: It is said she was poisoned, but no proof | | was ever found. | | Feud between Larg and Goltana | | A political struggle erupted between the Prince Larg and | | the son of the late King. They are fighting for the | | regency, who will be guardian to the Prince. The Queen | | sided with Larg, but the officials who oppose her, | | including many Nobles, sided with Goltana.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Lately, some | | say Prince Larg will officially be appointed Regent. | | Peasant riot in Zeltennia | | A large peasant rebellion has erupted in Zeltennia, | | Goltana's territory. It was caused by the heavy damage | | resulting from the previous years drought, as well as | | growing unease over the rise in taxes after the War. A | | group of ex-Knights, known as the "Ryomoku" seemed to be | | behind the rebellion.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Baron Grims' Black Sheep are | | struggling to suppress it. | I------------------------------------------------------------I ```
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Rad, Alicia, and Lavian joins. The party heads to Dorter.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: Knight
intro.text: How about 500 gil per head?
intro.title: Dorter Trade City

intro.speaker: Mercenary
intro.text: Way too low. 2000. It's 2000 gil a head.
intro.title: Dorter Trade City

intro.speaker: Knight
intro.text: It would be easy to make all of you heretics, you know.
intro.title: Dorter Trade City

intro.speaker: Mercenary
intro.text: Is that a threat? ...How about 1000 gil?
intro.title: Dorter Trade City

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The knight shakes his head.
intro.title: Dorter Trade City

intro.speaker: Knight
intro.text: 700. No more.
intro.title: Dorter Trade City

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The mercenary thinks.
intro.title: Dorter Trade City

intro.speaker: Mercenary
intro.text: OK. Done deal.
intro.title: Dorter Trade City

intro.speaker: Knight
intro.text: They'll be here any minute. Kill all of them. Understand?
intro.title: Dorter Trade City

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The party arrives at Dorter.
intro.title: Dorter Trade City

intro.speaker: Knight
intro.text: Ha, speak of the devil...... There they are. Get them!
intro.title: Dorter Trade City

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The knight quickly disappears into the shadows. The mercenary looks at the party.
intro.title: Dorter Trade City

intro.speaker: Mercenary
intro.text: That's Gafgarion! Damn! 700 was too cheap!
intro.title: Dorter Trade City

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The mercenary throws his hat and whistles, calling his other mates.
intro.title: Dorter Trade City

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: Ambush? Going all out, huh?
intro.title: Dorter Trade City

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: If you don't like it, you can leave!
intro.title: Dorter Trade City

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: I usually don't do freebies, but I'll make an exception!
intro.title: Dorter Trade City

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: You patronizing...
intro.title: Dorter Trade City

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: There's no time to waste. We must hurry and rescue the Princess!
outro.title: Dorter Trade City

outro.speaker: Gafgarion
outro.text: Where are we going? Do you know where they went?
outro.title: Dorter Trade City

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: There is only one place they could've escaped to! Impregnable fortress... Bethla Garrison.
outro.title: Dorter Trade City

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Bethla Garrison...
outro.title: Dorter Trade City

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: On their way to Bethla Garisson..... Araguay Woods.
outro.title: Dorter Trade City

missions.brief: Dorter · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Boco among the goblins

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: A chocobo had accidentally wandered inside the goblin's forest. Six Goblins surrounds the poor chocobo.
intro.title: Araguay Woods

intro.speaker: Black Goblin
intro.text: Gob, gob! Gobgobgob!!
intro.title: Araguay Woods

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The goblins closes in at the chocobo.
intro.title: Araguay Woods

intro.speaker: Chocobo
intro.text: W-Wark!!
intro.title: Araguay Woods

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The party arrives.
intro.title: Araguay Woods

intro.speaker: Goblin
intro.text: Gob, gobu--!!
intro.title: Araguay Woods

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: A Chocobo? In this forest?
intro.title: Araguay Woods

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: Must be pretty stupid to wander into Goblin's forest!
intro.title: Araguay Woods

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: We can't waste time here. We must get out of this forest....
intro.title: Araguay Woods

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: Right. We shouldn't do anything that doesn't make money.
intro.title: Araguay Woods

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: Sorry, Chocobo... We must save the Princess first. Forgive me.
intro.title: Araguay Woods

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Delita said wild Chocobos are stronger than tame ones. I wonder if he's strong in a fight?
intro.title: Araguay Woods

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: You want to help him, Ramza? No money in that!
intro.title: Araguay Woods

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: He may help us save the Princess...
intro.title: Araguay Woods

outro.speaker: Chocobo
outro.text: W-Wark!!
outro.title: Araguay Woods

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: You seem alright.
outro.title: Araguay Woods

outro.speaker: Gafgarion
outro.text: You're lucky. You ought to thank Ramza.
outro.title: Araguay Woods

missions.brief: Araguay · Protect Boco.

missions.name: The waterfall crossing

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The Chocobo joins the party. Upon their arrival at Zirekile Falls, the party sees Ovelia and Delita on a bridge surrounded by some Hokuten Knights.
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Hokuten Knight
intro.text: It's over! Surrender! Turn the Princess over to us and we'll spare your life!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: That's a bald faced lie! You want to kill her! Then after that you'll kill me for knowing the truth!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Knight
intro.text: Ridiculous! We came to help the Princess! Why would we want to kill her? We can't let Goltana keep her!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: Princess Ovelia!!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.text: Agrias!!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Knight
intro.text: Great, here comes a crowd! Gafgarion! Kill them!! And do it now!!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: Don't know what's going on, but it's in the contract!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: Gafgarion, are you betraying us?
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: Betraying you? C'mon, this is business. Our job is to kidnap the Princess 'unharmed'. The job is to kill you all and keep things quiet!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: What are you getting at? This kidnapping's a sham?
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: The Princess is in the way! The Princess should be next in line. If she's alive there'll be nothing but trouble!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Delita hides the princess behind him.
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Since you're going to die, I'll let you help me... If the Princess's kidnapped and killed by Goltana, they'll be rid of her and his rivals. I'm sure that's how Prince Larg wrote the scenario. No, Dycedarg probably wrote it. Don't you agree, Ramza?
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Gafgarion steps forward.
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: Right, Ramza. Let's get them all!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Another helpless sacrifice... No more! There must not be any more victims like Teta!!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: Princess Ovelia! We'll save you!!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: I don't think so!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: Are you sure of what you're doing? The Princess may be adopted but she's still royalty.
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: I'm quite sure! Even Princesses can die for getting in the way! That's what 'royal blood' is about!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: Are you mocking the Pricness!?
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: Get in the way, get killed. It's the same for commoners! The only difference is people like you pledging blind loyalty! Unless you make it to the top you're only gonna be used so you're better off dead!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: Then, I'll save her!!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Delita! You're alive!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Imagine meeting you here! Are your brothers still running your life?
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Who knows? They never tell me anything? But uh, Delita, are you party to their plot?
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Don't be foolish! I'm here to save the Princess to free her from those who are exploiting her!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: Don't lie to me! You were hired too, weren't you? You were hired to kidnap her for money! Don't play dumb!!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: No, I'm not like you. It's not for the money!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: Then, who's getting in my way? A kid who heard the plan, and decided to save her for justice!? Who hired you? Who told you about the plan? Talk!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: None of your business!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.text: What are you? Ally or enemy?
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Human, just like you!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Did you know about this!? Why, such a dirty trick!?
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: Dirty!? There is no 'dirty' when it comes to money. I'm a mercenary. I have to finish the jobs I take. That's called being a pro!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Why didn't you tell me? Why?
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: If I'd told you, would you have stopped me? If I don't do this, someone else will! Get it? People die all the time without you knowing about it! That's reality! You think you can stop something you know nothing about?
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: But......but Does that make it right?
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: No 'buts'! You're just a child who doesn't want to face reality! If you don't like it, try living without depending on someone else for a change! But don't come complaining to me if you can't!
intro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Leave the Princess with me. It's better for her.
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Agrias blocks Ovelia behind her back.
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Delita, what're you scheming?
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Scheming? Don't be foolish. I'm telling the truth. Think about it. Where would you take her after making an enemy of Hokuten? Crack Hokuten troops will come here looking for you any time now. Just where the hell do you plan on escaping to?
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: W, well, I...
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Think carefully. The Princess knows this was Prince Larg's plan. The royal family is not on your side. So what about Goltana? No, he'd execute you just to clear himself.
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: What would you do?
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: I'd do what you can't do.
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: What do you mean?
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: I can't tell you...
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita turns around.
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: I'll leave the Princess with you a little longer.
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita starts to walk away.
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Delita, I'm glad I could see you again.
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita looks down and then up.
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Teta saved me...
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: What?
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Teta saved me back then...
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita walks off. Ovelia steps forward.
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: Thank you, Delita.
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: See you again, Ramza.
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita disappears into the shadows.
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: Ramza, thanks for your support. But are you sure you want to make Hokuten an enemy?
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Don't worry. I've already decided. The question is, now what should we do? Like Delita said, nobody will help us...
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: We can ask Cardinal Draclau for help...... Glabados church has jurisdiction over Lionel. They might be able to help.
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Hokuten has to be careful what they do in Lionel.... Let's go. It's the only place for us.
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: ```text I------------------------------------------------------------I |-- =-=-= =-= =-=-= =-= =-=- NEWS -=-= =-= =-=-= =-= =-=-= --| | Kidnap of the Princess | | Princess Ovelia has been abducted from the Orbonne | | Monastery. Witnesses say the Knight that disappeared had a | | crest of a Black Lion, believed to be those of the Nanten, | | under Prince Goltana. Goltana strongly denies any | | involvement.
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: He assembled a group of investigators to | | clear any suspicion, but due to the attempted supression | | of the rebellion in Zeltennia, it seems difficult. | I------------------------------------------------------------I ```
outro.title: Zirekile Falls

banter.speaker: Gafgarion
banter.text: Dammit!
banter.title: Zirekile Falls

missions.brief: Zirekile · Protect Ovelia.

missions.name: A machinist in flight

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: A man is being chased by the Bart Trading Company in Zaland Fort City.
intro.title: Zaland Fort City

intro.speaker: Fencer
intro.text: You can't escape! Give it to us if you value your life!
intro.title: Zaland Fort City

intro.speaker: Young man
intro.text: What do you want? I don't know what you're talking about.
intro.title: Zaland Fort City

intro.speaker: Fencer
intro.text: Don't play dumb! Mustadio! Don't care about your father? Just give us the 'holy stone' and we'll return him....OK guys, get him!
intro.title: Zaland Fort City

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The man jumps up on top of the fort.
intro.title: Zaland Fort City

intro.speaker: Young man 'Mustadio'
intro.text: And you can tell Rudvich... If he lays a hand on father he'll never see the stone!
intro.title: Zaland Fort City

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The party comes at Zaland on their way to Lionel.
intro.title: Zaland Fort City

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: An argument! Someone's after that young man...
intro.title: Zaland Fort City

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: I don't want to be involved, but I can't just leave him. I'll help him!
intro.title: Zaland Fort City

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: He'll be killed, if we don't do something! Let's help!
intro.title: Zaland Fort City

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Are you all right?
outro.title: Zaland Fort City

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: Yeah.......I think so. Thanks for helping me.
outro.title: Zaland Fort City

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: They were Troublemakers hired by Bart Company.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: Bart Company? The Importer?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: You know them? They're not just traders. They're a criminal syndicate into everything from smuggling and slavery.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Why were they after you?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: You know why they call us mechanics?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza shakes his head.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: I hear a 'lost civilization' is hidden under Goug.... When St. Ajora was alive, airships were in the sky, and human robots in town. But time passed, technology was lost, and no one knows if it ever really existed.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: But the civilization must have existed. Parts from many airships and machines are buried under Goug. Mechanics are the ones who restore the 'past legacies'.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: That weird thing you used in the battle, was that one of the machines?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: Oh, this?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Mustadio brings out his weapon.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: This is called a 'gun'. A metal 'bullet' is propelled by gunpowder. This is the most simple one. They say you used to be able put magic in it and shoot it.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Hmm...
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: Why's Bart Company after you?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: You said you were going to see the Cardinal. He was a hero of the Fifty Year War. People in Lionel still think of him as a hero. My father, too. The Cardinal is the only one who can unite this country. I know he'd grant your wish. Then the princess would be safe.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: Yeah, and...?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: Can you take me with you? I want to meet the Cardinal.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: Why?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: To save my father! The Cardinal's the only one who can rescue him from Bart! But he wouldn't want to meet some mechanics like myself. So, please. Take me with you!
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: You still hasn't told us why they're after you!
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Mustadio looks down.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: ...I can't tell you now.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: Then, we can't take you.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: I beg you! Trust me! I must see the Cardinal!
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The princess enters the room. Ramza and Agrias kneels down.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: All right. You can come with us.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: Really? Thank you, Highness!
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: Remember! You're in the presence of a princess!
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Mustadio kneels down.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: It's all right. Please stand up.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The three stands up.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: All right, then. I trust you.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ovelia and the others rests on their way to Lionel Castle.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: Princess Ovelia, see? Lionel Castle is over the mountain.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: It's still far from this fort. I wonder if Cardinal Draclau will really help us?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: I hear the Cardinal is very loyal to the royal family. And right now, he's neutral in the dispute between Prince Larg and Prince Goltana. I'm sure he wouldn't defeat justice by turning you over to either one of them.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: I hope so......
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ovelia walks up to a tree and picks up a leaf.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: Besides, he is a man of popularity at Glabados Church. They'll accept you if the Cardinal asks them.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: I wish I weren't a princess.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ovelia drops the leaf.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: Princess Ovelia......
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza eavesdrops.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: I was always surrounded by the convent walls...and have only seen the sky through them. I don't think you know, but I was at another monastery before I went to Orbonne. Even after hearing about the adoption by the deceased king, I stayed there for a long time. No, I'm not complaining about that. Just......... People are dying because I'm the princess. It's so painful......
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: Please don't blame yourself. It's not your fault. Those who are trying to take advantage of you are the ones to blame.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ovelia takes another leaf from the tree and drops it.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: I met a girl at Orbonne. She said she had also been living in the monastery since birth. We used to laugh at how similar our lives have been. ----Isn't it funny?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The princess takes another leaf and drops it.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: She was the daughter of the Beoulves, Miss. Alma, wasn't she?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: She is my only friend...... I wonder if Cardinal Draclau would use me?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Voice of Mustadio
outro.text: Ramza! Where are you? Shall we go?!
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Mustadio comes out.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: What have you been doing here?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: How was it?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: Fine. It doesn't seem like Hokuten has been here yet.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ovelia tries to play the reed flute.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: My friend taught me before, but I can't seem to do it right.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza walks over and takes a reed. He starts to show Ovelia how to play it.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: This is how you do it.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: Like this?
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ovelia also plays the reed flute.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: There! I did it.
outro.title: In a room

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: They both starts to play the reed flute. The party heads to Lionel but encounters some mercenaries on their way.
outro.title: In a room

missions.brief: Zaland · Protect Mustadio.

missions.name: The hill road

intro.speaker: Rudvich Mercenary
intro.text: I don't know who you are. But leave the boy with us! We don't want to fight! Hand Mustadio over and there won't be any trouble. OK?
intro.title: Bariaus Hill

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: Why don't you leave quietly! Tell Rudvich we'll fight anyone who tries to use war to sway the people!
intro.title: Bariaus Hill

intro.speaker: Mercenary
intro.text: Then I guess we must take him by force! Here goes!!
intro.title: Bariaus Hill

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Why are they after you? Will you explain?
outro.title: Bariaus Hill

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: Sorry... But I can't tell you now.
outro.title: Bariaus Hill

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Meanwhile at the office of Igros castle.
outro.title: Bariaus Hill

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Do anything to capture Ovelia. The same goes for Agrias and the others. Kill them!
outro.title: Office of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Gafgarion
outro.text: What about Ramza?
outro.title: Office of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Dycedarg takes a cup and pours a wine.
outro.title: Office of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: He's a disgrace to the name Beoulve, and he's in our way. I left him alone because I thought he'd learn how harsh the real world is. I never thought he was that dense.
outro.title: Office of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Gafgarion
outro.text: Did his strong sense of justice come from his father?
outro.title: Office of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: My father spoiled him. If he obeys orders, fine. If he resists, we have no choice...
outro.title: Office of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Dycedarg drinks the wine.
outro.title: Office of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Gafgarion
outro.text: It's hard to believe his own brother said that. Sickening. But what if the Cardinal gets in our way? With the church supporting him, even the Prince couldn't do anything easily.
outro.title: Office of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: I've already prepared for that. There's no need to worry.
outro.title: Office of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Gafgarion
outro.text: So that's that? The more I know, the worse you appear.
outro.title: Office of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: If that's how you feel, then you'd best watch your tongue. Don't forget your head can be easily cut off.
outro.title: Office of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Gafgarion
outro.text: Hey, stop that. I'm your loyal servant. Remember I'm not stubborn like your little brother.
outro.title: Office of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Then, don't make any mistakes.
outro.title: Office of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Gafgarion
outro.text: Speaking of that, who did you order to kidnap Ovelia? When I was chasing her in Dorter, someone attacked me. What was that about?
outro.title: Office of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Dycedarg looks out the window.
outro.title: Office of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: They found the criminals in the monastery woods- dead. Someone learned of our plan and is trying to stop us... Anyhow, as long as Ovelia is with Agrias, there'll be many chances to get her...
outro.title: Office of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Gafgarion
outro.text: I hope so.
outro.title: Office of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: After going for days and nights the party finally comes at the gate of Lionel Castle.
outro.title: Office of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Lionel Castle Knight
outro.text: Who are you? What do you want?
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: I'm Agrias Oaks of the Lesalia St. Konoe Knights. I came from Orbonne to save the son of God, St. Ajora. Open the gate!
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Knight
outro.text: Saving the St. Ajora is the will of the high priest. The gate will open for he who would save the high priest. Open the gate!
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The gate opens and the party enters the castle. The party meets the Cardinal.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Draclau
outro.text: I understand your situation, Agrias. Moreover, I'll send a man to the High Priest in Murond. We'll do something to expose Larg's scheme, and keep the Princess from danger.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: Will High Priest Funeral help us?
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Draclau
outro.text: Don't worry, Agrias. I'm with you. You must be strong to make the Princess feel at ease. Make yourselves comfortable in this old castle until word comes from the holy land.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: Thank you for your kindness.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Draclau
outro.text: St. Ajora is with us. There's no need to worry. Young mechanic. I heard your wish too. I'll send troops to Goug, to destroy Bart Company.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: Thank you.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Draclau
outro.text: But, would you explain why they're after you two?
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: I...can't...
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Draclau
outro.text: That's all right... Is this it?
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The Cardinal brings out a shiny red stone.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: What is that crystal?
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Draclau
outro.text: Have you ever heard of the 'Zodiac Brave Story'?
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: You mean that fairy tale, we used to hear in church?
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Draclau
outro.text: Here now! Are you saying the church lied?
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: N-no, I didn't mean that...
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: Long ago, when the land was much different, 12 brave warriors fought against the Evil Lucavi who ruled the land. After a desperate battle, they sent Lucavi to Hades, and the land was peaceful. They each had crystals with zodiac signs on them, they were called "Zodiac Braves". Ever since then, whenever humans are attacked, the Braves come to save us.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Draclau
outro.text: You're quite learned, Princess. Just as I expected.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: Mr. Simon taught me at the Orbonne Monastery. He also said St. Ajora and the Braves saved Ivalice from chaos.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Draclau
outro.text: We call the crystals, 'Holy Stones'. This very stone, is the legendary secret stone, the "Zodiac Stone".
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: I didn't think it really existed.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Draclau
outro.text: They say its 'Divine Power' surpasses Lucavi's. I feel strange power, but it looks just like an ordinary crystal to me.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: What's wrong, Mustadio? You look pale.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Draclau
outro.text: You saw the same stone underground Goug?
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: Many broken machine parts are buried there. But if the stone gets near the machines, they start to howl.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Draclau
outro.text: Bart Company's after the stone, right?
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: I don't know what power the stone has... But Rudvich wants to use its power to make weapons. My father told me never to give the stones to him. So they abducted him.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Draclau
outro.text: Don't worry, Mustadio. The church will see to his safety. While our men fight, we'll get the stone back.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: Y, yes, sir.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: I'll go to Goug with you.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: Thank you, Ramza.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: We made it this far thanks to you, Ramza.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: I wish I could've been more help. Please be careful.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: That's very thoughtful. Don't worry. We'll be fine.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: ```text I------------------------------------------------------------I |-- =-=-= =-= =-=-= =-= =-=- NEWS -=-= =-= =-=-= =-= =-=-= --| | Zodiac Brave Story | | Long before Ivalice was united, the land was divided into | | 7 kingdoms: Zeltennia, Fovoham, Lionel, Limberry, Lesalie, | | Gallione, and Murond.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Each tried to expand their territory | | and the struggles continued for hundreds of years, until | | an ambitious new King, was born in Murond. He gathered a | | great army from all over Ivalice and fought, but victory | | did not come easily. Then the King found a secret way to | | summon a Magic God from the netherworld. But when he tried | | to use its powers, the Magic God killed the King and tried | | to destroy the world...
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: 12 brave souls defeated the Devils | | summoned by the Magic God and sent him back to the | | netherworld. At this time, the 12 warriors were crested | | with 12 zodiac symbols, and people began to call them the | | "Zodiac Braves". | | Zodiac Stone | | Crystals said to be made in a mythic area. With a zodiac | | symbol carved on their surface, the crystal was known as | | the "Zodiac Stone of the 12 zodiac symbols".
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The stones | | are said to have holy powers used by the Zodiac Braves to | | work miracles. The last time they were seen was during St. | | Ajora's time, no one has seen them since... | | Bart Company's dark rumor | | Bart Trading Company, based in Warjilis, is increasing in | | popularity because it donates heavily to projects | | improving the infrastructure and orphanages. But they are | | not only known for their charity.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Some say they are a | | criminal outfit involved in opium smuggling, slavery and | | even murder. Who knows the real truth about this company? | I------------------------------------------------------------I ```
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: << Flashback >>
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Besrodio
outro.text: Listen, Mustadio. Take this and run!
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Besrodio gives a yellow shiny stone to Mustadio.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: Run? Where?
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Outside the room....
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Rudvich Mercenary
outro.text: I know you're in there! Open the door!!
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Mustadio holds his father's hand.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: Father! Let's get out of here!
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Besrodio
outro.text: My legs are useless! Just go on without me!!
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: I can't leave you alone!
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Besrodio
outro.text: The Holy stone has enough power to destroy a country! Can't let Rudvich get it! Hide it in a safe place! And ask Cardinal Draclau to help you! I know he will!
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Rudvich and his mercenary breaks inside the room.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Rudvich
outro.text: You've wasted enough time. Now, give me the stone!
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Besrodio
outro.text: Go now! Mustadio!!
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The mercenaries rushes in to catch Mustadio.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Besrodio
outro.text: Hurry!!
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Mustadio escapes.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Rudvich
outro.text: After him!! Get him!
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: << End of Flashback >>
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: After the tough fight with the monsters of Zigolis Swamp. The two finally comes to Goug Machine City.
outro.title: The Gate of Lionel Castle

missions.brief: Bariaus Hill · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: The poisoned marsh

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The road to Goug crosses Zigolis Swamp. The company must pass the marsh and its undead defenders.

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The company leaves the marsh and reaches Goug.

missions.brief: Zigolis · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: The stone in Goug

intro.speaker: Mustadio
intro.text: I don't see anyone from Bart Company. It doesn't even look like there was a fight.... Something's strange.... I'll check it out. See you later.
intro.title: Goug Machine City

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Where?
intro.title: Goug Machine City

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Mustadio points at the slums.
intro.title: Goug Machine City

intro.speaker: Mustadio
intro.text: The slums over there... they shouldn't attract attention.
intro.title: Goug Machine City

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: All right. Be careful.
intro.title: Goug Machine City

intro.speaker: Mustadio
intro.text: Right. Leave it to me.
intro.title: Goug Machine City

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Mustadio leaves to check things out. Night falls and Ramza arrives at the slums to meet Mustadio.
intro.title: Goug Machine City

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: He's late.... Too late.
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Rain starts to pour down.
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Think Mustadio was caught?
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Man's voice
intro.text: Are you his friend?
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Who are you!?
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Two female archer and a man comes out to greet Ramza.
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Ill-looking man
intro.text: Bring him!
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: A thief brings out the captured Mustadio.
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Mustadio
intro.text: S...Sorry, Ramza.
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Are you OK, Mustadio!!?
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza tries to free Mustadio.
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Man
intro.text: That's far enough. Don't move any closer!
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: So, you're Rudvich!! Let Mustadio go!!
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Rudvich
intro.text: Give me the "Holy Stone". Then you can have him back. [looks at Mustadio] C'mon! Where'd you hide it? Talk!
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Rudvich Won't talk, huh? Even after seeing this?
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The man gives the signal and another thief comes out holding Mustadio's father.
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Mustadio
intro.text: Father! Are you OK!?
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Besrodio
intro.text: I'm all right... Don't give him the 'Holy Stone'.
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Rudvich
intro.text: Put him in there!
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The thief shoves Besrodio into a room.
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Rudvich
intro.text: Ready to confess now?
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Mustadio looks down.
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Mustadio
intro.text: Inside the chimney... at Ramza's feet...
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Rudvich
intro.text: Well then, you pick it up! If you want to save his life!
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza gets the hidden holy stone from inside the chimney.
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: This...? Let them go!
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Rudvich
intro.text: First give me the stone!
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Let them go, first!!
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Rudvich
intro.text: Throw the stone! Then, we'll let them go!
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza throws the stone at Rudvich and frees Mustadio. The stone shines in Rudvich's hand.
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Rudvich
intro.text: The Zodiac Stone! Finally we've got it! The Cardinal'll be very pleased! Good job. I'm done now. You take care of the rest. Get rid of them!
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Rudvich disappears into the darkness with the stone.
intro.title: Slums

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Draclau was in on it, too?
intro.title: Slums

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: Will my father be all right?
outro.title: Slums

outro.speaker: Besrodio
outro.text: Don't worry about me.... They got the stone. Rudvich'll try to revive the machines beneath Goug with its power. He may even try to use the divine power with Bart Company. Not much we can do now...
outro.title: Mustadio's house

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: Heh, heh... Good for them.
outro.title: Mustadio's house

outro.speaker: Besrodio
outro.text: What do you mean?
outro.title: Mustadio's house

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Mustadio brings out a shiny crystal. The holy stone shines.
outro.title: Mustadio's house

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: I made a fake one in case something like this happened.
outro.title: Mustadio's house

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: You mean, they got a fake?
outro.title: Mustadio's house

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: That's right. They must be going crazy now.
outro.title: Mustadio's house

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Princess Ovelia and Agrias are in danger....!
outro.title: Mustadio's house

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: What do you mean?
outro.title: Mustadio's house

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: The Cardinal joined Bart to get the stone. He may take the Princess hostage.
outro.title: Mustadio's house

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: Ridiculous! Making an enemy of the royal family!
outro.title: Mustadio's house

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Why do you think the Cardinal wanted the stone? People are sick of long wars and political in fighting. Draclau wants to use the 'Zodiac Brave Story'. Creating 'Zodiac Braves' by collecting holy stones, he can control the world.
outro.title: Mustadio's house

outro.speaker: Besrodio
outro.text: He is right. We can't give the stone to the Cardinal.
outro.title: Mustadio's house

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Let's save the Princess and Agrias!
outro.title: Mustadio's house

outro.speaker: Mustadio
outro.text: Right. But the way to Lionel is probably sealed. We'll use a ship to sneak in the back of the castle.
outro.title: Mustadio's house

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The party sails to Warjilis Trade City, taking the stone with them.
outro.title: Mustadio's house

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: There aren't any Lionel troops in Warjilis....
outro.title: Warjilis Trade City

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza walks off the ship and faces an old friend.
outro.title: Warjilis Trade City

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Delita! Why are you here!?
outro.title: Warjilis Trade City

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Don't take our information network too lightly.
outro.title: Warjilis Trade City

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: 'Our'?
outro.title: Warjilis Trade City

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Go back to Igros, for your own sake. It's healthier to keep your nose out of certain things like Princesses and stones.
outro.title: Warjilis Trade City

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Delita, what do you mean?
outro.title: Warjilis Trade City

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: rescuing the Princess only solves one problem. But I can save her from all of them.
outro.title: Warjilis Trade City

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: What do you mean? I don't understand.
outro.title: Warjilis Trade City

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: The best ways don't always lead to the best results. You can't save her no matter what. Remember that.
outro.title: Warjilis Trade City

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita walks away.
outro.title: Warjilis Trade City

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Wait, Delita. What are you trying to do?
outro.title: Warjilis Trade City

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Larg, Goltana, your brothers, everyone... Haven't noticed they're all swept up in the same flow. I'm just going against it. That's all...... I'll see you again, if we live that long.
outro.title: Warjilis Trade City

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita leaves.
outro.title: Warjilis Trade City

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Delita...
outro.title: Warjilis Trade City

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Meanwhile at Lionel Castle...
outro.title: Warjilis Trade City

outro.speaker: Gafgarion
outro.text: You're using the princess as bait to get the stone back? That's not some thing a holyman would do.
outro.title: Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Rudvich
outro.text: Bastard! Things would've been fine if you hadn't let them escape!
outro.title: Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Gafgarion
outro.text: There were some mistakes, but it wasn't my fault!
outro.title: Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Draclau
outro.text: Enough, Rudvich. I'll return Ovelia to Dycedarg as promised. It was our intention, too. But don't you need to get rid of those who know about the kidnapping? The thief who stole the stone is with them. You can catch them all by using the Princess as bait. 2 birds with one stone.
outro.title: Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Gafgarion
outro.text: Exactly. But what if...?
outro.title: Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Draclau
outro.text: You are being weak.
outro.title: Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Gafgarion
outro.text: 'Careful' is more like it. You've got to be careful to survive on a battlefield.
outro.title: Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Draclau
outro.text: All right. I'll make sure you're protected. Also, we'll prepare bait just incase.
outro.title: Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Gafgarion
outro.text: Good. The woman will make perfect bait. I'll get rid of them. I'm more reliable then him!
outro.title: Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Rudvich
outro.text: How dare you!
outro.title: Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Draclau
outro.text: Fine. I'll leave it to you.
outro.title: Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Rudvich
outro.text: Are you serious?
outro.title: Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Draclau
outro.text: Don't let me down, Gafgarion.
outro.title: Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Gafgarion
outro.text: No problem. I'll even get the stone back!
outro.title: Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Gafgarion leaves the room.
outro.title: Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Rudvich
outro.text: Why him...?
outro.title: Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Draclau
outro.text: You failed enough. Now you must take responsibility...
outro.title: Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Rudvich
outro.text: W, What...?
outro.title: Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Draclau kills Rudvich.
outro.title: Lionel Castle

missions.brief: Goug · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Agrias in the valley

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Agrias is seen running.
intro.title: Bariaus Valley

intro.speaker: Man's voice
intro.text: Where are you? Don't try to escape!!
intro.title: Bariaus Valley

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The man finds Agrias.
intro.title: Bariaus Valley

intro.speaker: Lionel Knight
intro.text: So here you are...
intro.title: Bariaus Valley

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The knight calls out his other troopers.
intro.title: Bariaus Valley

intro.speaker: Knight
intro.text: Give yourself up!
intro.title: Bariaus Valley

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza and the party comes for the rescue.
intro.title: Bariaus Valley

intro.speaker: Knight
intro.text: What!?
intro.title: Bariaus Valley

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: I'm protecting Agrias! Geronimo!
intro.title: Bariaus Valley

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: Ramza! Why are you here!?
intro.title: Bariaus Valley

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: I was going to attack the castle flank to save you. But, why are you here?
intro.title: Bariaus Valley

intro.speaker: Agrias
intro.text: The Cardinal secretly plotted with Larg from the start! We tried to escape but only the Princess got caught!! I couldn't save her. They're about to execute her. We must hurry!!
intro.title: Bariaus Valley

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: First, we have to get rid of them somehow...
intro.title: Bariaus Valley

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Are you all right, Agrias?
outro.title: Bariaus Valley

outro.speaker: Agrias
outro.text: Yes, I'm alright, but we must hurry! She's going to be executed at the Gologrand Execution Site. Let's hurry!
outro.title: Bariaus Valley

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Yes, let's go!
outro.title: Bariaus Valley

missions.brief: Bariaus Valley · Protect Agrias.

missions.name: The empty gallows

intro.speaker: Executioner
intro.text: Any last words? No? I see.
intro.title: Gologrand Execution Site

intro.speaker: Knight of Lionel troop
intro.text: Huh? The Enemy!!
intro.title: Gologrand Execution Site

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza and his troops comes to their destination.
intro.title: Gologrand Execution Site

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: That's far enough! Return the Princess, now!
intro.title: Gologrand Execution Site

intro.speaker: Executioner
intro.text: Heh, heh, heh.... You fell into a trap!
intro.title: Gologrand Execution Site

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The executioner takes off his disguise.
intro.title: Gologrand Execution Site

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: You're still too naive, kid.
intro.title: Gologrand Execution Site

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Where is the Princess!?
intro.title: Gologrand Execution Site

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: At Lionel Castle. Where's the stone?
intro.title: Gologrand Execution Site

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Stone?
intro.title: Gologrand Execution Site

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: Stop playing dumb. The stone you stole from the Cardinal. You're with the one who stole it. Just hand it over!
intro.title: Gologrand Execution Site

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: If you want it, you'll have to take it!
intro.title: Gologrand Execution Site

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: Seems you've matured a bit. Then I will!
intro.title: Gologrand Execution Site

outro.speaker: Gafgarion
outro.text: Damn it! I didn't expect you to be this strong......! Retreat for now!!
outro.title: Gologrand Execution Site

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Gafgarion and his remaining troops retreats.
outro.title: Gologrand Execution Site

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: We must go to Lionel Castle immediately!!
outro.title: Gologrand Execution Site

banter.speaker: Gafgarion
banter.text: It's not too late! Let's go back to Igros! Your brother, Dycedarg said he'd forgive you! Come on, wake up!!
banter.title: Gologrand Execution Site

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: No, I won't be involved in any more wrong doing!
banter.title: Gologrand Execution Site

banter.speaker: Gafgarion
banter.text: 'Wrong doing'? What do you mean by that? You are a Beoulve! You have a mission to accomplish. 'Wrong doing', indeed! It's your mission, don't be such a fool!
banter.title: Gologrand Execution Site

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: My brothers are making war for personal reasons! What else can you call it other than 'evil'?
banter.title: Gologrand Execution Site

banter.speaker: Gafgarion
banter.text: You must make 'sacrifices' to accomplish anything! Without 'sacrifice' there's no progress, nor history! Look at Ivalice! Corrupt! Someone must change it!! Your brothers are trying to do that! Even if it means 'wrong doing'!
banter.title: Gologrand Execution Site

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: But that doesn't mean I should leave her stranded!
banter.title: Gologrand Execution Site

banter.speaker: Gafgarion
banter.text: Forget about Ft. Zeakden! It couldn't be helped! You're a Beoulve. You have a given duty! It is your fate!
banter.title: Gologrand Execution Site

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: It's fate that let Teta die? No, that's wrong! We killed her out of convenience... Yes, us! I've run from the truth long enough...I killed her...
banter.title: Gologrand Execution Site

banter.speaker: Agrias
banter.text: Ramza, are you really a Beoulve?
banter.title: Gologrand Execution Site

banter.speaker: Gafgarion
banter.text: Didn't you know, Agrias? His name is Ramza Beoulve. One of the Beoulve family.
banter.title: Gologrand Execution Site

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: It's true I'm a Beoulve! But I'm not like my brothers! I never knew about kidnapping the princess! I swear it!
banter.title: Gologrand Execution Site

banter.speaker: Agrias
banter.text: No doubt in my mind! I believe you!!
banter.title: Gologrand Execution Site

banter.speaker: Gafgarion
banter.text: This is ridiculous! One girls had died, so what? We must first think about 'justice'!
banter.title: Gologrand Execution Site

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: There's no 'justice' in using and deceiving people! I can't ignore people dying for 'justice'! I'll save Princess Ovelia!
banter.title: Gologrand Execution Site

banter.speaker: Gafgarion
banter.text: Stubborn kid!
banter.title: Gologrand Execution Site

banter.speaker: Agrias
banter.text: What're you going to do with the Princess!?
banter.title: Gologrand Execution Site

banter.speaker: Gafgarion
banter.text: My contract's to take her back to Gallione. I have no idea what Larg will do after that.
banter.title: Gologrand Execution Site

banter.speaker: Agrias
banter.text: You're using her as a tool for battle! Same as you! Larg and Dycedarg are using you, too! Aren't you ashamed of yourself? Don't you have any pride?
banter.title: Gologrand Execution Site

banter.speaker: Gafgarion
banter.text: What's the use? I gave mine up long ago!
banter.title: Gologrand Execution Site

missions.brief: Golgorand · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: The gate of Lionel

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Aren't you eating? You can't go on without food.
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: No one will mourn your death. In fact, it should make most people happy. You won't die. Just eat the food.
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.text: I knew you were in with the Cardinal. If you aren't turning me over to Larg, what's your plan?
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Taking you somewhere you belong... that's all.
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.text: So, you're using me, too. But you can't make me do whatever you want.
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: You have no other choice if you want to live.
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.text: What's that mean?
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: It means....
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Draclau and a man walks inside the cell.
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: A Knight
intro.text: So, she is Ovelia...?
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Cardinal Draclau
intro.text: How are you, Princess? If you'd behaved, you wouldn't be here now.
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Knight
intro.text: Hmmm, she's almost too good a substitute for a Princess.
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Draclau
intro.text: Heh, heh...Mr. Vormav, she doesn't know yet.
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: I see...poor girl.
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.text: What are you talking about?
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: Listen carefully. You're not Ovelia.
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: The real princess died long ago. You're a substitute.
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.text: No, that's a lie!!
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: It's not a lie. You are not Ovelia. Old Senators who didn't care for Princess Luveria, made you... So someday you'd succeed the throne, ousting the Princess. They killed 2 older Princes making it look like illness, and adopted you as Princess. They all thought Omdolia was too weak to make another son so you took the throne. However, Orinas was born. Even now, no one's sure if the Prince is really his son.
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: Larg may have had "seeds" planted to make his sister the King's mother... In any case, the old men's plan was ruined.
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.text: Liar! I don't believe it!
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: Think what you will. Whether you're a Princess or not doesn't matter to us. What matters is that we have an ace up our sleeve called a 'Princess'...
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.text: What are you going to do to me? What do you want?
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: Nothing. Just be a 'Princess' as you are now.
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.text: My ancestors were Atkaschas! No one can control me!
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: Then what? If Larg catches you, he'll kill you... right? We just want to help you take the throne...
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.text: Who are you?
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: We're neither allies of Larg nor supporters of Goltana. Just 'collaborators'.
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Draclau
intro.text: Vormav, let her calm down. Once she comes to her senses she won't refuse our help.
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: Yes...... you're right.
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Draclau leaves the cell.
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: Let's go, Delita!
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Vormav and Delita also leaves the cell.
intro.title: In a cell in Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza and his troop secretly arrives at the gate of Lionel Castle. Ramza tries to open the gate.
intro.title: At the gate of Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Wait there. I'll open the gate.
intro.title: At the gate of Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Familiar voice
intro.text: Not so fast!
intro.title: At the gate of Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Gafgarion comes out from the shadows.
intro.title: At the gate of Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: You got in all right, but didn't notice an ambush.
intro.title: At the gate of Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Gafgarion whistles. His men comes out from the shadows behind Ramza's troop.
intro.title: At the gate of Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Damn!!
intro.title: At the gate of Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Gafgarion
intro.text: Ramza! It's me you must fight with! En garde!!
intro.title: At the gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Gafgarion
outro.text: Ugnn...is this...end?
outro.title: At the gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Goodbye, Gafgarion......
outro.title: At the gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza pulls out his sword from Gafgarion's body, the Knight falls down on the ground silently.
outro.title: At the gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: We must save the princess before reinforcements arrive!
outro.title: At the gate of Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza and his troop successfully infiltrates inside the castle and finds the Cardinal.
outro.title: At the gate of Lionel Castle

missions.brief: Lionel Gate · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: The cardinal’s true face

intro.speaker: Draclau
intro.text: Gafgarion is not as good as he says... Or was it bad luck? Anyhow, you're good. You have Beoulve blood in your veins. Even if you are a bastard.
intro.title: Inside Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The Cardinal slowly walks down to confront the party.
intro.title: Inside Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Draclau
intro.text: But, I don't need your interference anymore. Leave the stone here. If you resist, I'll show no mercy...
intro.title: Inside Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Where is Princess Ovelia?
intro.title: Inside Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Draclau
intro.text: Why must you save her? You deserted the Beoulves. What can you change by yourself? Don't waste energy. Without power, nothing can be achieved... You're powerless.
intro.title: Inside Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Where's the Princess?
intro.title: Inside Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Draclau
intro.text: She's not here. She left for Zeltennia. She chose our help over yours.
intro.title: Inside Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: That's a lie!!
intro.title: Inside Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Draclau
intro.text: She has begun to think for herself. She felt unsure of you and chose us for obvious reasons to take the throne. Why don't you join us? You want to get the best of your brothers sails, right? We care about the world, too. How about it?
intro.title: Inside Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: I don't want to change the world! I just can't allow people to suffer and die because of some elitist's ideas. Change the world? You think anyone really can? I'm not that reckless!!
intro.title: Inside Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Draclau
intro.text: Ha, ha, ha... You're the one holding the stone. You can change not only the world, but the truth of everything with its power. Since you don't seem to understand, let me show you.
intro.title: Inside Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The Cardinal brings out a red crystal from his pocket. Lights, souls and demons flashes around the Cardinal. Huge ball of light flashes around the Cardinal, turning him to a demon.
intro.title: Inside Lionel Castle

intro.speaker: Tainted King, Queklain
intro.text: Hya, ha, ha! How about that? Surprised? Now, let me have my fun. Let me hear your screams and suffering death cries!
intro.title: Inside Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: Queklain
outro.text: I'm immortal...how can I be losing....? It's impossible. I can't...die...until he resurrects...
outro.title: Inside Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The Cardinal vanishes leaving the red stone. The stone flashes and falls down on the ground. The haunting scream of the Cardinal is heard just as the stone falls on the ground.
outro.title: Inside Lionel Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita successfully delivers the Princess to Goltana. Upon hearing this Goltana arranges a meeting with him.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: It's you... who saved Ovelia.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Delita- Black Sheep knight under Baron Grims, and Hyral. I was sent by order of Baron Grims to save the Princess. I've returned- Mission completed.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Minister Gelwan
outro.text: ...Hyral? Never heard of him.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: The Baron died in battle last month with the Ryomoku. The Black Sheep were entirely wiped out.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: That's why I returned.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: How's the Princess?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Kanbabrif
outro.text: Sleeping soundly, she's exhausted from the long trip.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Orlandu
outro.text: I heard you brought a prisoner?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Yes, sir. Bring him!
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: A knight brings the prisoner inside the room.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Why did you kidnap the Princess?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Prisoner
outro.text: We framed Goltana to prevent him from Lesalia,...taking the regency.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Who gave you the order? Prince Larg?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Prisoner
outro.text: One of Goltana's aids who wants to join Larg.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Minister Gelwan steps forward to silent the prisoner.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Gelwan
outro.text: Ridiculous! No aids would do that! Silence this lout!
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: No need. Listen.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Who is that?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Talk! Now!
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Prisoner
outro.text: Will you save my life?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: All right, I promise. Who is it!!?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Prisoner
outro.text: Him... Minister Gelwan.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Gelwan
outro.text: How dare you! It's a lie! I don't even know you!
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Who seduced you? The Queen?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Gelwan
outro.text: That's absurd! I don't know anything!
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Treason's a serious crime, Minister?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita draws his sword from his sheath. The knight and the prisoner steps back immediately. Orlandu quickly puts his hand on Excalibur's hilt, ready to draw.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Gelwan
outro.text: I said I don't know a thing!
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita lifts his sword to strike. Minister Gelwan quickly runs for the door but takes a fatal blow to his back from Delita's sword. Delita puts his sword back to his sheath and bow downs before Goltana. Orlandu takes his hand from Excalibur's hilt.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Let me say this! We must go to the capital with the Nanten now! Or they may hold you responsible for this plot. First, let's remove Orinas and the Queen, then get the Princess on the throne!
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Goltana went to Lesalia and confined Ruvelia in Bethla for kidnapping the Princess, and let the Princess accede to the throne.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: But Larg insisted Orinas was the legitimate successor and had him accede to the throne. Then Larg became the regent as a guardian.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Immediately after, Larg sent the Hokuten let by Orinas to Bethla to rescue the Queen. Meanwhile, Goltana sent the Nanten led by Ovelia...
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: This is the beginning of the upheavel which would later be called the 'Lion War'....
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: 3 months passed since the outbreak of the Lion War. Days passed, the frontlines expanded as did the intensity of the conflicts. Without any decisive victor, both Larg and Goltana's armies were being exhausted. Hunger and high taxes overwhelmed the people.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Bolmna
outro.text: 20,000 dead. Counting both sides, that makes 40,000... Well over 200,000 injured just in our troops alone.
outro.title: Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Elmdor
outro.text: Casualties aren't the only problem, foodstock is short as we expected. The real problem's the drought. There's no food and tax revenues are reduced. Storage is at less than a half.
outro.title: Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Blansh
outro.text: Larg's probably facing the same problem. I hear crops were ruined before harvest, due to rain.
outro.title: Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Orlandu
outro.text: More serious are those made destitute by the war. According to Olan, more than 100,000 refugees have come to Lesalia.
outro.title: Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Blansh
outro.text: Ha, ha...Good! Larg'll have problems getting food.
outro.title: Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Orlandu
outro.text: This is no laughing matter! The same could happen here. Many refugees may come here! Should we start peace talks!
outro.title: Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: I understand your concerns. But, we cannot stop the war. We'll increase tax by 30%. Make sure no one trades grain at high prices. Also keep an eye on all refugees entering Limberry.
outro.title: Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Orlandu
outro.text: Larg is in difficulty too. It's not too late for a peace settlement.
outro.title: Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: Enough, Orlandu! A peace settlement won't occur.
outro.title: Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Orlandu
outro.text: Our nation exists because of the people! We exist because of them. Farmers suffered the most in the War! Raising taxes would hurt them even more. The soldiers are also suffering from lack of food. It's impossible to continue physically and mentally.
outro.title: Bethla Garrison
