outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: Mentally? Are you becoming a coward?
outro.title: Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Orlandu
outro.text: In the last War, we served by keeping Ordolia out of our land!
outro.title: Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: Are you saying there's no right in this battle? Since when did you start talking about 'hypocrisy'? You can't go easy on them. It's for the people! We can't allow a corrupt royal family to oppress the people any longer. We fight!
outro.title: Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Blansh
outro.text: He's right. Just a little longer before it's over! I never expected to hear that from the one they used to call 'T.G. Cid'.
outro.title: Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Orlandu
outro.text: A little longer? Where'd you get that idea? How can you be optimistic? Are you blind?
outro.title: Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Blansh gets up from his chair.
outro.title: Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Blansh
outro.text: Your words are harsh!!
outro.title: Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: Enough! I'm disappointed in you, Orlandu. Any more harsh words may mean your life!
outro.title: Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Blansh sits down.
outro.title: Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: I won't say this again. If any more of you disagree with my plans, go now! Understand? Orlandu!
outro.title: Bethla Garrison

missions.brief: Lionel · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: The astrologer of Goland

intro.speaker: Chapter 3
intro.text: THE VALIANT
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Delita told me that there is a big tide and he goes against it...
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: If this age of war is the "big tide" like a fate we can't avoid, can I go against it?
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Now I head for Lesalia to tell my brother Zalbag there's someone manipulating this war...
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: ```text I------------------------------------------------------------I |-- =-=-= =-= =-=-= =-= =-=- NEWS -=-= =-= =-=-= =-= =-=-= --| | Future of the War | | Three months have passed since the Battle at Gulofavia | | -The first all out battle on a plain bordered by Lesalia | | and Limberry-. The death toll for the two armies reached | | nearly 400,000.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: This battle between those that fought side | | by side during the War is only creating many casualties | | with no end in sight. Many see the situation as a | | stalemate, and its length has brought pessimism among the | | people. | | Rescue of Princess Ovelia | | Princess Ovelia, abducted from Orbonne Monastery has been | | safely rescued.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The mastermind behind her abduction was | | Gelwan, a close official to Goltana and Queen Ruvelia. | | Trying to bring her son to the throne, it was the Queen's | | plan, to persuade the Minister -But, those supporting the | | Queen strongly deny these allegations-. Furthermore, the | | Minister has been already been executed.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The one who | | rescued the Princess was a young Knight named Delita, an | | assistant Black Sheep Knight under Baron Grims. Recognized | | for his heroism, he is expected to be the next leader of | | the Black Sheep now that the seat is vacant since the | | Baron was killed fighting the "Ryomoku"! | | Draclau's death | | 3 months have passed since the death of Draclau, due to | | illness.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: There are rumors that the leader of Lionel Castle | | was really assassinated. There is even one rumor that it | | was a murder by an "Unidentified monster". To support | | these theories, there was an attack upon the castle by | | thieves, the night before his death causing many death and | | injuries.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The cause of death was said to be people were | | "crushed to death." | | Drought and flood damage | | 10 years ago, the kingdom had a terribly bad harvest. | | Zeltennia and Limbbery were devasted by drought and their | | harvests were half the norm. On the other hand, Gallione | | and Fovoham, were devasted by floods. The harvests in the | | west were about half the norm as well.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: People left | | destitute in the war and people suffering from famine | | migrated to Lesalia seeking refuge. | I------------------------------------------------------------I ```
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: On their way to Lesalia, the party comes across a wooden house. A young man climbs on top of the house.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: Roar
intro.text: Where! Where did he run!?
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The young man moves.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: A roar
intro.text: Up there! Up the roof!!
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: A gang of thieves comes out and surrounds the house.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: Olan
intro.text: Surrounded...
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The leader climbs up the roof and greets the man.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: Thief
intro.text: I don't know who you are. Too bad you stumbled on us.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: Olan
intro.text: Next time put a sign outside saying "Thieves' hideout".
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: Thief
intro.text: Hya, ha! Damn blabbermouth. Now, give yourself up.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza and his troop decides to help the helpless man.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Something weird's going on in here...
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: Thief
intro.text: We have many visitors today. Let's get them all together!
intro.title: Opening / transition

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Are you all right?
outro.title: Opening / transition

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: Thank you for saving me. My name is Olan Durai. What is yours?
outro.title: Opening / transition

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Ramza Beoulve.
outro.title: Opening / transition

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Olan gives a strange reaction upon hearing Ramza's name.
outro.title: Opening / transition

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Is something wrong?
outro.title: Opening / transition

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: Oh, nothing. Never mind. Where are you going anyway?
outro.title: Opening / transition

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: To Lesalia. If you're going that way we could go along.
outro.title: Opening / transition

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: Too bad, I'm going the other way. Thanks for the offer.
outro.title: Opening / transition

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Well, be careful.
outro.title: Opening / transition

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: You too.
outro.title: Opening / transition

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The two shakes hands with each other.
outro.title: Opening / transition

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: I'll see you later. Stay alive, till then.
outro.title: Opening / transition

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Oh, uh, yeah...
outro.title: Opening / transition

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The two goes separate ways.
outro.title: Opening / transition

banter.speaker: Olan
banter.text: Destiny lies in my hands! Stop movement! Galaxy Stop!
banter.title: Opening / transition

missions.brief: Goland · Protect Olan.

missions.name: A heretic at Lesalia

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza finally comes to Lesalia and meets up with his brother, Zalbag.
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: Zalbag
intro.text: What's wrong? Why aren't you sitting? I was surprised to know you're in Lesalia. Alma's here, too. See her before you go.
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Brother...
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: Zalbag
intro.text: What?
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Can you stop the war?
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: Zalbag
intro.text: Don't be ridiculous!
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: What's the purpose? Beoulves have fought to protect the people, not royalty. But now, they're fighting for self- interest...
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: Zalbag
intro.text: You don't know anything!
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: You don't understand, brother! This battle's someone's plot! Someone's using Larg and Goltana!!
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: Zalbag
intro.text: Using...? What are you talking about?
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: I don't know much either...... Dycedarg tried to kidnap the princess to keep Goltana from the throne. But someone took the Princess to Goltana. If she was killed then, Goltana would have been killed as a traitor.
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Zalbag gets up from his chair.
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: Zalbag
intro.text: Dycedarg planned the kidnap? Ramza! You're saying your own brother came up with such a plot!?
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza steps back.
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Don't you know anything!?
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: Zalbag
intro.text: You fool!! Don't you trust your flesh? Get out! Go back to Igros!!
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Don't you believe me?!
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: Zalbag
intro.text: How am I supposed to believe an irreverent kid like you! I've cared about you being my half-brother but, after all bad blood is bad blood. Not suitable for a Beoulve!
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: ...Zalbag...
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: A Hokuten Knight comes in rushing into the room.
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: Hokuten Knight
intro.text: Your Excellency! I was told "T.G. Cid" broke through Doguola Pass!
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: Zalbag
intro.text: What!? I thought they were at Bethla! We'll have an assembly! Tell everyone to join!! I'll be there, too!!
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: Knight
intro.text: Yes, sir!
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Zalbag and the knight leaves the room.
intro.title: Lesalia Imperial Capital

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza steps out to go.
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: Ramza, wait!
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Alma comes to meet Ramza.
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Alma...
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: You were going to leave without telling me?
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: I hate good byes...
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: You won't be back, will you?
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Delita is alive.
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: What?
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Delita helped kidnap the Princess.
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: What does all this mean?
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: I thought he joined Goltana to get back at us... But he seems to be involved more with someone else. Someone other the Delita saved the Princess from being killed for some scheme.
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: Is it true Dycedarg was involved in the kidnapping?
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Yes. I'm sure he had his reasons, but I don't know them.
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: So Teta.... Is it...?
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Yes...
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Alma cries.
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Alma, listen carefully. I don't know who's behind Delita. But he's dangerous. Taking advantage of the war to achieve something vicious.
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: Is Delita party to the plot?
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: I don't know. He seemed to have his own ideas about things though.
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: You're fighting against them?
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: I'll go with you.
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Are you out of your mind? Of course not!!
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: I want to prove what you're saying is true!
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: No, no.
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: I don't want to see another Teta!!
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Alma......
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Man's voice
intro.text: Ramza Beoulve, aren't you?
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Two knight and a man steps out of the darkness.
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Priest
intro.text: I'm Zalmo Rusnada, Heresy Examiner! I order you to appear at a heresy hearing on suspicion of murder and heresy! You will follow us! Any resistance will force us to execute you immediately!
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Heresy Examiner??
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: Run! Brother!!
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

intro.speaker: Zalmo
intro.text: I won't let you! Get him! Kill the 'heretic'!
intro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: Zalmo
outro.text: You 'heretics' don't fear God!! I'll fix you!
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Zalmo vanishes.
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: Are you all right?
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Yeah....so we're both OK. How'd the examiner find out about the Holy Stone? Maybe it was someone behind Delita or Glabados Church? But why would the church...?
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: Holy stone? You mean the legendary Holy Stone? It really exists? Then, maybe I've seen it...
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza looks at her sister in disbelieve.
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: What!? Where?
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: Promise to take me with you?
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: don't be ridiculous. You'd have a terrible time! NO! I won't take you!
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: Ok, then I won't tell you!
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Come on, don't play games. You might get killed!
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: It may be too late already. Because you disobeyed him. By now I'm probably a heretic, a fugitive like you. Dycedarg may desert me to protect Beoulve....
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: He's capable of that. No, it's too dangerous. Explain it to Zalbag and get permission from the church!
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: I saw it at Orbonne Monastery. Yes....a crystal with a carved Virgo crest.
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Virgo...... Before it passes into their hands...... Thanks for telling me. Now, go back to Zalbag!
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: How do you get in Orbonne? You're a 'heretic'. You can't go into a monastery of Glabados. There's no way!
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: See? You DO need me, don't you?
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Only as far as Orbonne, all right? Then you go back.
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: ......alright.
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Promise me!
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Alma nods.
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: ```text I------------------------------------------------------------I |-- =-=-= =-= =-=-= =-= =-=- NEWS -=-= =-= =-=-= =-= =-=-= --| | Death of Marquis Elmdor in battle | | Known as the "Silver Nobleman" to his allies and "Silver | | Ogre" to his enemies, Marquis Elmdor was hit by a stray | | arrow at the battle at Fuss Plains and died. His people | | believed in him and thought he was a devout believer in | | the Glabados Church.
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Many visit his grave to pay their | | respects. Since he was the leader that supported the | | Goltana Army, the war effort will be affected. | I------------------------------------------------------------I ```
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza and his squad arrives at the monastery. Orbonne was already attacked by those after the stone. Ramza and Alma finds Simon, wounded in the library.
outro.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

banter.speaker: Zalmo
banter.text: Opposing us is the same as blasphemy! It's not too late! Repent! And your life will be saved!
banter.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: Why am I a 'heretic'? I haven't done anything.
banter.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

banter.speaker: Zalmo
banter.text: Don't be coy! You killed Draclau and took the Holy Stone to give it to a demon!
banter.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: That's a false charge! It was an 'evil stone' with vicious power, not like the legend. Further, the Cardinal became the legendary 'Lucavi' with its evil power!!
banter.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

banter.speaker: Zalmo
banter.text: You dare to hurt him too? Oh... for shame! You are a disgrace to the Beoulve name!
banter.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

banter.speaker: Zalmo
banter.text: Brother! Run! Hurry!! Those he never return! Run! Hurry!
banter.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: You should run, Alma! Or you too, will be branded a 'heretic'! Hurry and run!!
banter.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

banter.speaker: Alma
banter.text: I can't leave you alone here!
banter.title: Back gate of Lesalia Castle

missions.brief: Lesalia · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Orbonne: second floor

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: Simon!! Please answer me!!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Simon
intro.text: U, ugh...Alma... Why...are you...here?
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: What happened?
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Simon
intro.text: It's dangerous....here. Hurry....run. They...came for the Holy Stone 'Virgo'...
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Holy Stone!? Then Alma was right...
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Simon
intro.text: The Stone's been a royal treasure for generations... When Princess Ovelia came here, they gave it to us as proof of her status.
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Who are 'they'? Who's trying to get the stone?
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Simon
intro.text: You're Alma's older brother Ramza, aren't you? Don't get any more involved. You'll be killed......
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Man's voice
intro.text: Where is the Holy Stone!!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Another voice
intro.text: Wait! It must be here somewhere! Look for it!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Another voice
intro.text: We can go underground from here. Let's go!!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: I'm a fugitive, branded by the church as a 'heretic'. Is it because of the stone? Please tell me. Who are they?
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Simon
intro.text: High Priest and his sect are trying to regain power. First, they're reducing Larg and Goltana's military power by causing in-fighting. If the war drags on, it not only reduce their power, but trust in the royal family.
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: What's the real reason for collecting the Stones... and reviving the Zodiac Braves?
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Simon
intro.text: To gain the people's trust, of course.
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: But the Cardinal already joined Lucavi. If it's only the stone's power, it'd be strong enough to replace the military. Funeral wants that power?
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Simon
intro.text: You're different from your brothers. More like Balbanes. Perhaps you might be able to destroy their ambition.
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: You stay here. I'll go after them.
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: I'll go with you!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: We can't leave Simon alone. Hide in a safe place!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: ....OK, I will.
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza hands the Holy Stones to Alma.
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Hold on to this stone, just in case. If I don't come back, make sure to throw it in Bugrosia Sea. OK!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: I regret I can't help you. I wish I were born a man...
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Don't be silly. You're the only one I trust.
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: Brother...
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Take care of Simon!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza goes down after the attackers, leaving the two stones and Simon in Alma's care.
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Izlude
intro.text: You stay here! Understand!?
intro.title: Underground Book Storage Second Floor

intro.speaker: Shrine Knight Wizard
intro.text: Yes, sir!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage Second Floor

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Izlude goes down to find the holy stone. Ramza and his squad comes down to confront the enemy.
intro.title: Underground Book Storage Second Floor

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: It's not over yet! Never give them the Stone!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage Second Floor

outro.speaker: Izlude
outro.text: Wow! Is this 'Virgo'? How beautiful!!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage Second Floor

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Underground! Let's go!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage Second Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza and his troop pursues Izlude and finds him.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage Second Floor

missions.brief: Orbonne · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Orbonne: Izlude’s challenge

intro.speaker: Izlude
intro.text: I didn't expect you to find us here! But, just in time. Heretic Ramza, hand us the stone!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage Third Floor

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: No, why don't you give me yours? Do as I say and I'll let you live!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage Third Floor

intro.speaker: Izlude
intro.text: You think you can beat us?! Then I'll take it by force!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage Third Floor

outro.speaker: Izlude
outro.text: Damn! I refuse to acknowledge his power! I can't die... I must bring the stone back! Ramza, The next time I see you, will be your last! Remember!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage Third Floor

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Wait! Izlude!!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage Third Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Izlude runs up to the first floor. Ramza follows.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage Third Floor

banter.speaker: Izlude
banter.text: Why do you go against us Ramza? Though you're a Beoulve, you don't obey your brothers. Why?
banter.title: Underground Book Storage Third Floor

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: It's because I'm a Beoulve that I don't obey them! The name shouldn't be used for self-gain, but rather for divine 'justice'! During the War, my father fought and died to save the people from invasion... Beoulves must not fight for a defunct royal family, but only for Noble rights!
banter.title: Underground Book Storage Third Floor

banter.speaker: Izlude
banter.text: Then, let's fight together! Our goals are the same! Listen well, Ramza! The Glabados want a world where all people are equal! St. Ajora's ideal world, is 'God's world'! You know people don't trust the royal family or nobility! We must do something before Ivalice is ruined!!
banter.title: Underground Book Storage Third Floor

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: You started this war! Was that the will of God?
banter.title: Underground Book Storage Third Floor

banter.speaker: Izlude
banter.text: Certain sacrifices must be made for the revolution! Decadent royalty and nobles must pay! For the people! Now, cooperate with us. As Delita did!
banter.title: Underground Book Storage Third Floor

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: It sounds good when you say 'for the people', but what you really want is... a stronger army than the Knights, and the evil power to control the people.
banter.title: Underground Book Storage Third Floor

banter.speaker: Izlude
banter.text: 'Evil power'? No, the stone is 'holy'! We want to guide people by God's miracle! Never "evil power"!
banter.title: Underground Book Storage Third Floor

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: You know the Cardinal joined Lucavi, right? If that's not 'evil power', I don't know whatis!
banter.title: Underground Book Storage Third Floor

banter.speaker: Izlude
banter.text: What do you mean? You killed the Cardinal and took the stone from him! But he died because he was secretly collecting the Holy Stone for us.
banter.title: Underground Book Storage Third Floor

missions.brief: Orbonne · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Orbonne: the white knight

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: No! Let go!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Wiegraf
intro.text: Izlude, leave this to me! You gotta get out of here with that firl!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Izlude
intro.text: You, come on this way!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Alma
intro.text: Help me! Brother Ramza!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Izlude takes off with Alma.
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Wiegraf
intro.text: Here's Ramza! It would be a fatal mistake to underestimate them! Don't let your guard down!!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza and his troop comes up the first floor.
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Wiegraf
intro.text: ...Miluda, finally I can avenge your death!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Wiegraf!! You're still alive!!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Wiegraf
intro.text: Been a long time, Ramza. Glad to see you again!!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: You've become a dog for the church and have forsaken your ideals!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Wiegraf
intro.text: You don't understand how hard it is to fulfill your ideal. Even if your ideal is great, it's just a dream if you can't fulfill it! So how can you fulfill it? You need power! That's the politics of the world! I can see it clearly now! You can't fulfill your dreams without power! You say I'm a dog of the church! Go ahead!! I don't care! You can despise me, but I'll be laughing at the end. You'll all submit to me!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: I pity you, Wiegraf. Even if you couldn't fulfill your dream, your people wouldn't have forgotten you. Your ideals and actions inspired your people and stirred up the old Noble customs! Your actions have meaning only if they hold true to your ideals... Miluda and your old comrades would be disappointed with your current choice of actions. If you need someone else to fulfill your dreams it loses its value, Wouldn't you agree?
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

intro.speaker: Wiegraf
intro.text: You say you are different? You say you depend on no one? You'll never know the feeling of the 'Meager'! You may think you know it, but you've never lived it! You'd never know! 'Reality' is far harsher than you can possibly imagine. Why do you blame me? You have no right to blame me!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: Ouh...... No, I won't lose...! I'm...a member...of Zodiac Braves... with 'Aries'... I... can't... lose... like this!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Wiegraf vanishes.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Where are you! Wiegraf!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza's troop still battles the Temple Knights. While that was happening, Ramza runs outside the monastery to find Alma. Near death, Wiegraf crawls out of the monastery leaving trails of blood behind.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Izlude
outro.text: Are you OK? Wiegraf!!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: Don't worry...about me... Just...go!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza comes out.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Alma!!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Izlude
outro.text: Sorry, Wiegraf!!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Izlude takes off with Alma.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Wait! Izlude!!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Wiegraf coughs.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: Goho! Damn....I can't die here. I can't face my dead allies without avenging Miluda... No.... I don't want to die...
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: A purple stone falls down to the ground from Wiegraf's pocket. The stone slowly arises into the air.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Holder of the Holy Stone... Promise me....
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: What....? The stone....spoke...?
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Holder of the Holy Stone... Promise me.... Your spirit will unite with My flesh to live forever.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: Is this the stone's secret?
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Your despair and resentment called me... now promise...
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: No! Wiegraf!! Don't open that!!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The stone flashes, calling upon souls and demons. The stone hovers on top of Wiegraf, and all sorts of light flashes around the stone. Wiegraf melds with the Lucavi Magician Velius. The stone blasts and makes mist around Wiegraf. The mist finally vanishes, revealing Velius (Wiegraf). Ramza quickly puts his hand on his sword's hilt.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Velius
outro.text: This is the stone's power!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Wiegraf.........!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Velius
outro.text: Ramza, its power is magnificent! No, not just the power. Centuries of knowledge ingrained into my brain.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: With lightning speed, Ramza pulls out his sword from his sheath.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Velius
outro.text: Hya, ha...easy...save some for later...! Hya, ha...superb...Superb power......!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Velius vanishes. The wounded Simon comes out. Ramza helps the old man.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Simon! Can you hear me...?
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Simon
outro.text: H, here...
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Simon hands a book to Ramza.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: What is this book?
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Simon
outro.text: Germonik, a disciple of St. Ajora wrote it... It had been missing...till I found it in the underground library.... It explains in detail about the Zodiac Brave Story...
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Please don't try to talk!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Simon
outro.text: That's all right...... I'm a sinner... I knew of the church's wrong doing... but said nothing... You can bring them to justice with this book! You can bring Alma back with this book...
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Simon!!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Simon
outro.text: Whew, now I can finally rest. Take care of the rest... Ramza.... You're just like Balbanes... when he was young.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Simon dies peacefully.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Simon!!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage First Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: After the death of Simon, Ramza heads to Dorter. It was raining hard, while walking up the street Ramza meets a young man.
outro.title: Dorter Trade City

outro.speaker: Exotic Wizard
outro.text: Heretic Ramza?
outro.title: Dorter Trade City

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Where is Alma?
outro.title: Dorter Trade City

outro.speaker: Wizard
outro.text: If you want her back, come to Riovanes Castle. But you must bring the 'Germonik Scriptures' given to you at the monastery.
outro.title: Dorter Trade City

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: What does it mean to you?
outro.title: Dorter Trade City

outro.speaker: Wizard
outro.text: Haven't you read it?
outro.title: Dorter Trade City

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Return Alma, if you don't want the church's lies exposed!
outro.title: Dorter Trade City

outro.speaker: Wizard
outro.text: You're in no position to demand. You have no choice. You've been warned.
outro.title: Dorter Trade City

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: No, not yet. Is it an important book?
outro.title: Dorter Trade City

outro.speaker: Wizard
outro.text: A blissful ignorant. Your life's in danger, and yet you don't even realize the importance of the book? Well...no matter...you've been warned.
outro.title: Dorter Trade City

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The wizard disappears into the dark shadows.
outro.title: Dorter Trade City

missions.brief: Orbonne · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Deserters on Grog Hill

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ovelia, who became Queen by Goltana's will was shattered upon discovering she was living a lie.
intro.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's Church

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: So here you are... Everyone was looking for you.
intro.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's Church

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Delita enters the ruins.
intro.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's Church

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Something wrong? Oh, I shouldn't talk to a Princess in such a way.
intro.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's Church

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.text: Stop it!!
intro.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's Church

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: By your leave, your most gracious majesty.
intro.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's Church

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.text: ...Please stop.
intro.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's Church

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Sorry....I apologize.
intro.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's Church

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.text: What are you going to do with me? I'm not Ovelia, you know. I'm worth nothing to you. Not even worth living alive.
intro.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's Church

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Yes. You're not Ovelia. We don't know your real name or even if you're a noble or a commoner.
intro.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's Church

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.text: What did my life mean all these years...? Raised as a substitute... Ha, ha...amusing isn't it? A Princess must live her life quietly in a monastery away from the capital. I'd often wondered why only I had to live like that. But if my suffering would to keep Ivalice in peace, then I thought I could endure it. What was all the grief and isolation I suffered for?
intro.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's Church

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: You and I are the same... Miserable people forced to live false lives. Always being used by someone... Try hard and you'll be rewarded they say. Lies... Only those close to the top are rewarded without trying, It's the way of the world. Most people have to act the roles given to them... Then again, most of them haven't even noticed they're even acting. No way I'd do that. I won't be used. I'll be the one using!
intro.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's Church

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Those who used me must pay for what they've done!
intro.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's Church

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.text: What will you do?
intro.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's Church

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Trust me, Ovelia. I'll make a country worthy of you! I'll make your life shine! Let me guide you!
intro.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's Church

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Delita comforts Ovelia.
intro.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's Church

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: ...Don't cry like that.
intro.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's Church

intro.speaker: Ovelia
intro.text: Should I trust you?
intro.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's Church

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: I won't betray you. I swear by my dead sister, Teta...... So, please don't cry...
intro.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's Church

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Finding comfort in Delita's words, Ovelia hugs him. Having seen the death of Simon, abduction of Alma, the church's lies, Germonik Scriptures, the war, Ramza heads to Riovanes Castle to find answers and to end things. On their way, at Grog Hill, Ramza and his troop comes across some people.
intro.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's Church

intro.speaker: Nanten Deserter
intro.text: Damn. What rotten luck, a pursuit unit!
intro.title: Grog Hill

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Are you a Nanten patrol?
intro.title: Grog Hill

intro.speaker: Deserter
intro.text: We're tired of fighting! We want to go home! We'd rather be poor and covered with mud than this! We're sick of killing! We want to return to our families!
intro.title: Grog Hill

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Wait! We're not after you! We have no desire to fight! Don't misunderstand!
intro.title: Grog Hill

intro.speaker: Deserter
intro.text: Don't lie! You expect us to believe you? Trying to get us off guard then kill us! Well none of your tricks will work!
intro.title: Grog Hill

intro.speaker: Deserter (Chemist)
intro.text: H, hey! He was on the wanted list!
intro.title: Grog Hill

intro.speaker: Deserter
intro.text: Huh? ....So what?!
intro.title: Grog Hill

intro.speaker: Deserter (Chemist)
intro.text: It's him! The 'heretic! You know! If we bring him to them, they may let us off!!
intro.title: Grog Hill

intro.speaker: Deserter
intro.text: You mean... going back to the Knights?
intro.title: Grog Hill

intro.speaker: Deserter (Chemist)
intro.text: Getting a 'heretic's big. Like getting enemy brass! If we get him, they might give us a discharge, too.
intro.title: Grog Hill

intro.speaker: Deserter
intro.text: That's right... I know a guy discharged in an exchange.
intro.title: Grog Hill

intro.speaker: Deserter (Chemist)
intro.text: We can go home big! Otherwise, we'll have to live in hiding as deserters!
intro.title: Grog Hill

intro.speaker: Deserter
intro.text: Right! Let's catch him! We can even kill him! He's a 'heretic', they'll execute him sooner or later. We can go home by killing him! This is our last battle!!
intro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: I understand your lives are important...but, is that it?
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: After defeating the deserters, Ramza wonders about his father.
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: I wonder what...father would've done?
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The pursuit unit along with Olan as the leader, appears at rainy Grog Hill.
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: We meet again.
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: A Black Lion's crest.... You're a Nanten?
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: So, you killed the deserters for us. I never thought a Beoulve would help us.
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Not because I wanted to.
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: I know. You didn't want to fight, right? Same here. I don't go after deserters because I want to. You know what I mean.
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: You knew me...
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: Yeah, I saw your name and face on the wanted list... As a dangerous 'heretic', what did you do?
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Are you going to try and catch me?
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: Why would I do that? Our job's to catch deserters. No need for us to be involved. But your brothers are after you. Run before they come.
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza walks and stops.
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Why do you continue to fight?
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: As long as your brothers point swords at us, it'll continue...
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: So if Larg quits, Goltana would, too?
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: But that won't ever happen.
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: If you see Orlandu of Nanten, let me know. Some are urging Larg and Goltana for 'gain'. We're in the palm of their hands...They're the real ones to beat.
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: Why Orlandu?
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: My father used to say he was his only friend...
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: Orlandu's my father-in-law. I'll tell him that...
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Do you believe me?
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: I don't know why they're trying to collect holy stones. If it's for the people, I won't interrupt. But, if it's for self gain, Orlandu won't allow it. He'll promise to kill in the name of 'T.G. Cid'.
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Do you know about the High Priest's plot?
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: Yes, but there is no proof. We're investigating it, but you may know better.
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: If we prove it, would you stop fighting?
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: Do you have proof?
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Here's the 'Germonik...' ...no...nothing...
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: No one knows whether the war will end or not. But I'm sure... Orlandu would quit...
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Nanten Knight
outro.text: Olan, shall we go?
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: All right. I'm coming! I must go, Ramza. Take care.
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Olan goes down to unite with his unit.
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: Ramza, you're not alone! You have friends! Allies who'd risk their lives! I'm one of them!
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Olan and his squad leaves.
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: ...Thank you, Olan.
outro.title: Grog Hill

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza drew strength from Olan's words and proceeds to Riovanes Castle. On their way, Ramza and his troop decides to rest at Yardow Fort City.
outro.title: Grog Hill

missions.brief: Grog Hill · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: The girl at Yardow

intro.speaker: Exotic Wizard
intro.text: You know what you're saying?
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

intro.speaker: Rafa
intro.text: You're the one who doesn't. We're not tools. Tools for murder! If we stay here, we'll be used as tools till we die! Come on, Malak! Let's escape together!
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

intro.speaker: Malak
intro.text: Who helped us when we lost our parents in the war? If Grand Duke hadn't saved us, we'd have starved... he cared about us... Now you're returning the favor with vengeance?
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Rafa shakes her head.
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

intro.speaker: Rafa
intro.text: You've been deceived! Barinten took advantage of war and burned the village! Why? To get the family skills only our family knows. He burned a village to get my Heaven skill and your Hell skill! He killed our parents!! Don't you see?!!
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Malak slaps Rafa on the cheek.
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

intro.speaker: Malak
intro.text: That's ridiculous!!
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

intro.speaker: Rafa
intro.text: You know what he did! What he did to me! I KNOW you know!
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

intro.speaker: Malak
intro.text: Don't you say anymore! Otherwise, I...
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: A ninja comes down to meet Malak.
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

intro.speaker: Riovanes Ninja
intro.text: So here you are, Malak. He'll be here soon.
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: More enemy soldiers comes.
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

intro.speaker: Malak
intro.text: I know. It's all set....
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

intro.speaker: Rafa
intro.text: Malak....
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza and his troop comes to Yardow Fort City.
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

intro.speaker: Ninja
intro.text: Here he comes! Heretic Ramza!
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Rafa quickly sprints to Ramza's troop.
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

intro.speaker: Malak
intro.text: Rafa!!
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

intro.speaker: Rafa
intro.text: Help!!
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: You! You're that man! You're supposed to be waiting at Riovanes Castle!
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

intro.speaker: Malak
intro.text: That was what Grand Duke said! I'll prove we can beat you without the Shrine Knights!
intro.title: Yardow Fort City

outro.speaker: Malak
outro.text: Damn, I hate retreating like this!
outro.title: Yardow Fort City

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Are you all right?
outro.title: Yardow Fort City

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: Y....yes...thank you...I....I....
outro.title: Yardow Fort City

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: If they return, we're in trouble. Let's hide!
outro.title: Yardow Fort City

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Rafa, the girl rescued at Yardow, talks with Ramza in a basement.
outro.title: Yardow Fort City

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: Barinten wants only one thing. To be the king. They call him 'Weapon King' for making strong weapons and training many wizards.
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: There is one who incites the Grand Duke that is of the royal family. Killing Larg and Goltana set the stage for him to become a regent...
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: Why do you keep fighting being branded a 'heretic'? I think I know why. But nobody'll thank you for beating him.
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: I'm not fighting for thanks. I'm fighting for honor and pride as a Beoulve.
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: That's a lie....You aren't that noble. You can't ignore injustice or evil in front of you.
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: You flatter me. I'm not that good. But what're you going to do? I must go to Riovanes to save Alma. But you barely escaped from there, right?
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: I must get my brother out...
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Why are you two fighting?
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: We're Fifty Year War orphans. I'll never forget those days looking through garbage and dead bodies for food... That's when Barinten saved us. I believed in God then.
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Barinten built orphanages for the war orphans. But, he provided training to 'gifted' children to be professional assassins... You must be those children.
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: We, Galthanas, have 'secret skills' of the family.... My Heaven skill and my brother's Hell skill. These two skills differ from magic... Barinten wanted them. But the family elder refused him. So he burned the village. He decided if he couldn't have them, he'd erase them from this world. He probably was excited when he found us among the orphans.
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: You tried to escape when you found out the truth.
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: We yearned for him to be like our real father... But even then...
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Voice of Malak
outro.text: So this is where you were hiding?
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: Malak!
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: A frog jumps out of the darkness behind the two.
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Voice of Malak
outro.text: Listen, Ramza! Hurry to Riovanes Castle! Or your sister will be dead!
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: If you touch Alma, I'll show no mercy!
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Voice of Malak
outro.text: Rafa, you're coming, too! Resist and Ramza's sister'll die because of you!
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: It's not fair! They have nothing to do with us!
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Voice of Malak
outro.text: This is not a warning... it's an order!!
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The frog explodes.
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: Let's go, Ramza!
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Sorry, Rafa! You had to do this because of us...
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: It's not your fault. Don't worry.
outro.title: Basement

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Hearing Malak's orders, Ramza and his troops heads to Riovanes Castle. Along the way, the party gets attacked by undead soldiers.
outro.title: Basement

missions.brief: Yardow · Protect Rafa.

missions.name: Whispers in Yuguo

intro.speaker: Rafa
intro.text: Those who died in the War haven't been able to rest. Return to the future life once again with your affection left in this life!!
intro.title: Yuguo Woods

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: The spiritual forest.... I never want to come back.
outro.title: Yuguo Woods

missions.brief: Yuguo · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Riovanes: the outer wall

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Vormav and Wiegraf comes inside in one of the rooms of the Castle to meet Barinten.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: Welcome. How do you like our castle? It looks a little spartan compared to Lesalia Castle but I like it... This castle's built for war. It's far more beautiful than one built for government. Ivalice has always been ruled by men with 'power'. This war proved the royal family lost the 'power'.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: Get to the point.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: You're being impatient.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Barinten gets up from his seat and walks down.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: To be quite frank... Can we work together?
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: What do you mean?
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: As I said, men with 'power' rule Ivalice. So, who has the "power"? Prince Larg of Hokuten? Or, Prince Goltana of Nanten? Neither one of them. It's you, Shrine Knights, who hold the stones......
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: Holy Stones have great magical power. According to ancient legend, a natural disaster in Murond was caused by its power......
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Vormav starts to laugh.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: Ha, ha, ha...... Well, excuse me. I didn't expect a Grand Duke like yourself believed in such fairy tales.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: So you're saying you don't believe it? That's strange...They say Draclau of Lionel died from problems with the stone.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: I heard he died of illness.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: Then why are you after the youngest Beoulve? Why chase him as a 'heretic'?
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: We don't question decisions by Heresy Examiners.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: Oh, my...You're saying you know nothing about it? But you may change your mind after seeing this... Call Malak!!
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Malak brings in the captured Izlude.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Izlude
intro.text: F, father.....I'm sorry.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: ...I see.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: We have 'Scorpio' and 'Taurus'.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: Moron!!
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Vormav slaps Izlude. A Riovanes Knight walks in.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Riovanes Knight
intro.text: Excuse me, Sir! We verified the intruder's identity!
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: Malak, I'll let you take care of him.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Malak and the knight walks out the room.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: What do you want?
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Barinten sits down.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: As I said before, we want to help you, too.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: What if I refuse?
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: The Church's injustice will be exposed. That's all.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: You can't prove it just with the Holy Stones.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: Exactly. But, how about with the 'Germonik Scriptures'? Larg, Goltana, and the senate ought to be interested...
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: Where is it?
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: I can't tell you.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: Wiegraf, go after the wizard. I'll take care of here.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Barinten stands up from his seat. Wiegraf walks out the door.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: Don't do anything funny! The odds are against you!
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: Odds? What do you think you weak humans can do?
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Izlude
intro.text: Father....?
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: A loud thunderclap booms in the distance.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: Don't underestimate us. Killing you is easy...
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: Are you opposing me!?
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Barinten quickly steps back. Two Riovanes knight enters the room while the two knight beside Barinten steps up. The four knights surrounds Vormav and slowly puts their hand on their sword's hilt. Vormav looks down. Another loud thunderclap booms in the distance. Drops of sweats runs down from the knights foreheads.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: Want to fight...? Fine. I'll show you the power of the Holy Stone!
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Vormav brings out a yellow stone. The stone starts to glow. The screen fades. The cries of terror echoes in the hall.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Rafa
intro.text: Malak, please stop! Let's go together!
intro.title: At the gate of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Malak
intro.text: You know what happens to traitors! You'll be chased by your ex-allies and killed. Even if you escape, you'll live your life frightened. I'd never want to live like that! But Grand Duke promised to free us after this job!
intro.title: At the gate of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Rafa
intro.text: Do you believe him? You know he's lying! If we don't escape now, we'll be his slaves for life!
intro.title: At the gate of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Malak
intro.text: I trust him! We'll be free if we kill him and take the 'Germonik Scriptures'!
intro.title: At the gate of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Where is Alma?
intro.title: At the gate of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Malak
intro.text: I can see you're worried about her. Just hand me the 'Germonik Scriptures' and I'll save you!
intro.title: At the gate of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Rafa
intro.text: Ramza, don't believe him! Barinten'll kill both of you once he gets what he wants! Whatever you do don't give the scriptures to him! Your sister'll be safe only as long as you have the book!
intro.title: At the gate of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Malak
outro.text: Ugh....tough... My power is not good enough?!
outro.title: At the gate of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Malak escapes.
outro.title: At the gate of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: Malak! Are you running away?
outro.title: At the gate of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Rafa goes after Malak.
outro.title: At the gate of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: A knight comes out from inside the castle holding his wounds.
outro.title: At the gate of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Riovanes Knight
outro.text: H...help... M...monster...
outro.title: At the gate of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The knight dies.
outro.title: At the gate of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Rafa......Alma.... Please be safe.........
outro.title: At the gate of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza's troop was still fighting outside the castle. Ramza quickly ran inside the castle to rescue his sister.
outro.title: At the gate of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Imprisoned at Riovanes Castle, Alma thinks about Ramza.
outro.title: In a cell

outro.speaker: (Alma's thought
outro.text: Brother...)
outro.title: In a cell

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Suddenly a scream of terror breaks the silence in the cell.
outro.title: In a cell

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: What!?
outro.title: In a cell

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The sound of battle and the screams of horror echoes through the cell. A knight enters the cell, covered with blood. The knight falls down, a pool of blood slowly pours down from his wounds.
outro.title: In a cell

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: What an awful wound!
outro.title: In a cell

outro.speaker: Riovanes Knight
outro.text: U, ugh...help... That....monster......
outro.title: In a cell

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Alma holds the knight's hand.
outro.title: In a cell

outro.speaker: Knight
outro.text: R...run.... It's...dangerous...
outro.title: In a cell

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The knight dies. Alma fearfully made her way out of the cell.
outro.title: In a cell

missions.brief: Riovanes · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Riovanes: one against one

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza makes his way through the Castle. Ramza comes across a hallway and witnesses the dead knights bodies.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: What's this...?
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Wiegraf sees Ramza.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Wiegraf
intro.text: There you are Ramza.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Wiegraf slowly walks down.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Wiegraf
intro.text: Draw your sword, Ramza.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Nothing happens.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Wiegraf
intro.text: What's wrong? If you don't, I will.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: How miserable you are... Giving your spirit to Lucavi just to avenge yourself. If Miluda knew about this, she'd be very disappointed.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Wiegraf
intro.text: Revenge? Ha! That's not what I'm after.... I want far more than that. I don't give a damn about Miluda's murder. I want to bring 'chaos' into the world...to hear the screams of humans... But, don't worry, Ramza, I'll kill you....myself.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: The stones are evil...and so are the Zodiac Braves. The legends we believed in were all lies!
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Wiegraf
intro.text: Hya, ha, ha. So much for 'God's miracle'. Governments falsify history only so it favors them. But you can't blame them. Because people always hope for a 'miracle'. Endlessly complaining, lazy, nuisances... that's what the masses really are. Governments give the people what they want...and history repeats itself. Governments might well have taken advantage of their insecurity.... But then again, people are satisfied being used...
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Wiegraf
intro.text: 'God' is nothing but an image created out of their insecurity. It's their fault for knowing they're comfortably numb, and not doing anything about it.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: And what about you? Relying on miracles instead of beating your insecurities!
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Wiegraf
intro.text: It's because humans are insecure that they rely on 'miracles'. Can you honestly say you're not, with any confidence?
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: I'm trying!
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Wiegraf
intro.text: Then your efforts have come to an end!
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: You've improved...
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Wiegraf vanishes.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Running away? Wiegraf!!
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza runs down the hallway looking for Wiegraf.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Come out of there! Wiegraf!!
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Wiegraf appears.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Wiegraf
outro.text: Let's have it out here...
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Wiegraf using the stone's power, turns into Velius.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Velius
outro.text: Sorry to keep you waiting.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

missions.brief: Riovanes · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Riovanes: Velius awakens

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza's troop enters the room after defeating the enemies outside the castle.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Velius
intro.text: I see you have some help. Then I'll do the same. Come out, loyal servants!
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Velius summons the Archaic Demons.
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Velius
intro.text: Here I come, Ramza! Let me show you the power of evil!
intro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Velius
outro.text: Whooooah!! They're just humans....!
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Velius and his servants vanishes leaving the holy stone in Ramza's hand. A scream broke the silence in the hall.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Alma!!
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Speechless from seeing the dead bodies inside the castle. Alma makes her way to where Vormav fought the four knights. The four knights were already dead with a bloody gash on their bodies. The horribly wounded Izlude, sat silently in the dark, breathing heavily.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Izlude
outro.text: ...Uhn...Uhnn...
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Alma slowly makes her way to Izlude.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: Are you all right!?
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Izlude
outro.text: S...sword...where is it? must....beat...him.... Please...give me some light. So dark...can't see a thing.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: Don't worry. No need to fight anymore.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Izlude
outro.text: Tell your brother...the stone...has 'evil power'... He's not...my father...the power made him...Lucavi......hack...cough...
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Izlude coughs, blood spilling out from his mouth.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: Please don't try to talk...
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Izlude
outro.text: What Ramza said was true... The world will end...if we don't kill him... Tell everyone...not time to fight....must cooperate... W, where's...my sword? ...Can't move...my arms.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: Don't worry. I saw 'his' body in the hall. My brother killed him. So you don't need to fight.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Izlude
outro.text: Really? That's a relief... The stone is...in my jacket. Give it....to your brother...
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Alma takes the stone from Izlude's jacket.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: I'll be sure to do that.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Izlude
outro.text: Ugh...tired...sleepy......just rest now...
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Izlude dies.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Man's voice
outro.text: Who's there?
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Vormav walks in and sees Alma.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Vormav
outro.text: So here you are. I'll send you to the other side, too.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Vormav walks down.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Vormav
outro.text: Don't fear. You won't suffer....
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Vormav slowly makes his way to Alma and hears a haunting howl.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: (Vormav's thoughts
outro.text: What.... Velius was killed?)
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Vormav
outro.text: Your brother has the devil's own luck... Now, come here......
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Suddenly the holy stone shimmers.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Velius
outro.text: Why, why is Virgo responding? You...can't be... Very nice! I didn't expect to meet you here! I thought it would take 100 years to find you! I never dreamed you were the one!
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Vormav grabs Alma's hand.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: Stop!! Let go of me!!
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Vormav
outro.text: No need to fear. I won't kill you. Now come here!
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Vormav punches the poor girl on the stomach and carries her away, leaving the stone Alma got from Izlude.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

missions.brief: Riovanes · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Riovanes: the rooftop

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: Fool! This is what I get? Revenge for kindness!? Why do you think you're even still alive today! Because of me! I took you out of the garbage! Or did you forget that already?
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Rafa
intro.text: Revenge for kindness? You burned the village! You are the one who killed my parents! And you say it's revenge for kindness? No...it's justice!
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Rafa draws her sword. Barinten quickly pulls out a gun from his jacket and points it at Rafa.
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: Justice? Now can you kill me? I'm your father. I raised you! I'd like to see you try and kill me!
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Nothing happens.
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: Hya, ha! You can't... And do you know why? Because your body recalls the terror... Don't worry...that terror will gradually subside. Hya, ha, ha.
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Malak
intro.text: Is that true?!!
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Malak comes out from the shadows.
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Malak
intro.text: Is what you said true?
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: You're turning on me, too? You're both ingrates!
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Rafa lifts her sword up to strike.
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Rafa
intro.text: I'll kill you!!
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Malak
intro.text: Stop it! Rafa!!
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Malak pushes Rafa just when Barinten shoots. Taking a bullet from Barinten's gun, Malak falls down.
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Rafa
intro.text: Malak!!
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Rafa holds Malak's head.
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Rafa
intro.text: Malak! Are you all right!
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza arrives at the scene.
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Rafa! Malak!!
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: So, you're Ramza..... Don't move. Rafa, if you want to help Malak, bring the stone here. Malak should have it. Find it!
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Rafa takes the stone from Malak's pocket.
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: That's right. Bring it to me! Hurry!
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: A young woman comes up from behind Barinten and lifts him up by his throat.
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Barinten
intro.text: Gya!!
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The girl throws Barinten off the building.
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Man's voice
intro.text: Can you hand me the stone?
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: A man appears from the shadows along with another young girl.
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: M...Marquis Elmdor. Why are you here....?
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Rafa puts the stone in her pocket.
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Elmdor
intro.text: No... Give it to me...
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza steps forward.
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Rafa! Watch out!! They are not human!
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Elmdor
intro.text: So you're Ramza, the heretic? I never really thanked you for doing me this favor. Thank you.... I don't want to have to get rough like Vormav did. Please understand. Now, hand me the stone and I'll ask Vormav to return your sister.
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Where is Alma!? Bring her back!!
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Elmdor
intro.text: Didn't you hear me? Give me the stone first.
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: No, I won't.
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Elmdor
