intro.text: Are you abandoning her? I thought you came here to save her, knowing there'd be danger.
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Elmdor
intro.text: Very well. I didn't want to get rough but... Celia, Lede, go ahead! That girl has the stone. Get it back....!
intro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Elmdor
outro.text: I see why Queklain and Velius were beaten...... Celia, Lede, retreat! Listen Ramza, If you want our stone, come to Limberry Castle! We'll be waiting...!
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The three disappears into the darkness.
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: Malak......
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Rafa sits beside Malak. Ramza watches them.
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: Brother, look...it's dawn. Remember how we used to chat till dawn about things? I wanted to travel with you. We were going to go to the Galthana's hometown after the war... Remember? Brother.... say something....
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Rafa starts to cry.
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: (Ramza's thought
outro.text: Alma...)
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The stone suddenly begins to glow.
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: What's this?
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Rafa brings out the stone.
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: It's responding to... Rafa's spirit.........? It grieves Malak's death......... Wiegraf's despair and resentment summoned Velius... Then...
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: You, too grieve his death? Thank you...
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: No, Rafa...its...
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The stone glows. A red beam of light comes down from the sky and enters Malak's body.
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: ...What?
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Malak moves.
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Malak
outro.text: Ugh....ugh...
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: Brother...Malak!!
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Malak looks up to see Rafa.
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Malak
outro.text: Rafa....? Where am I....? What happened....?
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Rafa hugs Malak by his neck.
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: Brother...brother... I'm so glad......
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Malak strangles for freedom.
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Malak
outro.text: That hurts, Rafa... Ha, ha, ha....
outro.title: Roof of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: There was no sign of Alma in the Castle. The only thing left was the shining "Pisces" stone.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Malak "Somebody called me... I don't know. I've never heard that voice..."
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Malak "The voice said, 'Return to the ones with the right mind..."
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza picks up the shining stone from the ground.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: The Zodiac Stone...here...?
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza "I didn't think the God made holy stones but...more evil... Well... Lucavi made them to hand in this world..."
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Malak "I guess it means whoever uses it will have to deal with the 'problem'..."
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Alma......
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Tired of the standstill, the Hokuten tried to capture Bethla Garrison by mobilizing the Knights at the front.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Malak
outro.text: The corpses were crushed by something real powerful.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: Was your sister one of them?
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: No...she wasn't.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Malak
outro.text: She was in this castle. Probably gone now... Only 3 Shrine Knights were here...No one else.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: I killed the one who turned into Lucavi. The other one, Izlude, was dead also... That means that the third one took my sister away...?
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Malak
outro.text: Maybe they went back to the main church at Murond. They're following the High Priest's orders, right? Then the Knight who took your sister must've gone to Murond.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: You think so? I doubt the High Priest knows the stone's secret. Wiegraf didn't know the secret until he contracted Velius... And I think that Izlude died fighting Lucavi.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Malak
outro.text: What do you mean?
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Secretly controlling the war, to strengthen the Church's power... I'm sure that's the High Priest's true ambition. But collecting the stones and using the Brave Legend to use the people...
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Malak
outro.text: You mean even the High Priest's being used?
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Rafa
outro.text: Who took your sister away?
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Malak
outro.text: I believe it was Vormav.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: He's probably behind it.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Malak
outro.text: What're you going to do?
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: I'm going to see Delita in Zeltennia.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Malak
outro.text: The one who replaced Baron Grims as leader of the Black Sheep Knights?
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Delita's being controlled by the Church and the Shrine Knights. Does Delita know the truth about Vormav?
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: To find Vormav and his real intentions, Ramza and his troop began a trip to Zeltennia.
outro.title: Inside of Riovanes Castle

intro.speaker: Chapter 4
intro.text: SOMEBODY TO LOVE
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: ```text I------------------------------------------------------------I |-- =-=-= =-= =-=-= =-= =-=- NEWS -=-= =-= =-=-= =-= =-=-= --| | Future of the War 2 | | Suffering through the long stalemate, Larg's Army began to | | mobilize. Over 80 percent of the Knights in the frontline | | were Hokuten when the march on Bethla began. Bethla was a | | strategic location for the invasion of Zeltennia.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: | | Occupying this area would mean an abundant food supply. | | This would either make or break the war effort for either | | side. | | Monster in Riovanes Castle | | There was an incident of an attack by an "Unidentified | | monster" at Lionel Castle. But now, it has occurred again | | at Riovanes Castle, home of Duke Barinten. Victims of the | | incident are said to number over 500.
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The image of | | people's crushed heads are etched into the minds of those | | who saw it. | I------------------------------------------------------------I ```
intro.title: Opening / transition

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Orlandu returns to Zeltennia Castle from the front.
intro.title: Zeltennia Castle

intro.speaker: Olan
intro.text: Welcome back, father!
intro.title: Zeltennia Castle

intro.speaker: Orlandu
intro.text: Yes...How are you, Olan?
intro.title: Zeltennia Castle

intro.speaker: Olan
intro.text: Fine. How was the front?
intro.title: Zeltennia Castle

intro.speaker: Orlandu
intro.text: You know, it's really horrible. You have to keep an eye on your own men...My reputation is shot...Ha, ha, ha.
intro.title: Zeltennia Castle

intro.speaker: Olan
intro.text: Hah... Your reputation? What about Goltana's? Everyone says it's because of you that the other generals are still here.
intro.title: Zeltennia Castle

intro.speaker: Orlandu
intro.text: Pledging life-long loyalty. That's the Orlandu way... Watch what you say.
intro.title: Zeltennia Castle

intro.speaker: Olan
intro.text: I'm sorry... I'll be careful from now on.
intro.title: Zeltennia Castle

intro.speaker: Orlandu
intro.text: Alright...what about the other matter?
intro.title: Zeltennia Castle

intro.speaker: Olan
intro.text: The crystal-like stone was found in Goug. Another was found by the late Cardinal at the end of the War. The Shrine Knight's have been active, but we don't know their plans yet.
intro.title: Zeltennia Castle

intro.speaker: Orlandu
intro.text: What about the spy we sent into Murond?
intro.title: Zeltennia Castle

intro.speaker: Olan
intro.text: Unfortunately... We'd like some proof of the High Priest's plot and move in to peace...
intro.title: Zeltennia Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Orlandu brings out the "Libra" stone.
intro.title: Zeltennia Castle

intro.speaker: Orlandu
intro.text: They'll find out sooner or later. Then there will be real war.
intro.title: Zeltennia Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: On their way to Zeltennia, Ramza and his troop comes to Doguola Pass.
intro.title: Doguola Pass

intro.speaker: Nanten Guard
intro.text: As long as we're here, you cannot pass.
intro.title: Doguola Pass

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The company wins the field and continues its journey.

missions.brief: Doguola · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: A sister’s accusation

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza meet a young lady while exploring the city.
intro.title: Bervenia Free City

intro.speaker: Meliadoul
intro.text: I'm Meliadoul! I came to avenge my brother!!
intro.title: Bervenia Free City

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Avenge your brother? What are you talking about?
intro.title: Bervenia Free City

intro.speaker: Meliadoul
intro.text: You're denying it!? Izlude, whom you killed at Riovanes, was my brother!! I'm going to kill you, not for the High Priest, but for my brother!!
intro.title: Bervenia Free City

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Wait! Izlude, I didn't kill him! Do you know What happened at Riovanes? That wasn't the doing of any human! Izlude was killed by Lucavi!
intro.title: Bervenia Free City

intro.speaker: Meliadoul
intro.text: Lucavi!? Lucavi appeared and killed my brother!? Ha, ha! That's pretty wild! Can't you come up with a better lie than that?
intro.title: Bervenia Free City

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: You're the same as Izlude! You don't know the truth! You don't realize you're just pathetic puppets, dancing for the bad guys!! The stones aren't just objects of faith, but have 'power' to work miracles! That 'power' is different for each side, but they're using it for evil! Wake up, Meliadoul!! Vormav's deceiving you!
intro.title: Bervenia Free City

intro.speaker: Meliadoul
intro.text: You expect me to believe that? Ridiculous!! Vormav is our father!!
intro.title: Bervenia Free City

intro.speaker: Meliadoul
intro.text: My brother really wanted to save this rotten kingdom! Our plans may be violent... but 'reform' requires 'pain'! If there's no 'pain', there's no true 'reform'!! A baby like you who can't even deal with your own fate can never change the world!
intro.title: Bervenia Free City

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: I beg you! Please trust me! I didn't kill your brother! I'm not the one you want to fight! Lucavi exists! Your father is no longer human! He's a devil, possessed by Lucavi!!
intro.title: Bervenia Free City

intro.speaker: Meliadoul
intro.text: Cut it out, Ramza!
intro.title: Bervenia Free City

outro.speaker: Meliadoul
outro.text: Ugh... You're...strong!! No wonder Wiegraf lost! Listen! The next time we meet is the day you die! Remember that!
outro.title: Bervenia Free City

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Having no weapon and armor, she flees into the darkness.
outro.title: Bervenia Free City

missions.brief: Bervenia · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: The red river

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: After resting at Bervenia Free City, Ramza and his troop comes at Finath River.
intro.title: Finath River

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: This river's deeper than I thought. Must be careful.
intro.title: Finath River

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The company wins the field and continues its journey.

missions.brief: Finath · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Delita in the church

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza prays inside the church. Delita walks inside and kneels beside Ramza.
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: A 'heretic', coming to Church...pretty bold...
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: I have no time...So, I'll ask you straight out. Why did the High Priest send you to Goltana?
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: You came to Zeltennia to ask me that? ...Fine, I'll tell you. My duty is to assassinate Goltana and Orlandu...
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: What...!?
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Shh...lower your voice. This is the real plan... We've trying to incite those dissatisfied with the government to revolt, Thereby causing people to distrust the government even more. Both armies will try to put down the revolts, but won't have enough soldiers. Then what? They'll finish things trying to break the deadlock.
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: All these recent revolts were the High Priest's plan. And to stop these, both armies are leading to Bethla. Everything is as you planned...
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Not quite yet. Because... During the battle Larg and Goltana will both be killed by someone. Of course the leaders will also be killed... Nantens' Orlandu, Hokutens' Zalbag, and Dycedarg... Losing their leaders, both armies will stop fighting and turn to peace...
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Then, the Church will become the 'mediator'...
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: And the people will support the Church entirely. They even threw in the Zodiac Brave Legend.
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: But the Zodiac Stone...
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Right now, you're the church's biggest obstacle.
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Aren't you trying to get the stones also?
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Delita stands up.
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: I'm not working for the Church!
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: What do you mean?
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: It means I'll kill you if I have to. Don't worry. Our reasons may be different, but we want the same thing. As long as we want the same thing...we won't be enemies.
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Come with me...
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Sorry, I can't. She needs me.
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: She...?
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Prince or Princess... It doesn't matter as long as they are easily controlled. The High Priest's plan calls for a puppet government.
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: You're just using Ovelia for your own ambitions?
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: ...I don't know. But...
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza stands up.
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: But what?
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: I would give my life for her...
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Delita...
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Is that strange?
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: No, I believe you.
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Suddenly a gunshot breaks the conversation between the two.
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Familiar Voice
intro.text: Ramza! The Church is surrounded!! Come out quietly!
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: That voice...It's Zalmo!?
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza and Delita goes out the church.
intro.title: Church in Zeltennia

intro.speaker: Zalmo
intro.text: You're the Black Knight, Hyral! Why are you here?
intro.title: Church outside the town

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Now that you've seen me, I cannot let you live! C'mon, Ramza!!
intro.title: Church outside the town

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: They're unknowingly part of the High Priest's plot! If you explain it well, they'd understand...
intro.title: Church outside the town

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Are you still so naive? ...Well, good luck!
intro.title: Church outside the town

intro.speaker: Zalmo
intro.text: Do you know what you're doing? He's a top criminal! Anyone who helps him is guilty, too! You, leader of the Black Knights, dare oppose the Trial Examiners?
intro.title: Church outside the town

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: I know who you are! That's why I must kill you all!
intro.title: Church outside the town

intro.speaker: Zalmo
intro.text: What!? You audacious fool!! Your actions will disrupt the world order and oppose God's Natural Providence!! Are you trying to rebel against God!?
intro.title: Church outside the town

intro.speaker: Delita
intro.text: Disrupt the 'order'? This 'order' you talk about is just a matter of your own convenience!! Using God as an 'order' to control the people is absurd! You have no right to take advantage of the innocent!!
intro.title: Church outside the town

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: I don't care about God! I just want you to see the 'truth'!
intro.title: Church outside the town

intro.speaker: Zalmo
intro.text: 'Truth'? Are you saying this is not 'truth'? You had a chance to clear the charges in the Cardinal murder/Zodiac Stone robbery. But you blew it by running away! That proved your guilt! We've already decided you're guilty and sentenced you! It's too late to say anything!
intro.title: Church outside the town

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Then I guess I must fight!!
intro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Zalmo
outro.text: Oh, God...please punish the wicked.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Zalmo falls down on the ground, dead.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: What're you going to do, Ramza?
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: I had 2 reasons for coming to Zeltennia. One was to see you. The other is to see Count Orlandu.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Thundergod Cid?
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: I want his cooperation to uncover the Church's plot.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: How?
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: I have strong 'proof' that will uncover the wrong- doing.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: The 'Germonik scriptures'!
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: When I met Olan, the Count's son-in-law, He promised me if I had proof, he would stop the High Priest's conspiracy.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Olan, huh?
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: A young lady appears from the shadows.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: It's ok... She's one of us. Several people were sent from Murond to help me. She's one of them.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Magician Woman
outro.text: Help...? More like to keep an eye on you.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Hey, c'mon. She knows everything. She's the only one we can trust in the Goltana Army.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Magician Woman
outro.text: You're the youngest Beoulve, Ramza, right? My name is Balmafula. Nice to meet you.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: And...what do you want?
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Balmafula
outro.text: The Hokuten are moving.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Is Ft. Bethla the target?
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The woman nods.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Balmafula
outro.text: Count Orlandu left for Bethla a while ago. Goltana's heading for Bethla... along with your Black Sheep Knights.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: A little too late... The battle won't end...
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: I'm not giving up. I'll persuade the Count before any more die.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: ...I guess it's good bye, Ramza.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Stay alive, Delita.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: You too...
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita walks over to Ramza and stretches out his hand. Ramza and Delita shakes hands. Ramza then disappears into the shadows.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Balmafula
outro.text: You're letting him go?
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: I know what he'll do.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Balmafula
outro.text: You even use your friends.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Shut up! What do you know?
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Balmafula
outro.text: I hate people like you.
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Hurry up and go!!
outro.title: Church outside the town

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Balmafula leaves.
outro.title: Church outside the town

missions.brief: Zeltennia · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Poison in the sand

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza and his troop heads for Bethla. Along the way, the party comes across Bed Desert.
intro.title: Bed Desert

intro.speaker: Balk
intro.text: ...They're all spread? Nice wind. Should be enough to float them around in the air for most of the day.
intro.title: Bed Desert

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza and his troop comes out.
intro.title: Bed Desert

intro.speaker: Balk
intro.text: Uh-oh...Didn't think I'd see you here...
intro.title: Bed Desert

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: What are the Shrine Knights doing here? You said, "spread"... What the hell did you spread?
intro.title: Bed Desert

intro.speaker: Balk
intro.text: Wanna know...? I guess I can tell you because there's nothing you can do now.
intro.title: Bed Desert

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Spill it! What did you spread?
intro.title: Bed Desert

intro.speaker: Balk
intro.text: This!
intro.title: Bed Desert

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The Temple Knight throws some kind of an orb at the troop. The orb explodes spreading poison on the troop.
intro.title: Bed Desert

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Poison!?
intro.title: Bed Desert

intro.speaker: Balk
intro.text: That's right. I spread this to the Hokuten Province. Any soldier who inhales this will be too sick to fight!
intro.title: Bed Desert

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: The High Priest doesn't want Goltana to win the war!
intro.title: Bed Desert

intro.speaker: Balk
intro.text: That's correct. If the Hokuten can't fight their best, the Nanten will open the fortress... Totally annihilating it. Making it a good chance to kill Goltana and Orlandu. Of course, plans are set to kill Larg in the confusion. It'll probably be easier to kill him in the confusion over the poisoning.
intro.title: Bed Desert

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: What!?
intro.title: Bed Desert

intro.speaker: Balk
intro.text: You should be happy! The war will end! From now on, we'll be the center of authority! The people want that! No more of you aristocrats ruling the kingdom.
intro.title: Bed Desert

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: I won't let that happen! I'll end the war differently!
intro.title: Bed Desert

intro.speaker: Balk
intro.text: I knew you'd say that!
intro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Balk
outro.text: Dammit! I'm not going to die in a place like this.
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Can't resist the pain, Balk falls down on the ground and dies.
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: I have to hurry...
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Meanwhile... Nanten Knights tries to capture Orlandu.
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Count Orlandu
outro.text: What do you mean? Suspicion of conspiracy?
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Nanten Knight
outro.text: ...Please. Obey the roder.
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Orlandu
outro.text: Nonsense. Why would I be involved in a conspiracy?
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Goltana enters the room.
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: It's too bad, Cid. Attempting rebellion...
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Orlandu
outro.text: You can't be serious? I'd never think of...
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: I have proof. You've been secretly planning with the Church to overthrow me.
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Orlandu
outro.text: Nonsense!! Who told you such a lie!?
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: You still deny it? Hearing of your betrayal, the High Priest notified me personally.
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Orlandu
outro.text: It's the High Priest's plot!
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: The High Priest's plot? How dare you say that? Can you prove it?
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Orlandu
outro.text: I've been serving you over 20 years and you don't trust me?
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: ...I cannot go to war without your Knights. I am very disappointed, Cid... Take him away!!
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Orlandu gets taken way by the knights. Delita and Balmafula enters the room and kneels down before Goltana.
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Yes, Your Excellency.
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: Continue your contact with Murond. If we get an official edict, overturning Larg will be easy.
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: The High Priest's already decided. No need to worry.
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: Thanks for your trouble. I will grand you command over the Nanten Knights. You will become a Holy Knight.
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: I appreciate your kindness!
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: I'm counting on you, Delita. I know I can trust you.
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: I won't let you down.
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza and his troop finally comes at Bethla Garrison.
outro.title: Bed Desert

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: (If you chose south wall)
outro.title: Bed Desert

missions.brief: Bed Desert · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Bethla: the northern approach

intro.speaker: Knight
intro.text: I never thought Hokuten would attack from the front! We'll get them all at once! Attack!!
intro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: We have to do something before the armies collide!
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The Hokutens fell one by one from Balk's poison. It eventually got to Dycedarg and Larg.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Zalbag's Voice
outro.text: What happened here!?
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Zalbag appears at the scene and sees the dead bodies of the Hokuten Knights. Zalbag makes his way over to a poisoned knight.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Are you ok!? Pull yourself together!!
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The female knight coughs.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Hokuten Knight
outro.text: I, I'm fine... just my head...hurts.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The knight falls down.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Hey, get a grip!
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Dycedarg comes out.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Mosfungus poison has been spread in the air...
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Dycedarg falls on his knee. Zalbag helps his brother.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Brother!
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Don't worry, I'm alright... Where's is His Excellency?
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: We don't know.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Larg's Voice
outro.text: ...Here, Zalbag... Dycedarg...
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Zalbag and Dycedarg comes up and sees Larg lying on the ground
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: You Excellency!! Call the Chemist!!
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Dycedarg makes his way over to Larg.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: ...How do you feel?
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Larg
outro.text: My head hurts... I feel sick... But...I'll be alright. I'll feel better in a while.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: That's a problem.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Larg
outro.text: What?
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Zalbag brings out a dagger and stabs Larg.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Larg
outro.text: Urrgh!! Wha...What is this!?
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Brother!!
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Larg struggles. Dycedarg pushes the dagger deeper into Larg's body.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Quiet, Zalbag!
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Larg
outro.text: You...betraying me...? You killed Balbanes... not only to inherit the Beoulve estate... But, to kill...me...
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Dycedarg pulls out the dagger from Larg's body. Larg spits out bloods. Dycedarg stands up, breathing heavily. More blood trickles down from Larg's mouth. Larg dies.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Brother...No... Did you... 'poison'?
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Ugh...Ugh...... Not me. It was done by the allies who want Beoulve to take center stage...
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Why have they...
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Duke Larg died in battle, but we'll carry on his will...
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: But, the plot...
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Just put a dagger into one of their hands... He's the assassin sent by the Nanten. Alright...?
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Dycedarg falls down.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Brother!!
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

missions.brief: Bethla · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: The two sluice gates

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Oh! This floodgate! If I open it and release the water, they want be able to fight! How do I open the floodgate? Probably by pulling the levers on both sides! I think I see them...but first I have to get there...
intro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza pulls the lever. The water gates opens, pouring out water. Breaking the water gates at Bethla, Larg and Goltana's attack were avoided. Olan, Ramza and Balmafula made their way to save Orlandu.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: Father!!
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The three enters the cell.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: Father! You're safe!!
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza and Balmafula kneels down.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Orlandu
outro.text: Yes, I'm fine. You must be Ramza. You've grown. I recognized you.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: You know me?
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Orlandu
outro.text: Of course. It's no wonder you don't remember me. You were only 3 or 4 years old when I last saw you. You were almost hurt, trying to hold my sword. Your father scolded you and you cried... Ha, ha, ha. Thank you for coming. Both of you can relax now.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza and Balmafula gets up on their feet.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: There were minimal losses from both sides. Thanks to Ramza, we were able to avoid all-out war.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Orlandu
outro.text: Is that so? Balbanes sure has a fine son. Let me thank you on behalf of everyone, Ramza.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: No need for thanks. I only did what was natural.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Orlandu
outro.text: You've inherited Balbanes' soul. He should be pleased...
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Balmafula
outro.text: With your permission... Goltana's planning to kill you tomorrow. Please escape.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: Father, what she says is true. For now, let's...
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Orlandu
outro.text: I know...I can't stay here while Goltana's like that. Olan, my son... this battle will end soon. I'll go with him. I must stop the High Priest, no matter what...
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: Father, I'll go with you!!
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Orlandu
outro.text: No. You must return to Zeltennia and protect Ovelia. Ovelia is the rightful heir to the throne of the kingdom. It is your duty to protect her. Do you understand?
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: ...Yes.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Orlandu
outro.text: Alright, Ramza?
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Of course.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Orlandu
outro.text: Then, let's go before someone sees us.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Angry from the failure, Goltana ordered Delita to come.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: What's this!? Who opened the floodgate?
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita enters the room and kneels down before Goltana.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Yes, Your Excellency?
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: Gather the soldiers and attack the Hokuten!
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: We can't even move because of the water.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: Neither can they. And that's our edge! Now is our chance to make them think we won't attack! We must move now...
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: That's not a good idea.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: What!?
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita drew his sword and charged at Goltana. With one motion, the sword struck home.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Goltana
outro.text: Oh...y, you...!
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Nobody's wants you to be King!!
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita pulls out his sword. Blood pours out from Goltana's body as he falls down on the ground, dead.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Come in!
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Balmafula comes in, along with Orlandu. Orlandu falls on his knees before Delita.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: You understand, your death won't be waste.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Grevados as 'Cid'
outro.text: Everything's guided by the will of St. Ajora...
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita stabs his sword through his body. He then pulls out his word and puts the sword in his sheath. The fake Orlandu silently fells on the ground.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Balmafula
outro.text: The real Cid and Ramza have escaped.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Good...Pray that Ramza will take care of the rest.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Having lost their leaders, the High Priest proposed a mediator for the armies. But, since they were both still strong, they refused.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: I headed for Limberry looking for Alma...
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: On their way, at Zarghidas.
outro.title: In front of Bethla Garrison's Sluice

missions.brief: Bethla Sluice · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: The heights of Germinas

intro.speaker: Bandit Boss
intro.text: If you wanna pass, leave your money. And get yer hand offa that sword if you wanna live!
intro.title: Germinas Peak

intro.speaker: Bandit
intro.text: Boss! This guy's wanted! Yeah...with a huge bounty! May be it's better to kill him and get the reward, than to take their money now.
intro.title: Germinas Peak

intro.speaker: Bandit Boss
intro.text: Yeah, I saw his face on a wanted poster. We're no bounty hunters, but what the hell... Let's kill him for the gil!!
intro.title: Germinas Peak

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The company wins the field and continues its journey.

missions.brief: Germinas · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: The still waters of Poeskas

intro.speaker: Poeskas Lake Ghost
intro.text: Who disturbs our sleep...? ......!! You have the Zodiac Stones...? Then, hand it over...! With that, we can go to a higher dimension...!!
intro.title: Poeskas Lake

outro.speaker: Rofel
outro.text: I see you have no intention of agreeing with our arbitration.
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: That's right. His Excellency's wish to unify the kingdoms... Rather, until King Orinas is recognized as the true king, we won't stop fighting. As long as the Beoulves lives, we won't give up.
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Rofel
outro.text: Who do you think let you assassinate Duke!?
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: What a thing to say... Larg was killed by someone sent by the Nanten. Or... are you saying you sent the assassin...?
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: So you're definitely not going to cooperate?
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: If we wanted to, we could easily beat you. Don't forget that...
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: 'Us'? Do you remember what the 'poison' was that took out the Hokuten?
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: I think it was extracted from Mosfungus...
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Right. Unless you take large doses, it won't kill you. But even small amounts over a long time, can be deadly.
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Rofel
outro.text: Over time, you develop symptoms similar to a cold. You're not fully aware of your conditions until it's too late...
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Rofel
outro.text: Didn't your father die from cold complications?
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: What are you saying?
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Rofel
outro.text: I heard you know a lot about poison...
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: So...what are you saying?
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Rofel
outro.text: If you bury a body with Mosfungus... The Mosfungus begins to grow out of the body. Did you know that?
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Rofel
outro.text: Such trivial things... Oh yeah, I've got something for you from the High Priest.
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The Temple Knight brings out a shining stone and puts it on the table. The stone glows.
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: What's this?
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Rofel
outro.text: It's a holy Zodiac Stone, from Murond. He'd like you to have this to show his trust in you...
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The stone glows again. Zalbag is seen behind the door listening to the conversation. Meanwhile, Ramza and his troop comes at the gate of Limberry Castle.
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

missions.brief: Poeskas · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Limberry: the demon gate

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Nobody here...Are these ruins really deserted? The entrance is open...
intro.title: At the gate of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza makes his way near the entrance.
intro.title: At the gate of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Something's not right... This feels like the time I faced Queklain and Velius...
intro.title: At the gate of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Lady's Voice
intro.text: Welcome to Limberry Castle.
intro.title: At the gate of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: A young lady appears from the gate above.
intro.title: At the gate of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Celia
intro.text: We've been waiting for you.
intro.title: At the gate of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Lady's Voice
intro.text: We have a warm welcome for you.
intro.title: At the gate of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Lede appears from the darkness.
intro.title: At the gate of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Lede
intro.text: We'll burn you to death. So don't run away.
intro.title: At the gate of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Demons appears from the darkness.
intro.title: At the gate of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Damn! A trap!!
intro.title: At the gate of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Celia
outro.text: If you want your dear sister back, be brave and enter!
outro.title: At the gate of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Lede
outro.text: We'll be waiting inside. Hurry up!
outro.title: At the gate of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Celia and Lede disappears.
outro.title: At the gate of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Alma!!
outro.title: At the gate of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Vormav and Elmdor had a meeting.
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Elmdor
outro.text: Velius and Queklain are both gone... We're the only ones alive now. Adramelk's caught in the 'loophole'...
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Vormav
outro.text: Don't worry about him. He'll soon be summoned to the 'other side'...
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Elmdor
outro.text: Did they find a suitable 'body' for him?
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Vormav
outro.text: Yes, the Zodiac Stone chose one. Just as 'they' chose 'us', the stones will choose the 'body'!
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Elmdor gets up from his seat and walks over to the window.
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Elmdor
outro.text: Really... Now we have to bring back 'Bloody Angel', using the 'Ultimate Power'! ...Then even without the stones or a suitable 'body', we can come and go at will. Did they find a good 'body' for 'Angel'? Don't tell me it's that girl...
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Vormav
outro.text: There's only one 'body' suitable for 'Angel'...That girl. Now we must find the "Way to the Dead City".
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Celia appears.
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Celia
outro.text: He's here.
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Lede also appears.
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Lede
outro.text: I lured him into the castle. What shall I do with him?
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Elmdor
outro.text: I've been waiting for you, Ramza. Payback time for what happened at Riovanes...
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Vormav
outro.text: Be careful, he's strong. He even beat Velius.
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Elmdor
outro.text: Don't worry about me. Let me handle it. Go find the "Way to the Dead City".
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Vormav
outro.text: Ok. Be careful.
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Vormav disappears.
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Elmdor
outro.text: Alright, I'm going!
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

missions.brief: Limberry · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Limberry: the marquis

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza and his squad comes before Elmdor, Lede and Celia.
intro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Elmdor
intro.text: It's payback time for all the disgrace from Riovanes Castle!
intro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Alma...where's my sister? Where is she!?
intro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Elmdor
intro.text: You'll have to beat me to find out!
intro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Elmdor
outro.text: Ugh...you're strong... I thought you'd be strong... but with this 'body'. I can't seem to...
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Elmdor vanishes.
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Elmdor Underground...Come down... Your sister is there...
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: You're not getting away!!
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza and his troop hurried down to Limberry Castle's underground and finds Elmdor.
outro.title: Inside of Limberry Castle

missions.brief: Limberry · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Limberry: the dead angel

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Elmdor! Give up! You don't have a chance! Let Alma go!
intro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Elmdor
intro.text: Oh, you fool... She's not in this castle! The only ones here are the spirits of the dead...
intro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The dead arises from their coffins.
intro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Elmdor
intro.text: Your life shall also end, here in this graveyard!
intro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Elmdor, using the stone's power, turns into Zalera, the demon.
intro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Zalera
intro.text: Let's settle this once and for all...!
intro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Meliadoul enters the room.
intro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Meliadoul
intro.text: What? The Marquis -- a monster? This...is the power of the Zodiac Stone?
intro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Now you know what I said was true! Your brother Izlude died because he found the truth and fought them!
intro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Meliadoul
intro.text: Oh...my God! Does Father...Vormav know that?
intro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Well...
intro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Zalera
intro.text: Ha, ha, ha... So, you're Vormav's daughter? Just like Izlude, you 'body' isn't suitable for us... But your father's was...
intro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Meliadoul
intro.text: Then, father was...!
intro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Zalera
intro.text: Yes, he's no longer your father. He's now a blood member of Darkness. But no matter...For now you, and Ramza will die here!
intro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Meliadoul
intro.text: What you said was true... I'm sorry...
intro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: It's ok, Meliadoul. Let's avenge Izlude!
intro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Zalera
outro.text: Hashmalum...sorry. I'm leaving the rest to you...
outro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: With that the demon exploded leaving the stone on the ground. Ramza picks up the stone. Meliadoul brings out a holy stone from her pocket.
outro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Meliadoul
outro.text: Secret's hidden in this Stone... I never dreamed! It may be 'divine', but I thought it was just a strange rock. I never thought collecting them would make a miracle.
outro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The stone glows.
outro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Neither you nor Izlude were informed... Even Wiegraf didn't know until he turned Lucavi. So even the High Priest's plot's being used by Vormav.
outro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Meliadoul
outro.text: What're they after?
outro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza shakes his head.
outro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: That, I don't know. If they want to, they could destroy an entire brigade. Just like at Riovanes. But they don't use that power outright. There must be a reason why.
outro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Meliadoul
outro.text: Maybe they can't use their power outright? The Lucavi of legend, was an unbeatable, ferocious monster.
outro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: That's right. They don't seem to be the 'immortal evils' the legends say.
outro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Meliadoul
outro.text: Legends do tend to over exaggerate. Maybe Lucavi was just another monster, after all.
outro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: I hope so...
outro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Meliadoul hands the stone to Ramza.
outro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Meliadoul
outro.text: I'm going to give you this Zodiac Stone. In return, let me go along. I want to know why my father... Besides...
outro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Besides?
outro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Meliadoul
outro.text: I want to know why he gave away the 'Capricorn' Stone. Why it was given to Lord Dycedarg... I need to know.
outro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: To my brother? Why?
outro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza headed for Igros to find some answers.
outro.title: Underground cemetery of Limberry Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ovelia stood near the window. Suddenly the sound of battle broke the silence in the room.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Harsh Voice
outro.text: Where did he escape to?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Another Voice
outro.text: You search over there! He was wounded trying to escape! He must still be near!
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Olan, covered with blood, enters the room where Ovelia is.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Queen Ovelia
outro.text: Olan!! Are you ok!? What an awful wound. Be strong...
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: Ovelia, your Highness... I must tell you...
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: Don't speak...
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: Please... Listen to me... My stepfather Orlandu didn't murder Lord Goltana... Suspected of conspiracy, my stepfather escaped Bethla with Ramza Beoulve... Now, he's fighting to stop the High Priest's evil plot.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: I trusted Uncle not to start any rebellious moment...
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Harsh Boice
outro.text: No good! The door won't open!
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Another Voice
outro.text: Highness! Are you safe!?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Voice
outro.text: Please! Open this door!
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: Then...who? Who killed Lord Goltana?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: It was...
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The two knight breaks the door and comes in.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Nanten Knight
outro.text: Your Highness... Are you alright?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Nanten Knight
outro.text: Here he is!!
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita enters the room. The two knights falls down on their knees.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: You there, leave this room.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Nanten Knight
outro.text: Huh?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: I said, leave this room!
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Nanten Knight
outro.text: B, But...
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: I'll not say it again!
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Nanten Knight
outro.text: Y, Yes...
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The two knights leaves the room. Balmafula enters the room. Delita walks over at Olan.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: Please! Don't be rough on Olan!
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Such a foolish thing you did, Olan.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: You...traitor.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Oh, please. You know you wanted this too. Look around. See anyone who's really saddened? You should thank me for 'killing' your father...now nobody will be after him.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: Stop that nonsense!
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: Why, Why did you do such a thing?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: I told you I'd make you into a real monarch.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: You liar! You're just trying to use me!
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: You don't trust me?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Well...Ovelia?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: I'd like to trust you... But...
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: I must talk to Olan. Go to your room...
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Ovelia
outro.text: Please... Be gentle with him...
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Ok. I promise...
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ovelia goes down, slams her room's door and secretly eavesdrops the conversation.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: I don't care. All I wanted was to clear my stepfather. Do it in one deathblow...
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: What are you talking about? I can't have you dead.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: What am I worth to you alive?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: You'll work under me.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: Ha, ha, ha. Don't be a fool. I refuse, even if it means death!
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: You cannot refuse. I'll bring down the Hokuten and build Ovelia's kingdom. Of course I'll kill the High Priest. I'm not his dog.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: Are you serious? What the hell...?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: I'm sure you know I'm right. What I'm planing to do is completely justified. A former squire, now in control of Knights, and restoring order to the world. It's easy to understand. This's the 'hero' the people have been demanding.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Olan
outro.text: For that, you're going to take advantage of everything?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Is that wrong?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ovelia, in disbelieve, runs in to her room. Hearing Delita's words Balmafula steps forward.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: What's the matter? Want to kill me? I know the High Priest sent you as an 'assassin'! And if I betray you, you'll kill me, right?
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Delita slowly walks at Balmafula. Balmafula steps back and draws a small dagger.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: Delita
outro.text: Go on... Stab me with that dagger. What's the matter? Go on... If you don't kill me... I'll kill you!
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The screen fades. The sound of scream is heard.
outro.title: Inside of Zeltennia Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: After listening to the secret meeting between Rofel and Dycedarg. As Rofel said, there is a poisonous mushroom, Mosfungus, growing in the ground. Learning this, Zalbag headed to his father's resting place at the graveyard.
outro.title: Graveyard

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: This way...
outro.title: Graveyard

outro.speaker: Chemist
outro.text: Mister, wait...
outro.title: Graveyard

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Father... Come here. I'd like you to see something...
outro.title: Graveyard

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Zalbag picks up a mushroom from Balbanes's tomb.
outro.title: Graveyard

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: This...
outro.title: Graveyard

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: He throws the mushroom at the chemist.
outro.title: Graveyard

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Do you know what that is?
outro.title: Graveyard

outro.speaker: Chemist
outro.text: Of course! This is the Mosfungus, a Mushroom. It's poison isn't that deadly, though.
outro.title: Graveyard

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: No wonder...
outro.title: Graveyard

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The chemist throws the mushroom away.
outro.title: Graveyard

outro.speaker: Chemist
outro.text: Mister... We'd best be going.
outro.title: Graveyard

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Why are you so scared?
outro.title: Graveyard

outro.speaker: Chemist
outro.text: Don't you know? Mosfungus only grows on corpses... And tombs with Mosfungus corpses are major bad luck. They say Mosfungused corpses mean the end with that family's generation.
outro.title: Graveyard

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Ok... You may go now.
outro.title: Graveyard

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Zalbag throws a coin at the chemist.
outro.title: Graveyard

outro.speaker: Chemist
outro.text: Heh, heh...thanks, mister.
outro.title: Graveyard

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: You must keep this a secret.
outro.title: Graveyard

outro.speaker: Chemist
outro.text: I will.
outro.title: Graveyard

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The chemist disappears into the darkness.
outro.title: Graveyard

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Father...
outro.title: Graveyard
