missions.name: Igros: a brother’s crime

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza stood in front gate of Igros Castle.
intro.title: At the gate of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: ...No guards. Strange...
intro.title: At the gate of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza sees a chocobo standing next to the gate.
intro.title: At the gate of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: This Chocobo is my brother Zalbag's...
intro.title: At the gate of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza goes near the gate.
intro.title: At the gate of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: That's it.
intro.title: At the gate of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza enters Igros Castle.
intro.title: At the gate of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: After finding out that Dycedarg had murdered Balbanes. Zalbag went to Igros Castle to avenge his father's death. After seeing Dycedarg inside the castle, Zalbag knocks his brother down on the floor and draws his sword.
intro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: Dycedarg
intro.text: Zalbag! Have you gone crazy? What's this all about!?
intro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: Zalbag
intro.text: Brother...and you call yourself a Beoulve?
intro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: Dycedarg
intro.text: You mean Duke Larg? He'd have died anyway! Think about it. He couldn't even fight without relying on others for help! It was a mistake for anybody like him to even start a war!
intro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: Zalbag
intro.text: It's bad to kill one's lord, but my father... I'll never forgive that. Why him? Why'd you have to kill him?
intro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: Dycedarg
intro.text: What? I don't know what you're talking about!
intro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: Zalbag
intro.text: The Duke's dying words... I couldn't believe them! Why, brother!? Why did you kill father!?
intro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Hokuten Knight comes out.
intro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: Hokuten Knight
intro.text: Dycedarg!!
intro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: Dycedarg
intro.text: Zalbag's insane!!
intro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: More knights comes in and surrounds Zalbag. Dycedarg gets up on his feet.
intro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: Dycedarg
intro.text: Capture him!
intro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: Zalbag
intro.text: Brother!!
intro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Zalbag!!
intro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: Zalbag
intro.text: Ramza! You were right! Our brother's started a war and killed Larg to satisfy his own ambition! This is disgraceful and cannot be forgiven!!
intro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Zalbag!!
intro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: If only you hadn't interfered... Ivalice would've been ours, the Beoulve's... You fools...
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Dycedarg falls down on the ground. Suddenly Dycedarg changes into a demon. The stone shines and disappears.
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Adramelk
outro.text: Heh, heh...So that's it...Now I know... Young fool. Here's a souvenir for you on the way to Hell. I killed Balbanes... Yes, I did it... The Beoulve's finally had their chance to rule... But he blew it! That idiot! So I killed him... Even a sword master can't fight poison!
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Adramelk uses his power against Zalbag. Zalbag feels a sharp pain all over his body. Using the stone's power Adramelk destroys Zalbag in front of Ramza.
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Adramelk
outro.text: Now it's your turn... You'll regret opposing me!
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

banter.speaker: Dycedarg
banter.text: Fools! Why won't you obey? Why do you defy me? The powerful must rule the powerless ones! It's our duty! Even the once mighty Royal Family has fallen and lost their power! It's only natural for us to take their place! It's the right way to use our power!! Why can't you understand!?
banter.title: Inside of Igros Castle

banter.speaker: Zalbag
banter.text: Don't you have any 'justice', Brother!? The Beoulve name is only for the brave! You aren't worthy of it, Brother!
banter.title: Inside of Igros Castle

banter.speaker: Dycedarg
banter.text: 'Justice'? I'm embarrassed to think you even said that! You think such pretty ideals can govern the people!? Why are you able to use that sword? Why do you think the people call you a hero? It's all because of me!! Because I dirtied my hands you're here! You should be thanking me, not despising me!!
banter.title: Inside of Igros Castle

missions.brief: Igros · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Igros: Adramelk

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Zalbag! The stone has taken him. We have to stop this.

outro.speaker: Adramelk
outro.text: Shit! It's still not right. If only 'Bloody Ange;' were here this wouldn't have happened...
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: With that the demon disappeared with the lightning. The holy stone fell on the ground.
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: This is the end of the Beoulve's... Names don't matter... What's important is how you live your life. Alma... I must save Alma!
outro.title: Inside of Igros Castle

missions.brief: Igros · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Murond: the temple grounds

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Losing many allies and having many stones stolen, Vormav commenced an attack on the High Priest. After killing the High Priest's bodyguard, Vormav puts his sword straight through the High Priest's body.
intro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Funeral
intro.text: You're...betraying...me...
intro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Vormav pulls out his sword from Funeral's body.
intro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: If you'd confessed all, I'd have kept you alive. I didn't mean to take such drastic measures, but I don't have much time left.
intro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Funeral
intro.text: Wha, What do you mean?
intro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: I was going along with you to get the Zodiac Stone... But now that the kid took most of them, it was all for nothing.
intro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: The High Priest stretches out his hand to beg mercy.
intro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Funeral
intro.text: S...Spare me...
intro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: That wound is deep, but not fatal. If you treat it soon, you'll be ok. Now, if you value your life, tell me where the entrance to Murond is!!
intro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Funeral
intro.text: Orbonne...A sealed Magic Square at the bottom of the underground library.
intro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: How do I break the seal?
intro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Funeral
intro.text: I don't know...it might be written in the scriptures.
intro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Vormav slaps Funeral's hand.
intro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: That kid again!
intro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Vormav eye signals Rofel, who's standing behind Funeral, holding a katana.
intro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: I'm through with you.
intro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Vormav leaves the room along with Kletian. Funeral stretches his hand out again.
intro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Funeral
intro.text: Please...spare me.
intro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Rofel lifts the katana and stabs it on Funeral's back. Meanwhile, Ramza and his troop stood before St. Murond Temple.
intro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Shrine Knight Magician
intro.text: Stop! Only the Priest is allowed in here! What business do you have at Murond Temple? Identify yourself!!
intro.title: St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: My name is Ramza, Ramza Beoulve! I'm here for my sister, Alma Beoulve, who was kidnapped by Vormav!
intro.title: St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Magician
intro.text: Heresy Ramza!! What a fool to come so openly! I will execute your sentence here and now!!
intro.title: St. Murond Temple

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Alma...I'm coming! Just hold on...!!
outro.title: St. Murond Temple

missions.brief: Murond · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Murond: the templars

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza and his party sttod before the three shrine knights; Vormav, Rofel and Kletian.
intro.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: So, you're Ramza... Nice meeting you... I'd ask you to dinner, but I'm too busy... Forgive me. I don't have too much time. So, let me get down to business. If you want your sister, give me the Germonik scriptures and all the Zodiac Stones. If you don't do what I say, your lovely sister is dead. Now, hand them over!!
intro.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Where's Alma? Unless you show me her now, I'll not hand over the scriptures or the stones!
intro.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: Didn't you hear me? You have no choice. I'll say it again. Hand them over!
intro.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza steps forward and brings out the Germonik scriptures.
intro.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Only the scriptures! I'll give you the stone only after I see Alma!
intro.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza puts the book down on the ground and slowly walks away. Rofel steps up and picks up the book. He then flips the pages.
intro.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: Well?
intro.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Rofel
intro.text: ....It's here. It's a simple curse.
intro.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: Good, now that we know, they're finished. I could let him go, but I'll get revenge for Velius and the others.
intro.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: You deceived me!!
intro.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

outro.speaker: Vormav
outro.text: I won't be beaten here. I must escape!
outro.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Vormav and co. escapes.
outro.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Running away? Coward!
outro.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza and his party goes after Vormav and catches up with him.
outro.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: Why do you let Alma live?
banter.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

banter.speaker: Vormav
banter.text: What?
banter.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: You even killed your own son. Why do you keep Alma alive?
banter.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

banter.speaker: Vormav
banter.text: That's none of your affair. If you want to know, kill me.
banter.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

banter.speaker: Meliadoul
banter.text: Father... Are you really my father?
banter.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

banter.speaker: Vormav
banter.text: Of course, dear daughter. Why are you over 'there'? When did you become the enemy?
banter.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

banter.speaker: Meliadoul
banter.text: That's because you're not the father who used to be.
banter.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

banter.speaker: Vormav
banter.text: What do you mean?
banter.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

banter.speaker: Meliadoul
banter.text: At Limberry, Marquis Elmdor used the Zodiac Stones to turn into a monster. Father, wasn't it you who killed the people at Riovanes Castle and also Izlude?
banter.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

banter.speaker: Vormav
banter.text: You're saying we're monsters?
banter.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

banter.speaker: Meliadoul
banter.text: !! You're not my father...
banter.title: Hall of St. Murond Temple

missions.brief: Murond · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Murond: the last Beoulve

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: No more time to waste... I want to end this now, but you probably won't go quietly... I'm afraid your life must end here. My servants will be your opponents. A coffin...just the thing for you. Rest in peace.
intro.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Vormav using the stone's power, summons demons.
intro.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: This man will be your opponent...
intro.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Zalbag appears.
intro.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Zalbag!!
intro.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: He maybe your brother, but he's joined our family. Think you can fight with him? Ha, ha...
intro.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Vormav disappears into the darkness laughing.
intro.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Dirty --!!
intro.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Vormav's Voice
intro.text: Zalbag, kill the boy before you! Don't let him leave this temple alive!!
intro.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Brother! Zalbag!! It's me!!
intro.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Zalbag
intro.text: Is that you, Ramza...? What...am I doing? Can't feel a thing...
intro.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: You're being controlled by Lucavi!!
intro.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Zalbag
intro.text: I'm...fighting...you? Why...? Go Ramza, Run! Or else...I might...kill you.
intro.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: Brother!!
intro.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: I'm so sorry, Ramza... to make you...suffer. Save...Alma... You're the only one... who can... I...have to go now...Goodbye...Ramza... Thank you......
outro.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Zalbag falls down on the ground and vanishes.
outro.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Zalbaaaaaag!!
outro.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza goes further inside the temple. Meanwhile, the old man lay on the ground, a katana still quivering in his back. His bodyguards were on the ground dead as a stone.
outro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

outro.speaker: (Funeral's thoughts
outro.text: ...somebody...)
outro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza enters the room.
outro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: How awful.
outro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

outro.speaker: Funeral
outro.text: Help...hel...p...
outro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Hold on...hold on!
outro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

outro.speaker: Funeral
outro.text: Sh...shr...shrine...
outro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: You know where they went? Where? Where did they go?
outro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

outro.speaker: Funeral
outro.text: Or...Orbon...ne...
outro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Breathing his last breath, the High Priest Funeral died.
outro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Orbonne Monastery...
outro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza and his party heads to Orbonne to stop Vormav.
outro.title: Inside of St. Murond Temple

banter.speaker: Zalbag
banter.text: Please...Ramza. Kill...me... I'm in pain...no feeling in my hands and feet, yet it hurts...all over... The scariest part is... I'm slowly losing my memory.
banter.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: You'll be ok, Zalbag!! I'm sure there's a way! So, don't give up!! Please, don't give up!
banter.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

banter.speaker: Zalbag
banter.text: No, hurry up and... kill me...I'm in pain... I hear voices...talking...crying...calling...taunting. Do something...Help me...Hurry and...kill me.
banter.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: Damn that Vormav!!
banter.title: Chapel of St. Murond Temple

missions.brief: Murond · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Orbonne: fourth-floor descent

intro.speaker: Rofel
intro.text: Stay and stand guard!! I'll go after Vormav!!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage Fourth Floor

intro.speaker: Shrine Knight
intro.text: Yes, sir!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage Fourth Floor

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Rofel goes down after Vormav. Ramza and his troop arrives.
intro.title: Underground Book Storage Fourth Floor

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: What's in this underground library?
intro.title: Underground Book Storage Fourth Floor

outro.speaker: Rofel
outro.text: Leave this to me...
outro.title: Underground Book Storage Fourth Floor

outro.speaker: Vormav
outro.text: I'm counting on you, Rofel.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage Fourth Floor

outro.speaker: Rofel
outro.text: ...Fel...Cao...De...Nda...! Zeede...m...Fe...rio... I am...the one...with...the Time God...open...this gate...!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage Fourth Floor

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: I won't let you go!!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage Fourth Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza hearing the conversation, heads down to stop them.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage Fourth Floor

missions.brief: Orbonne · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Orbonne: the final seal

intro.speaker: Rofel
intro.text: I've been waiting for you, Ramza. That's far enough! Rest eternally beneath this monastery!
intro.title: Underground Book Storage Fifth Floor

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: This feeling...same as when I fought Celia and Lede!! You are not human.
intro.title: Underground Book Storage Fifth Floor

intro.speaker: Rofel
intro.text: No, I am not...I've risen above humans... I have obtained eternal life with the help of Vormav's power... Hee, hee, hee... You can't understand the joy.
intro.title: Underground Book Storage Fifth Floor

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: What are you trying to do? What do you want?
intro.title: Underground Book Storage Fifth Floor

intro.speaker: Rofel
intro.text: Do you really want to know, Ramza? If you do, then you'll have to beat me. That is, if you can...
intro.title: Underground Book Storage Fifth Floor

outro.speaker: Rofel
outro.text: I can't die here. I haven't finished my duty... Ramza...... I invite you to Hell.........Fareth Kaos De Vanda!! Zoeda Remdo Feolio... I am the one together with the Time God Zomala who can open this gate! Dejeon!!
outro.title: Underground Book Storage Fifth Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The floor starts to shake. Beams of light flashes around the room and explodes, covering the room with mist. The mist soon disappears along with everybody. Ramza appears in a room along with Rofel.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage Fifth Floor

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: What is this?
outro.title: Underground Book Storage Fifth Floor

outro.speaker: Rofel
outro.text: Welcome...to Murond, Death City. Now that you're here... you can never return... All we have to do now is to destroy that entrance...
outro.title: Underground Book Storage Fifth Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Rofel raises his hand and mumbles something. A ball of energy forms in Rofel's hand. The ball of energy disappears and the entrance collapses into pieces.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage Fifth Floor

outro.speaker: Rofel
outro.text: Go on... Your sister is waiting...
outro.title: Underground Book Storage Fifth Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Rofel dies.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage Fifth Floor

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Alma...
outro.title: Underground Book Storage Fifth Floor

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza leaves the room and ventures outside and meets up with his party. Ramza and his party comes across Kletian and his troop.
outro.title: Underground Book Storage Fifth Floor

missions.brief: Orbonne · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Murond Death City

intro.speaker: Kletian
intro.text: So Rofel's been defeated? Then, unless I defeat you here, I can't face Rofel... Come on!!
intro.title: Murond Death City

outro.speaker: Kletian
outro.text: Ugh...F...Forgive me...Rofel......
outro.title: Murond Death City

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Kletian dies. A loud thunderclap booms in the distance.
outro.title: Murond Death City

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Over there!?
outro.title: Murond Death City

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: Where's Vormav!? Where did he go!?
banter.title: Murond Death City

banter.speaker: Kletian
banter.text: Where? What an odd thing to say... We came to Death City to revive our master. He slumbers in this world incomplete parts. Vormav is heading for the master's resting place... where St. Ajora died!
banter.title: Murond Death City

banter.speaker: Ramza
banter.text: Where is that!? Where!?
banter.title: Murond Death City

banter.speaker: Kletian
banter.text: You'll have to defeat me to find out!?
banter.title: Murond Death City

missions.brief: Death City · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Lost Sacred Precincts

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza faces Balk, the Temple Knight who died in a battle at Bed Deserts with Ramza.
intro.title: Lost Sacred Precincts

intro.speaker: Balk
intro.text: Nice to see you, kid. I was beaten before, but not this time. I'll make Death City your grave!!
intro.title: Lost Sacred Precincts

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: You turned into one of Lucavi's too... You'd sink that low just to live? What a pity!!
intro.title: Lost Sacred Precincts

intro.speaker: Balk
intro.text: It's pretty nice, kid. I'm finally a real human being!
intro.title: Lost Sacred Precincts

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: I wouldn't call selling your soul to the devil human!
intro.title: Lost Sacred Precincts

intro.speaker: Balk
intro.text: I'm above 'death'. At the top of the human race. Now I don't have to endure unjust treatment by you aristocrats!! I've won true 'freedom'! I'm a true 'human being'! I will be treated 'equally' now!!
intro.title: Lost Sacred Precincts

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: A real 'human being'? Don't make me laugh!! How valuable is a 'freedom' you didn't earn yourself? The moment 'pride' is lost, 'freedom' is also lost...!! You lost your freedom when you lost your pride and confidence....!! 'Equality's not something you're given! It's something you fight for!! Any 'freedom' gotten from Lucavi isn't true freedom.
intro.title: Lost Sacred Precincts

outro.speaker: Balk
outro.text: I'm...dying? I thought I'd risen over 'death'...
outro.title: Lost Sacred Precincts

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza pulls out his sword. Balk dies.
outro.title: Lost Sacred Precincts

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: The Stone is sympathizing. That way...
outro.title: Lost Sacred Precincts

missions.brief: Sacred Precincts · Reach the next stage of the campaign.

missions.name: Airship Graveyard: Hashmalum

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Vormav is seen kneeling before the unconscious Alma.
intro.title: Graveyard of Airships

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: ...Why? Why doesn't Virgo work?
intro.title: Graveyard of Airships

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Vormav stands up.
intro.title: Graveyard of Airships

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: The Holy Angel's spirit is around in here... Why...? Maybe it's Ajora reincarnated...? ...No, that can't be. Certainly, Virgo did react.
intro.title: Graveyard of Airships

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Vormav looks up.
intro.title: Graveyard of Airships

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: ...You're here.
intro.title: Graveyard of Airships

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Ramza and his troop stands before Vormav.
intro.title: Graveyard of Airships

intro.speaker: Ramza
intro.text: That's far enough, Vormav! Virgo's not working! So give up and hand over Alma!!
intro.title: Graveyard of Airships

intro.speaker: Vormav
intro.text: No, it will work... It just needs more... You didn't hear? It just needs more blood... Lots of blood is needed for the Angel's resurrection. Much bloodshed since Ajora's death, but I guess it wasn't enough... I guess I'll have to go on another rampage...!! Heh, heh, heh.... Don't worry... I'll 'sacrifice' you first.
intro.title: Graveyard of Airships

intro.speaker: The Durai Papers
intro.text: Vormav using the stones power, changes into Hashmalum.
intro.title: Graveyard of Airships

intro.speaker: Hashmalum
intro.text: Master, 'Bloody Angel'... Let me offer you 'blood' darker than wine and hotter than burning lava!
intro.title: Graveyard of Airships

outro.speaker: Hashmalum
outro.text: Master... you are not awake yet?
outro.title: Graveyard of Airships

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The stone responds and Alma wakes up.
outro.title: Graveyard of Airships

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: Ugh...Wh...Where am I...?
outro.title: Graveyard of Airships

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Alma!!
outro.title: Graveyard of Airships

outro.speaker: Alma
outro.text: Brother...Ramza?
outro.title: Graveyard of Airships

outro.speaker: Hashmalum
outro.text: I won't let you interfere. Bloody Angel!! I offer...my own life...for your resurrection...!!
outro.title: Graveyard of Airships

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Seeing that he can't win. Hashmalum tears his body open and sacrifices himself for the Angel's resurrection. The stone falls from Hashmalum's body and flashes. The stone on Alma's body responds. A light of beam shines down from the sky onto Alma, resurrecting St. Ajora.
outro.title: Graveyard of Airships

outro.speaker: St. Ajora
outro.text: I have my body back...
outro.title: Graveyard of Airships

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Alma!!
outro.title: Graveyard of Airships

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The Holy Stone shines.
outro.title: Graveyard of Airships

outro.speaker: St. Ajora
outro.text: Ugh...what...What is this?
outro.title: Graveyard of Airships

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: The stone flashes again.
outro.title: Graveyard of Airships

outro.speaker: St. Ajora
outro.text: Ugh...Ugh... He...Help...Brother...
outro.title: Graveyard of Airships

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Ramza rushes towards Ajora.
outro.title: Graveyard of Airships

outro.speaker: Ramza
outro.text: Alma!!
outro.title: Graveyard of Airships

outro.speaker: St. Ajora
outro.text: Brother Ramza... Stop...Don't interfere... Do...not...inter...fere... Do...not...inter...!!!
outro.title: Graveyard of Airships

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Another light of beam shines down on Ajora and splits Alma from Ajora.
outro.title: Graveyard of Airships

deviations: Battlefields use new procedural geometry. They do not reproduce the PS1 tile coordinates, roofs, or treasure coordinates.
Core combat supports CT, jobs, spells, facing, height, status effects, equipment, and permanent-loss options. Exact PS1 formulas, enemy rosters, AI, and balance are not reproduced.

Battle scenes use the supplied source script. Some conditional branches and guide-author combat descriptions are omitted. The new tutorial, travel copy, optional transitions, models, and score are additions.

The equipment and ability catalogs are substantial but not complete. Some passive traits use adapted behavior. Chocobo riding, the complete artifact and unexplored-land catalogs, and full monster breeding rules are missing.
Propositions are playable three-member timed assignments, with adapted rewards and discovery records.
The original guide has conflicting or interpretive stage directions. They are reference text, not independent verification of canonical facts.

outro.text: Hey, get a grip!
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Dycedarg comes out.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Mosfungus poison has been spread in the air...
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Dycedarg falls on his knee. Zalbag helps his brother.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Brother!
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Don't worry, I'm alright... Where's is His Excellency?
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: We don't know.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Larg's Voice
outro.text: ...Here, Zalbag... Dycedarg...
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Zalbag and Dycedarg comes up and sees Larg lying on the ground
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: You Excellency!! Call the Chemist!!
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Dycedarg makes his way over to Larg.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: ...How do you feel?
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Larg
outro.text: My head hurts... I feel sick... But...I'll be alright. I'll feel better in a while.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: That's a problem.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Larg
outro.text: What?
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Zalbag brings out a dagger and stabs Larg.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Larg
outro.text: Urrgh!! Wha...What is this!?
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Brother!!
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Larg struggles. Dycedarg pushes the dagger deeper into Larg's body.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Quiet, Zalbag!
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Larg
outro.text: You...betraying me...? You killed Balbanes... not only to inherit the Beoulve estate... But, to kill...me...
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Dycedarg pulls out the dagger from Larg's body. Larg spits out bloods. Dycedarg stands up, breathing heavily. More blood trickles down from Larg's mouth. Larg dies.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Brother...No... Did you... 'poison'?
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Ugh...Ugh...... Not me. It was done by the allies who want Beoulve to take center stage...
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Why have they...
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Duke Larg died in battle, but we'll carry on his will...
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: But, the plot...
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Dycedarg
outro.text: Just put a dagger into one of their hands... He's the assassin sent by the Nanten. Alright...?
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: The Durai Papers
outro.text: Dycedarg falls down.
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

outro.speaker: Zalbag
outro.text: Brother!!
outro.title: North Wall of Bethla Garrison

flower.speaker: Flower Girl
flower.text: Would you like a flower? It's only 1 gil.
flower.title: Zarghidas Trade City

flower.speaker: Flower Girl
flower.text: What's wrong? You've never seen a flower before?
flower.title: Zarghidas Trade City

flower.speaker: The Durai Papers
flower.text: Ramza buys a flower from the girl.
flower.title: Zarghidas Trade City

flower.speaker: Flower Girl
flower.text: In a place like this... Not a lot of people buy flowers around here. When is my knight in shining armor going to take me away from here...? Oh, I'm sorry. Excuse me for babbling. Thank you so much for buying the flower. Bye.
flower.title: Zarghidas Trade City

flower.speaker: Ramza
flower.text: It's just the day and age.
flower.title: Zarghidas Trade City

flower.speaker: The Durai Papers
flower.text: After staying at Zarghidas Ramza and his troop had to pass Germinas Peak to reach Limberry.
flower.title: Zarghidas Trade City

gougBall.speaker: The Durai Papers
gougBall.text: Besrodio, Mustadio's father, finds a big ball of steel. Mustadio and Ramza examines the treasure.
gougBall.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

gougBall.speaker: Mustadio
gougBall.text: This is what you found in the drift?
gougBall.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

gougBall.speaker: Besrodio
gougBall.text: Yes, when I started digging last week at drift No. 57. I tried to take it apart, but I didn't know what to prod where.
gougBall.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

gougBall.speaker: The Durai Papers
gougBall.text: Ramza steps forward to take a closer look. The steel ball reacts to Ramza's holy stones.
gougBall.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

gougBall.speaker: Ramza
gougBall.text: Did it respond to the stone?
gougBall.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

gougBall.speaker: The Durai Papers
gougBall.text: Having no clue, Ramza, Mustadio and their troop leaves Goug. Ramza and troop comes to Goland. Ramza walks inside the bar and hears a rumor.
gougBall.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

ghost.speaker: The Durai Papers
ghost.text: ```text I------------------------------------------------------------I |-- =-=-= =-= =-=-= =-= =-=- NEWS -=-= =-= =-=-= =-= =-=-= --| | Ghost of Colliery | | There are numerous coal mines in Goland, but a monster | | seems to have recently settled in one of them. A plan to | | gather Knights to suppress the monster was being made by | | the adminstration, but due to the war no progress has been | | made.
ghost.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

ghost.speaker: The Durai Papers
ghost.text: The adminstration put up a reward for anyone, from | | commoner to hunter, who slays the monster. All hope for a | | quick solution. | I------------------------------------------------------------I ```
ghost.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: The Durai Papers
beowulf.text: After hearing this rumor, Ramza and troop heads north and comes to Lesalia. Ramza walks inside the bar and walks over to the counter.
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: The Durai Papers
beowulf.text: Lesalia's Bar
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Bar Master
beowulf.text: Welcome. Something to drink?
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Ramza
beowulf.text: Ok...milk please.
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Bar Master
beowulf.text: Ha, I like you. Never seen anyone order that at a bar. You must've seen a lot of bloodshed. But you don't drink, eh?
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: The Durai Papers
beowulf.text: Ramza hears a conversation between some people.
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Bar Patron #1
beowulf.text: So it was true. There are monsters in Goland.
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Bar Patron #2
beowulf.text: Yeah, the coal mine shut down. We're in a fix.
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Bar Patron #1
beowulf.text: And we can't count on Knights either in this day and age.
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Bar Patron #2
beowulf.text: All of Goland's recruiting hunters, I hear.
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Bar Master
beowulf.text: Aren't you a hunter? You'd make good money.
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Ramza
beowulf.text: I don't care about the money. I can't leave people in need.
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Bar Master
beowulf.text: Wow, very impressive! If only Sir Balbanes were alive...
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Bar Patron #2
beowulf.text: But there's one that even a master hunter can't beat.
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Bar Patron #1
beowulf.text: Now, that's a big problem. What kind of a monster is it?
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Bar Patron #2
beowulf.text: It's called the Holly Dragon. Really unusual...
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Bar Master
beowulf.text: Are you going?
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Ramza
beowulf.text: Yeah. I'll just go and see.
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Bar Master
beowulf.text: Good luck.
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: The Durai Papers
beowulf.text: Ramza tries to leave the bar. A mysterious man stands up from his seat.
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Knight
beowulf.text: If you're going to the coal mines, would you hire me?
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Ramza
beowulf.text: Who are you?
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Knight
beowulf.text: My name is Beowulf, I'm a hunter. I've been searching for this Holy Dragon. What do you think?
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Ramza
beowulf.text: Ok, let's go together.
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

beowulf.speaker: Beowulf
beowulf.text: You can pay me later. Let's go
beowulf.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: The Durai Papers
worker8.text: Mustadio's House
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: The Durai Papers
worker8.text: Ramza and Mustadio tries to insert the 'Aquarius' stone inside the big steel ball.
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Mustadio
worker8.text: Will it really work with the stone?
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Besrodio
worker8.text: You saw it too, right? I'm sure it does.
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: The Durai Papers
worker8.text: Ramza inserts the stone.
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Mustadio
worker8.text: Hey, look! It moved!
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: The Durai Papers
worker8.text: The steel ball transforms into a big giant robot. The giant robot tries to move but fails.
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Mustadio
worker8.text: ....No? No go?
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: The Durai Papers
worker8.text: The giant's red eyes glows.
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Steel Giant
worker8.text: System set up completed! Everything is normal! Master, what is your order?
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Mustadio
worker8.text: Wow! It spoke!!
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Steel Giant
worker8.text: Master, your order, please!
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Mustadio
worker8.text: Ramza, give him an order.
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Ramza
worker8.text: What!? An order? No, I'm scared!!
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Mustadio
worker8.text: Don't be silly. You're his master!
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Steel Giant
worker8.text: Repeat, order, please!
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Ramza
worker8.text: Well...well then... Dance!!
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Mustadio
worker8.text: Do better than that!
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Ramza
worker8.text: A, all right...
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: The Durai Papers
worker8.text: The robot starts to dance.
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Mustadio
worker8.text: He's...dancing...... I wonder if he's strong?
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Steel Giant
worker8.text: I...am...very...strong!
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Ramza
worker8.text: Well...well then... Beat Mustadio up!!
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Mustadio
worker8.text: Do better than that!
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: The Durai Papers
worker8.text: The robot looks at Mustadio. Mustadio freaks out. The robot sends a huge wave of energy at Mustadio. Mustadio goes down cold.
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Ramza
worker8.text: Help! Phoenix down! Where's the Phoenix down?
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: The Durai Papers
worker8.text: Besrodio, the father of Mustadio, found another 'Past Treasure'.
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Mustadio
worker8.text: Father, what's this big one?
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Besrodio
worker8.text: I built it from stuff found at drift No. 83, but uh...
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Ramza
worker8.text: It looks like a heavenly globe.
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Besrodio
worker8.text: Now that you mention it... I guess it does, hmm...
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: The Durai Papers
worker8.text: The machine reacts to Ramza's holy stones.
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Mustadio
worker8.text: W, what was that?
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Ramza
worker8.text: It responded to the stone again?
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Besrodio
worker8.text: What's this '?' mark for? Holy Stone... ...indeed.
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

worker8.speaker: Ramza
worker8.text: You want us to search for it right? Oh well...
worker8.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

island.speaker: The Durai Papers
island.text: The party sets out and searches for this particular holy stone. The party tumbles at Zeltennia and hears a rumor.
island.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

island.speaker: The Durai Papers
island.text: ```text I------------------------------------------------------------I |-- =-=-= =-= =-=-= =-= =-=- NEWS -=-= =-= =-=-= =-= =-=-= --| | Cursed Island, Nelveska | | Nelveska Island, an island that lies 8000 doma north of | | Zeltennia. In the center of the island are many temple | | graves. It was a critical area used by guerillas resisting | | the enemy.
island.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

island.speaker: The Durai Papers
island.text: Known as a paradise for its lush greenery, the | | fishermen call it a 'Cursed Island.' and "A fearsome iron | | sentinel will kill all those who approach." | I------------------------------------------------------------I ```
island.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

island.speaker: The Durai Papers
island.text: Upon hearing this rumor, the party heads off to Nelveska.
island.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: The Durai Papers
cloudSummoned.text: Mustadio's House
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: The Durai Papers
cloudSummoned.text: Ramza prepares to insert the holy stone, they received from the robot, inside the weird machine Besrodio found.
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: Mustadio
cloudSummoned.text: It can't 'morph', can it?
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: Ramza
cloudSummoned.text: I guess you'll find out.
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: The Durai Papers
cloudSummoned.text: Ramza inserts the holy stone inside the machine.
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: Mustadio
cloudSummoned.text: Here he comes!
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: The Durai Papers
cloudSummoned.text: Light shines on the machine from above. From the mist a man appears.
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: Summoned young man
cloudSummoned.text: What happened? Last thing I remember was getting caught in the current.
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: Besrodio
cloudSummoned.text: Hum, I've read about this before. It could be some forwarding device.
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: Mustadio
cloudSummoned.text: Forwarding device?
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: Besrodio
cloudSummoned.text: You know, to travel to other worlds, different space.
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: Ramza
cloudSummoned.text: So, he came from other space?
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: Besrodio
cloudSummoned.text: Maybe. Look at his clothes, Quite unusual.
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: Summoned young man
cloudSummoned.text: My....name's Cloud. yes...Cloud.
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: Ramza
cloudSummoned.text: I'm Ramza. They're my friends....
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: Cloud
cloudSummoned.text: I don't care about names. What I need is a battlefield. Yeah...that's it...I'm a member of SOLDIER.
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: Mustadio
cloudSummoned.text: What a jerk!
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: The Durai Papers
cloudSummoned.text: A strange sound starts to ring in Cloud's head.
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: Cloud
cloudSummoned.text: What's this? My fingers are tingling... My eyes...they're burning... Stop...stop it.... phiros...
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: Mustadio
cloudSummoned.text: He's strange.
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: Cloud
cloudSummoned.text: I must go...must go to that place...
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: The Durai Papers
cloudSummoned.text: Cloud runs out.
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: Mustadio
cloudSummoned.text: Who was he?
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

cloudSummoned.speaker: The Durai Papers
cloudSummoned.text: The party runs after Cloud.
cloudSummoned.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

deepDungeon.speaker: The Durai Papers
deepDungeon.text: After rescuing Cloud. Ramza heads back to Goug and travels to Warjilis. Upon coming to Warjilis, Ramza walks inside the bar.
deepDungeon.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

deepDungeon.speaker: The Durai Papers
deepDungeon.text: Warjilis Bar
deepDungeon.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

deepDungeon.speaker: The Durai Papers
deepDungeon.text: Ramza sees a Knight and a Priest near the counter.
deepDungeon.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

deepDungeon.speaker: Knight
deepDungeon.text: This job's been a great success!
deepDungeon.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

deepDungeon.speaker: Priest
deepDungeon.text: Not to brag, but you can all thank me!
deepDungeon.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

deepDungeon.speaker: Bar Master
deepDungeon.text: Hmm, Count Minimum has his problems too.
deepDungeon.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

deepDungeon.speaker: The Durai Papers
deepDungeon.text: Ramza overhears a conversation between some people.
deepDungeon.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

deepDungeon.speaker: Bar Patron
deepDungeon.text: Then, it was true. The legend of the island's treasures...
deepDungeon.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

deepDungeon.speaker: Bar Patron #1
deepDungeon.text: Yeah, I hear there's lots of riches inside that cave.
deepDungeon.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

deepDungeon.speaker: Bar Patron
deepDungeon.text: Hmm, but those caves have lots of traps, right?
deepDungeon.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

deepDungeon.speaker: Bar Patron #1
deepDungeon.text: Not only traps...but I hear there's scary magicians there also.
deepDungeon.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

deepDungeon.speaker: Bar Patron
deepDungeon.text: Yikes! It doesn't matter how many lives you got!
deepDungeon.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

deepDungeon.speaker: Bar Patron #1
deepDungeon.text: Not even a flicker of light in there. No place for wimps.
deepDungeon.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

deepDungeon.speaker: Bar Patron
deepDungeon.text: What was the name of that cave? D...D...Depo Dungeon?
deepDungeon.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

deepDungeon.speaker: Bar Patron #1
deepDungeon.text: It's 'Deep Dungeon', right?
deepDungeon.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

deepDungeon.speaker: The Durai Papers
deepDungeon.text: The Knight and the Priest starts to argue near the counter.
deepDungeon.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

deepDungeon.speaker: Knight
deepDungeon.text: Wha? This job was a great success because of ME!
deepDungeon.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

deepDungeon.speaker: Priest
deepDungeon.text: Why're you talking so big? ...You talk weird too!
deepDungeon.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

deepDungeon.speaker: The Durai Papers
deepDungeon.text: The Priest pushes the Knight. The Priest turns around and sees Ramza.
deepDungeon.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

deepDungeon.speaker: Priest
deepDungeon.text: This ain't no show! Go away!
deepDungeon.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: People have arrived here to pay their respects to Alma Beoulve.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: Priest
endingScenes.text: With the Father's blessing, you shall return to Earth. Guide Alma Beoulve's soul to Heaven with St, Ajora's divine protection... Farlem...
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: Everybody
endingScenes.text: ...Farlem.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: The people starts to leave.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: Mourner (Old man)
endingScenes.text: What a pity. She was so young.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: Mourner (Old woman)
endingScenes.text: All the siblings gone...
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: Mourner (Middle-aged man)
endingScenes.text: The youngest, Ramza won't even be buried. Sad...
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: Mourner (Middle-aged woman)
endingScenes.text: Beoulve's 300 year history is over now...
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: All the people leaves. Olan and Balmafula comes.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: Olan
endingScenes.text: I'm sorry I'm late... Alma, Ramza. I wanted to come earlier, but it was too dangerous... Too risky...
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: Balmafula puts a bundle of flowers on top of Alma's grave.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: Olan
endingScenes.text: Delita married Ovelia. A commoner brings peace to a chaotic kingdom, marries the Princess, becoming King. A legend that will be passed down for centuries. Delita may be a good person as you said... He made it look like he killed her then let her go, when her identity was clear. I guess he identified with her, having been used by Vormav...
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: Balmafula points to an area. Olan nods and she leaves.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: Olan
endingScenes.text: Did my father die fighting heroically?
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: Olan shakes his head.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: Olan
endingScenes.text: ......I'll come back again. Bye...
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: Olan walks away and stops. He then looks back.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: Olan
endingScenes.text: Are you really dead? I still can't believe you're really dead... I mean...you know...
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: Ramza and Alma appears riding chocobos.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: The two leaves the area. Olan runs after them.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: Olan
endingScenes.text: Wait! Ramza! Alma!
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: The two disappears into the shadows. Balmafula comes.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: Olan
endingScenes.text: ...He's alive! Alive!!
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: Olan and Balmafula stares at the direction they went.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: Olan
endingScenes.text: ...Thank you. Ramza.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: Ending Full Motion Video: Ramza and Alma, riding in chocobos, walks through the forest and comes across a ruin. The two chocobos drinks water from the nearby river. Dawn arrives and the two heads into the direction of the sun. The sun fades.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: Since then, no one has caught sight of the two.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: Olan Durai reminisces in such a manner...
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: Where does one find good fortune? What possesses them to live for the present? What treasures will they leave behind?
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: The only thing certain is that he is the true hero, indeed.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: Years later, Olan Durai collected his experiences over a period of 5 years into a single syllabus.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: This Collection known as the "Durai papers" were to be presented at Prince Clemence's meeting during which the new possessor of the throne was to be selected,
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: but the church which feared public disclosure of the truth decided to arrest Durai and burn him at the stake for the crime of heresy.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: The retrieved Durai papers were then confiscated by the church for several hundred years.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: But I have uncovered the truth... Let me now revive his honor. Let his way of life be absorbed by the next generation.
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: Author of the Brave Story, Alazlam Durai
endingScenes.title: Graveyard

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: Delita arrives at the ruins with his chocobo to meet Ovelia.
endingScenes.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

endingScenes.speaker: King Delita
endingScenes.text: Here you are...Everyone's been looking for you.
endingScenes.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: Delita hops down from his chocobo and walks over to Ovelia. He brings out some flowers from his back.
endingScenes.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

endingScenes.speaker: King Delita
endingScenes.text: Today's your birthday, right? These flowers...
endingScenes.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: Ovelia turns around and dashes towards at Delita. She stabs him with a small dagger. The flowers falls down from Delita's hand.
endingScenes.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

endingScenes.speaker: King Delita
endingScenes.text: O....Ovelia...?
endingScenes.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

endingScenes.speaker: Queen Ovelia
endingScenes.text: You use everybody like that! Now, you'll kill me just like Ramza...!
endingScenes.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: Delita pulls out the dagger from Ovelia's hand and stabs her with it. Ovela falls down on the ground and dies. Delita, holding his wound, backs away and drops the dagger. He then falls on his knees.
endingScenes.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

endingScenes.speaker: King Delita
endingScenes.text: Ramza.... What did you get? I.........
endingScenes.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church

endingScenes.speaker: The Durai Papers
endingScenes.text: The screen fades.
endingScenes.title: Ruins of Zeltennia Castle's church
